sanskrit: prasannavadanaṃ dhyāyet sarvavighnopaśāṃtayevidveṣivargavijaye harinīlavarṇāmaṃbāṃ trilokajananīmajaniṃ prapadmejaya sarvagate devi bhadrakāli namostutenigamāgamataṃtrāṇāṃ purāṇavacasāmapimaṃtrajyotiṣaśilpānāṃ sāraṃ saṃgṛhya tattvataḥ || 2 || ||svarūpāyudhavarṇānāṃ bhūṣāvāhanalakṣmaṇāmviṣṇvīśa brahmaśakrādi devānāṃ lakṣaṇāni caetat prasaṃgādanyeṣāṃ vaktavyānāṃ kramā apigraṃthe śrītattvanidhyākhye navanidhyātmake śubhevakṣyāmāṇeṣu vidhiṣu jñātavyoyaṃ tvanukramaḥ || 7 || ||viṣṇumūrtiprabhedānāṃ lakṣmaproktaṃ dvitīyaketurīye brahmaśakrādidevarūpanirūpaṇamṣaṣṭhe proktaṃ harikṣetraśāligrāmādilakṣaṇamnigamāgamataṃtrādilakṣaṇaṃ proktamaṣṭameetannavanidhi jñānātsulabhānidhayonavatriṇotrāyauvanasthā ca kruddhā cordhva sthitāmatāekavaktrā tu sugrīvā bāhuviṃśati saṃyutāabhayaṃ ḍamaruṃ caivacchurikāṃ dakṣiṇaiḥ karaiḥnāgaṃpāśaṃ tathā kheṭaṃ kuṭhārāṃkuśa kārmukāntadadhomahiṣaśchinnamūrdhā patitamastakaḥśūlabhinnovamadraktorakta bhrūśmaśrulocanaḥvāmāṃghryākrāṃta siṃhā ca savyāṃghryālīḍhagāsurācaṃḍīcodyata śastreyamaśeṣaripunāśinī || svarṇavarṇaḥekakāloditāneka caṃdrakoṭyarkakoṭibhāmjapākusumasaṃkāśāma japāma japātmikām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bālārkakoṭibhāṃ tryakṣāṃ bāleṃdumakuṭojjvalāmacaṃcalataṭitkoṭiprabhā piṃgalavāsasamkoṭarikoṭī ghaṭitasudhākara sudhāplutāmkaṭākṣasaraṇī niryatkaruṇā pūrṇalocanāmśukratārāsamākāranāsābharaṇaśobhinīmvīṇāravaghṛṇādāyinijavāṇīguṇodayāmmaṇidarpaṇadarpaghnakapolaphalakaprabhāmmaṇimaṃgalasūtreṇa vilasatkaṃbukaṃdharāmratnāṃgulīya nivahairlasadaṃguli pallavāmkucabhāra namanmadhyatrivalī lalitodarāmsuvṛttajaṃghorukāṃḍāṃgūḍhagulphāṃ guḍālakāmratnagraiveya valayamakuṭāṃgadakaṃkaṇāmsarvaśṛṃgāra veṣāḍhyāṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāmkāraṇe śaśiroratnanighṛṣṭa caraṇāṃbujāmpaṃcapretāsanāsīnāṃ paṃcapraṇavarūpiṇīm || siṃdūravarṇaḥnīlāśmadyutimāsya pādadaśakāṃseve mahākālikāṃ yāmastautsvapiteharaukamalajohaṃtuṃ madhuṃkaiṭabham || 1 || nīlavarṇaḥśūlaṃpāśasudarśane ca dadhatīṃ hastaiḥ pravālaprabhāṃ sevesairibhamardinīmiha mahālakṣmīṃ sarojasthitām || 1 || pravālavarṇaḥgaurīdeha samudbhavāṃ trijagatāmādhārabhūtāṃ mahā pūrvāmatrasarasvatīmanubhaje śuṃbhādidaityārdinīm || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥprāptiḥ prākāmyāmīśatvaṃ va śitvaṃcāṣṭabhūtayaḥetādevyaścaturvāhāḥ japākusumasaṃnibhāḥdadhānādayayā pūrṇāyogibhiśca niṣevitāḥ || 3 || raktavarṇaḥvārāhī caiva māheṃdrīcāmuṃḍā caiva saptamīkapālamutpalaṃ caiva bibhrāṇāraktavāsasaḥbrahmādisadṛśākārā brahmādisadṛśāyudhāḥbrahmādīnāṃ paraṃ cihnaṃdhārayaṃtyaḥprakīrtitāḥ || raktavarṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dāḍimī puṣpasaṃkāśāḥ pītāṃbaramanoharāḥmadaraktabilolākṣyastāsāṃ nāmāmisaṃ śṛṇusarvākarṣiṇimudrā ca tathā sarvavaśaṃkarīsarvakhecari mudrā ca sarvabījā tathā parāityetāḥ kathitā vipradaśamudrādhidevatāḥ || 5 || raktavarṇaḥahaṃkārā karṣiṇī ca sarvākarṣiṇikākalārasākarṣiṇikā caiva gaṃdhākarṣiṇikākalāsmṛtyākarṣiṇikā nityānāmā karṣiṇikākalāamṛtākarṣiṇī nityāśarīrākarṣiṇī parāvidrumadruma saṃkāśāmaṃda prahasitānanāḥcāpabāṇau carmakhaḍgaudadhānādivyakāṃtayaḥ || 6 || raktavarṇaḥanaṃgamadanānaṃgamadanāturayā sahaanaṃgamālinya parācaitā devyojapātviṣaḥbibhratyodabhravikrāṃti śālinyolalitājñayā || 3 || raktavarṇaḥveṇī kṛtakacasmotāḥ siṃdūratilakojjvalāḥvahnicāpaṃ vahnibāṇaṃ vahnirūpamasiṃ tathāasureṃdraṃ pratikruddhāḥ kāmabhasma samudbhavamsarvasaṃkṣobhiṇī caiva sarvavidrāviṇī tathāsarvasaṃmohinī śaktissarvastaṃbhinikā tathāsarvaraṃjinikā śaktiḥ sarvonmādinikā tathāsarvamaṃtramayī śaktissarvadvaṃdvakṣayaṃkarīityevaṃ saṃpradāyānāṃ nāmāni kathitāni vai || raktavarṇaḥgadāṃghaṃṭāmaṇiṃ caiva dadhānādīpta vigrahāḥetāsāmapi nāmāni samākarṇayakuṃbhajasarvapriyaṃkarīdevī sarvamaṃgalakāriṇī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvamṛtyupraśamanī sarvavighnanivāriṇīdaśaitāḥ kathitādevyodayayā pūritāśayāḥ || 5 || śvetavarṇaḥsarvajñā sarvaśaktiśca sarvaiśvaryapradāyinīsarvādhāra svarūpā ca sarvapāpaharā tathāsarvepsita pradādevīmuktā gaurasamatviṣaḥcakraṃ caiva ca bibhrāṇā bhaṃḍāsuravadhodyatāḥ || 4 || śvetavarṇaḥraktāśokaprasūnābhā bāṇakārmukapāṇayaḥvaśinī caiva kāmeśīmodinīvimalā tathāaṣṭāvetāssmṛtā devyodaityasaṃhārahetavaḥ || 3 || raktavarṇaḥcāpabāṇaupānapātraṃ mātuliṃgaṃ kṛpāṇakambibhrāṇāmahironmattā atipūrvarahasyakāḥtisra etāssmṛtā daityebhaṃḍekopasamanvitāḥetāstu nityaṃ śrīdevyā aṃtaraṃgā prakīrtitāḥ || 4 || siṃdūravarṇaḥjagatāmupakārāya varttamānā yuge yugekarairdadhānāmaruṇāṃ triṇetrāṃ kāmeśvarīṃ nityamahaṃbhajāmi || 1 || raktavarṇaḥbaṃdhūkapuṣparucirāmati suṃdarāṃgīmaṃbāṃbhajāmi hṛdaye bhagamālinīṃ tām || 1 || raktavarṇaḥdorbhiḥpāśaṃ sṛṇivaramabhayaṃ pānapātraṃ dadhānāṃ nityaklinnāmahamanudivasaṃmānase bhāvayāmi || 1 || raktavarṇaḥguṃjāmālā virājatkucabharanamanonmadhyamāmabjasaṃsthāṃ nānā laṃkāra yuktāṃsuramakuṭamaṇidyotita svarṇapīṭhāmbhaktābhīṣṭādhidevīṃ paramasukhakarīṃ svākṛtiṃ sundarāsyāṃ bheruṃḍāṃ muktakeśīṃ tribhuvanajananīṃ cetasā ciṃtayāmi || śvetavarṇaḥtaptodyat kāṃcanābhāṃ maṇimayamakuṭāmaṣṭahastāṃ triṇetrāṃ nityāṃ cittāraviṃde pratidivasamahaṃ vahnivāsībhajāmi || 1 || kanakavarṇaḥbibhrāṇāṃ raktavarṇāṃ tribhirapinayanaiḥ sādaraṃ vīkṣatīṃ tāṃ vajreśīṃ bhāvayehaṃ suragaṇamunibhiḥ stūyamānāṃ bhavā**? || 1 || raktavarṇaḥmadhyāhnārka prabhābhāṃ navamaṇivilasadbhūṣaṇāmaṣṭahastāṃ dūtīṃ nityāṃ triṇetrāṃ suragaṇamunibhiḥ stūyamānāṃbhajeham || 1 || pāṭalavarṇaḥpītāṃpallavavāsinīṃ śikhiśikhā cūḍāvataṃsojjvalāṃ dhyāyāmyanvahamṛkṣasiṃhanivahaiḥ pīṭhasthi tāṃ sundarīm || 1 || pītavarṇaḥmālāṃpustakamapyabhīṣṭamabhayaṃ saṃbibhratīṃ bāhubhirbālāṃ tāmakhilāṃgabhūṣaṇadharāṃ dhyāyāmi saṃsiddhidām || 1 || aruṇavarṇaḥdakṣairaṃkuśapustakeṣu kusumaṃ khaḍgaṃ kapālābhayaṃ māṇikyābhara ṇojjvalāṃ triṇayanāṃ nityāṃbhavānīṃbhaje || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dakṣecāṃkuśa khaḍgaśaktisu mahābāṇābhayānbāhubhiḥ padmasthāṃ maṇimauktikā vṛtakucāṃnīladhvajāmāśraye || 1 || nīlavarṇaḥudyadbālārkavarṇāṃ tribhuvanavijayāṃ paṃcavaktraṃ trinetrāṃ devīṃ pītāṃbarāḍhyāṃku ca bharanamitāṃ saṃtataṃ bhāvayāmi || 1 || raktavarṇaḥbhaktānāṃ dhanadāṃvaraṃ ca radhatīṃvāmenahastena taddakṣeṇābhayamātulaṃgasuphalaṃ śrīmaṃgalāṃ bhāvaye || 1 || kanakavarṇaḥdakṣetvaṃkuśakhaḍgaśaktisuśarāñcāpābhaye bibhratīṃ jvalāmālinisaṃjñitāṃ maṇimayībhūṣānvitāmāśraye || 1 || raktavarṇaḥcitrāṃśukāṃ ca navaratnavibhūṣitāṃgīṃ citrāṃbikāṃtriṇayanāṃ hṛdibhāvayāmi || 1 || raktavarṇaḥrājarājeśvarīvatpāśāṃkuśekṣucāpapuṣpabāṇahastā siṃdūravarṇākāryāvarmadevī dṛṣṭidevī hyastradevīṣaḍīratāḥparitobindupīṭhaṃ ca bhrāmyaṃtyodīptamūrtayaḥ || 2 || raktavarṇaḥpāśapātradharāceyaṃ dvibhujāśyāmalā smṛtā || 1 || śyāmavarṇaḥālīḍhasthāna saṃsthānācatussiṃharathe sthitābāṇacāpau ca kartavye śaṃkhapadme tathaiva cadaṃḍaśaktī ca kartavye kṛṣṇājinahutāśanauekatraiva mahābhāgāratnapātradharā bhavet || 4 || nīlavarṇaḥbibhrāṇāṃ bāhudaṃḍaissulalitavaradādyābhivītāṃmanojñāṃ mudgānnāsaktacittāṃ madhumadamuditāṃ śākinīṃbhāvayet tām || 1 || svarṇavarṇaḥmedodhātu pratiṣṭhāmalimadamuditāṃbaṃdhinīṃpūgaśaktyāvītāṃdadhya nnasaktāmabhimataphaladāṃkinīṃ bhāvayet tām || 1 || pītavarṇaḥḍāmaryādyaiḥparītāṃ paśujanabhayadāṃmāṃsadhātvāsanasthāṃgauḍā nne saktacittāṃsakalasukhakarīṃsaṃsmarellākinīṃ tām || 1 || kṛṣṇavarṇaḥraktasthāṃ kālarātriprabhṛtiparivṛtāṃ śuddharaktepravṛttāṃ śrīmadvīreṃdravaṃdyāmabhimataphaladāṃ rākinīṃ bhāvayet tām || 1 || śyāmavarṇaḥvaktreṇaikenayuktāṃ paśujanabhayadāṃpāyasānna prasaktāṃtvaksthāṃ vaṃdemṛtoghaiḥ parivṛtavapuṣaṃḍākinīṃ vīracaṃḍām || 1 || raktavarṇaḥṣaḍvaktrāmabjasaṃsthāṃ trinayanalalitāṃhaṃsagatyādiyuktāṃhāridrānne prasaktāṃ sakalasuranutāṃhākinīṃ bhāvayet tām || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥrādīnāṃ sarvavaktrāṃ sakalasukhakarīṃ sarvadhātu svarūpāṃ sarvānnesaktacittāṃparaśivarasikāṃ bhāvayed yākinīṃ tām || 1 || citravarṇaḥpiṃgābhābhūṣaṇopetāmṛgacarmottarīyakāvāme tu pustakaṃkuṃḍīṃbibhratīcābhayaṃkaram || 2 || pītavarṇaḥśvetavarṇā daśabhujācaṃdrarekhā vibhūṣitāpāśaṃghaṃṭāṃ tathā nāgamaṃkuśaṃ bibhratīkaraiḥ || 2 || śvetavarṇaḥravibāhurmayūrasthāvaradā śaktidhariṇī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paraśuṃ bibhratī caiva tadadhastvabhayānvitā || 2 || pāṭalavarṇaḥśaṃkhacakrābhayānvāme sā ceyaṃvilasadbhujā || 1 || nīlavarṇaḥvaradādaṃḍinī khaḍgaṃbibhratī dakṣiṇekarekheṭapātrābhayānvāme sūkarāsyālasadbhujā || kṛṣṇavarṇaḥvaradāsūtriṇī vajraṃ bibhratyūrdhvaṃ tu dakṣiṇevāme tu kamalaṃpātraṃ hyabhayaṃtadadhaḥkare || kanakavarṇaḥdaṃṣṭrālākṣīṇadehā ca gartākṣīkāmarūpiṇīaṃkuśaṃ bibhratīkhaḍgaṃdakṣiṇe cāthavāmakekheṭaṃpāśaṃdhanurdaṃḍaṃ kuṭhāraṃcāpibibhratī || kṛṣṇavarṇaḥjaṭilāvartulā tryakṣāvaradā śūladhāriṇīkartrikāṃ bibhratīdakṣe pāśapātrābhayānvitā || śvetavarṇaḥvṛṣārūḍhāṃ śūladharāṃ śailaputrīṃyaśasvinīm || 1devīprasīda tu mayibrahmacāriṇyanuttamā || 1prasādaṃ tanutāṃmahyaṃ caṃḍakhaṃḍeti viśrutā || 1śubhadāstu sadā devīskaṃdamātāyaśasvinī || 1dadhānāhastapadmābhyāṃ kūṣmāṃḍāśubhadāstume || 1kātyāyanīśubhaṃ dadyād devīdānavaghātinī || 1kālarātriḥśubhaṃ dadyād devīcaṃḍāṭṭahāsinī || 1mahāgaurīśubhaṃ dadyānmahādeva pramodadā || 1sevyamānā sadābhūyāt siddhidāsiddhidāyinī || 1tatra padmānvite sthāne pūjyādurgāstumūrtitaḥ | aṣṭādaśabhujācaikāpīnavakṣobhujorukāmūrdhajaṃ kheṭakaṃghaṃṭāmādarśaṃtarjanīṃ dhanuḥśaktimudgaraśūlānivajraṃ śaṃkhamathāṃbujamśeṣāṣṣoḍaśahastāssyuśśaraṃḍamarukaṃvinānavamīcogra caṃḍā ca navadurgāḥprakīrtitāḥ || 1 || (tāsāṃvarṇā) ||
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pītā ca pāṃḍarā jñeyāhyālīḍhāstāharidvṛtāḥ || 1pannagavalayavibhūṣāṃ nīlagrīvāṃdigaṃbarāṃ vaṃde || 1 || śyāmavarṇaḥsaśūlakhaḍgāṃdhṛtaśaṃkhacakrāṃ mṛgeṃdrayānāṃ ravicaṃdrabhūṣāmiṣṭārthadātrīṃsuravaṃdyapādāṃ rudrāṃśadurgāṃ manasāsmarāmi || śyāmavarṇaḥvajraṃkare bibhratī sā mahākālīmudestunaḥ || 1 || meghaśyāmavarṇaḥ ||mama sā mahiṣottamāṃgasaṃsthā navadūrvāsadṛśīśriyestudurgā || 1 || hemavarṇaḥśyāmābhāṃ ca triṇetrāṃ tāṃ siṃhavaktrāṃ caturbhujām || ūrdhvakeśīṃ ca siṃhasthāṃcaṃ*??kitaśiroruhāmpratyaṅgirā??nityaṃ sarvaśatruvināśinīm || 2 || śyāmavarṇaḥsiṃhaskaṃdhādhirūḍhā catasṛbhirasikheṭānvitābhiḥ parītākanyābhirbhinna daityābhavatu bhavabhayadhvaṃsinīśūlinīnaḥ || 1 || meghaśyāmavarṇaḥghorāṃghorāṭṭahāsāṃkarakalitakapālāsiraudrāṃ triṇetrāṃ śatrūṇāṃ prāṇahaṃtrīṃ śaśiśiśumakuṭāṃ bhāvayeddhūmrakālām || 1 || raktavarṇaḥjagajjaitrīṃ japāraktāṃdevīṃvaśyamukhīṃbhaje || 1 || raktavarṇaḥkharvānīlaviśālapiṃgalajaṭājūṭogranāgairvṛtā jāḍyaṃ nyasyakapālake trijagatāṃhaṃtyugratārāsvayam || 1 || siṃdūravarṇaḥtamālaśyāmalākārāśyāmakaṃcukadhāriṇīparitobhrāmyati munemaṇinaukādhirohiṇī || 2 || nīlavarṇaḥyāṃsuvāmālinīmāhuryāmāhuramṛteśvarīmīṣadālokamātreṇa trailokyamadadāyinīpārijātaprasūnāsṛk parivītakacoccayāvāruṇītaraṇī śreṇīnāyikā tatra rājate || 4 || raktavarṇaḥnīlakuṃcita keśāgrāṃnimnanābhīvalitrayāmpītāṃbaravaropetāṃ bhūṣaṇasragvibhūṣitāmśaṃkhacakragadābhīti ramyahastāṃtrilocanāmsarvakāmapradāṃdevīṃ dhyāyet tāmaparājitām || nīlavarṇaḥagnijvālāraudramukhī ghoradaṃṣṭrātrilocanāetai raviṣkṛtairghoraiśśīghramuccāṭayed dviṣaḥ || 2 || nīla??ḍhakkāśūladharāṃ mahābalaripudhvaṃsāṃ kṛśāṃgīṃmahīṃ bhīmāṃgīṃ trijaṭāṃdavānalamayīṃ dhyāyetpinākistutām || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kārtasvaramayāṃbhoja karṇikāmadhyasaṃsthitamcakraṃvirājate tatra taptakāṃcanasannibhāśaṃkhacakrābhayavarān halaṃ ca musalaṃ tathāvārāhavaktrasaṃyuktādaṃḍinī tatra vartate || 4 || kanakavarṇaḥbibhrāṇāṃ svakarāṃbujairasilatāṃ carmāpipāśaṃsṛṇiṃ vārāhīmanu ciṃtayeddhayavarārūḍhāṃśubhālaṃkṛtim || 1 || meghaśyāmavarṇaḥśūlaṃkapālaṃmusalaṃnāgaṃ hastaistubibhratīmiṃdurekhālasanmauliṃ vārāhīṃtāmahaṃbhaje || nīlavarṇaḥkarasphuritavallakīṃ vimalaśaṃkhatāṭaṃkinīṃgha?nastanabharālasāṃgalita cūlikāṃśyāmalām || 1 || śyāmavarṇaḥabjanyastaikacaraṇāṃ cārucaṃdrāvataṃsakāmsaugaṃdhikasrakkalikācūlikāṃ raktavāsasamvibhūṣaṇairbhūṣitāṃ ca mātaṃgīṃ praṇamāmyaham || śyāmavarṇaḥakṣasrakpustakābhītivarastātubālikā || 1 || raktavarṇaḥhāragraiveyakāṃcīgaṇigaṇavalayainsaṃyutāmaṃbarāḍhyāmādyāṃ pāśāṃkuśābhyāmabhayavarakarāṃ bhāvayedbhauvaneśīm || || 1 || raktavarṇaḥpāśāhīṃdrāṃkuśagadākhaḍgaśūlavarābhayānraktāmaṣṭabhujāṃvaṃde phullapadmāsanāṃśubhām || raktavarṇaḥtriśūlaṃpānapātraṃ ca gadāṃ jihvāṃ ca vibhratīmpītāṃbarāṃmadāghūrṇāṃ dhyāyedbrahmāstradevatām || 2 || pītavarṇaḥbibhrāṇāsṛkkapālaṃ trinayanalasitāpīnavakṣoruhāḍhyā devībālārkavarṇā bhavatu sukhakarīprāṇaśaktiḥ parānaḥ || 1 || raktavarṇaḥcinmudrā'bhīti hastā ca śuddhavidyā sadāvatu || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥnānāvarṇamayenarāsthilulitesu vyaktamālādhare śrīvidyetvarite mahārtha mahite śrīśāṃkaritvāṃbhaje || 1 || citravarṇaḥsatatābhayavarahastāṃkalaye kāmapi kalādharāmaṃbām || 1 || raktavarṇaḥbibhrāṇāṃśaśikhaṃḍaśobhimakuṭāṃ ratnāṃbarālaṃkṛtāṃvaṃdetāṃ vanaśaṃkarīṃtrinayanāṃ vāgīśaviṣṇustutām || 1 || raktavarṇaḥvarṣābhāvavaśāddhatānmunigaṇāñśākena yā rakṣatātrailokyā jananīṃ maheśadayitāṃtāṃstaumiśākaṃbharīm || 1 || raktavarṇaḥtatrotpannāṃsurāṃ devīṃ kanyakārūpadhāriṇīmśaṃkhaṃ khaḍgaṃdhanuścaiva kapālaṃmusalaṃ tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: cakraṃmuṣṭiṃśaraṃ śūlaṃlohaṃ kheṭaṃ ca tomaramtriṇetrāṃdīrghatanvaṃgīṃ kālāgnisadṛśīṃ bhajetgomūtrakṣīravarṇābhāṃ kṛṣṇarūpāṃparāṃsurāmyā surāsāhyumādevī yomohassamaheśvaraḥ || 1 ||) citravarṇaḥmuktāvidyutpayodasphaṭikanavajapābaṃdhuraiḥ paṃcavaktrairūpakṣairvakṣojana mrāṃsakalaśaśinibhāṃ śāradāṃtāṃ namāmi || 1 || śubhravarṇaḥardhendumaulimaruṇāmaraviṃdavāsāṃ varṇeśvarīṃ praṇamatastanabhāra namrām || 1 || aruṇavarṇaḥraktakaṃjaśiromālāṃ caṃdrarekhāvataṃsakāmpāśekṣucāpamabhayaṃ kapālaṃpustakaṃ tathādhārayaṃtīṃ dvādaśārddhadevīṃ tāṃ praṇamāmyaham || raktavarṇaḥnidrānimīladbhuvanātiraskariṇikāvatu || 1 || nīlavarṇaḥdevī nityaṃprasannāśaśadharavilasatkeśapāśātriṇetrā dadyādadyānavadyā sakalasukhakulaprāpti hṛdyāṃśriyaṃnaḥ || 1 || raktavarṇaḥvāmahaste vajradharāṃ dakṣiṇenavarapradāmprasannavadanāṃbhojāmapsarogaṇasevitām || 2 || pītavarṇaḥdevīṃ divyarasānnapūrṇakalaśāmaṃbhojadarvīkarāṃ dhyāyecchaṃkaravallabhāṃ trinayanāmabhrālakāṃsundarīm || 1 || aruṇavarṇaḥnikhilavibudhavṛṃdāvaṃdyapādāraviṃdāhyati śayitamaraṃdāmodamādyanmi lindāvikacakamalamālā yogisaṃgītaśīlāvasaturuciralīlācaṃdrikānaṃdabālādhyāyecca varadāṃdevīṃ caṃdirāṃparameśvarīm || 3 || svarṇavarṇaḥprasannāṃ padmakalhāravarābhayacaturbhujāmdhvalāṃśukasaṃyuktāṃ padmāsananiṣeduṣīm || 2 || śyāmavarṇaḥkumārīṃraktavastrāṃgīṃ raktasraganulepanāmpadmākṣamālāvalayaṃ vibhratīṃdakṣiṇekareabhayaṃvāmamaste ca padmapīṭhe pratiṣṭitāmrasāyanāṃ ca bṛhatīṃgārhapatye pratiṣṭhitām || 4 || raktavarṇaḥyuvatīṃśvetavastrāḍhyāṃ śuklasraganulepanāmrudrākṣamālāvalayaṃ bibhratīṃdakṣiṇekare
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāmekare'bhayaṃ devīṃ tathaivārdhendudhāriṇīmmādhyaṃdinākhyasavanesatīṃgovṛṣavāhanāmdakṣiṇāgni svarūpāṃtāṃ dhyāyennityaṃviśuddhadhīḥ || 2 || śuklavarṇaḥsthavirendīvaraśyāmāṃ nīlakuṃcitamūrdhajāmśaṃkhaṃcakraṃgadāṃ caiva tathaivābhayadaṃpunaḥtṛtīyasavanākhyāṃ ca dhyāyedvai viṣṇurūpiṇīmvaradāṃgaruḍārūḍhāmāhavanīye vyavasthitām || 4 || śyāmavarṇaḥraktāgīṃpīnatuṃgastanabharavilasattārahārāṃtriṇetrāṃ vaṃde pūrṇendubibapratinidhivadanāmaṃbikāmannapūrṇām || 1 || raktavarṇaḥnānālaṃkārayuktāṃsarasijanayanāmiṃdusaṃkrāṃtamūrtiṃdevīṃ pāśāṃkuśāḍhyāmabhayavarakarāmannapūrṇāṃ namāmi || 1 || sindūravarṇaḥhastaiścakravarāsikheṭaviśiravāṃścāpāṃkuśau tarjanīṃbibhrāṇāmana lātmikāṃ śaśidharāṃdurgāṃtriṇetrāṃbhaje || 1 || kanakavarṇaḥmārjanīkalaśopetāṃśūrpālaṃkṛtamastakām || 1 || kṛṣṇavarṇaḥpāśāṃkuśauśaraṃcāpaṃdhārayaṃtīṃ trilocanām | sūryābhāṃ caṃdracūḍāṃcalopāmudrāṃbhajeśivām || 1 || siṃdūravarṇaḥdivyarūpāṃbujakarāsarvābharaṇabhūṣitā || 1 || hemavarṇaḥpṛthakcaturbhujākāryā devīsiṃhāsaneśubhāaṣṭapatraṃ mahābhāgākarṇikāyāṃsu saṃsthitābṛhannālaṃkarekāryaṃtasyāścakamalaṃ śubhamvāme'mṛtaghaṭaḥkāryastathā rājanmanoharaḥāvarjitakaraṃkāryaṃ tatpṛṣṭe kuṃjaradvayamdevyāśca mastake kāryaṃpadmaṃcāpimanoharam || svarṇavarṇaḥlakṣmīvatsā tadā kāryā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāvāmordhve kheṭakaṃ caiva śrīphalaṃtadadhaḥkarevibhratīmastakeliṃgaṃpūjanīyā vibhūtaye || svarṇavarṇaḥpadmāsanasthāṃ kurvīta śriyaṃtrailokyamātaram || 1 || hemavarṇaḥūrdhvapadmadvayauhastau tathā padmāsane sthitā || 1 || svarṇavarṇaḥdakṣiṇetvabhayaṃ bityuttare varadaṃ tathā || ūrūpadmadalākārauvīra śrīmurtilakṣaṇam || 1 || hemavarṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: svataṃtraḥ paśumānmaṃtrī viṣkaṃbhe jāyate naraḥgurudevādibhaktaśca prītiyogodbhavonaraḥāyuṣmadyogasaṃjātaḥ kīrtimānpaṃḍitassukhīsaubhāgyayogasaṃjāto dhanīsyāt paradeśagaḥsukopīśobhaneyoge jātobuddhipriyodṛḍhaḥpareṃgitajñomānīsyādatigaṃḍodbhavonaraḥpuṇyakarmaratoyoge sukarmākhye tu jāyatedhṛtiyogodbhavodhīro bahuvittonnataśśaṭhaḥbadhirotitarāṃkāmī dhanīmānī dṛḍhaḥ prabhuḥkunakhīśrutagobhoktā dhanīgaṃḍodbhavaḥ pumānbahuputrakalatrāḍhyastridoṣīvṛddhiyogajaḥkṣamīcanirdhanomānīdhruvayogodbhavonaraḥvyāghātayogasaṃjātaḥ putradārādhikoguṇīpareṃgitajñodhanavānharṣaṇe jāyate naraḥajayyaḥ vittavāñchrīmānvajrayogodbhavo naraḥśrīmāndhīmānprajāvāṃśca siddhiyogodbhavonaraḥvyatīpāte narojātastejasvīśītalaḥ priyaḥpittātmāvittasaṃpanno varyānyogekalatravānvācācalaśca bhīruśca śrīmānparighayogajaḥdhanavānparivārāḍhyaḥ śivayogodbhavonaraḥtridoṣātmādhanībhoktā siddhayoge tu paṃḍitaḥdhānyavānromaśākārassādhyayoge tu paṃḍitaḥśubhayogebhaviṣyajjñaḥ śleṣmalodhanadhānyavānśuklayoge tu saṃjāto vātaśleṣmātmako naraḥbrahmayogodbhavaśśreṣṭhaḥ kāṃtaśca dhanadhānyavān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vātātmākṣiprakopī ca śrīmānmāheṃdrayogajaḥsatyavāndhanavāntyāgī vaidhṛtau vikaṭekṣaṇaḥ || 1iṃdratoyāhivahnyarka bhūmarudbhagatoyapāḥsāvitrīkamalāgaurī nāsatyaupitaroditiḥviṣkaṃbhādikayogānāmadhi devavarā amīdaṃḍapāśadharaṃvaṃde dakṣiṇāśāpatiṃ vibhumnīlavarṇaḥśaṃkhacakragadāpāṇiṃ vaṃde sarvārthasiddhaye(caturviṃśatimṛrttisthaviṣṇuvat 2 ni0)lakṣmīsahodaraṃvaṃde kṣīrasāgaranaṃdanamśvetavarṇaḥ || (navagrahacaṃdravat 5 nio)akṣasrakkuṃḍikāpāṇi dhyāye tvāṃpāhimāṃ prabhopāṭalavarṇaḥ || (bṛhaspatipratyadhidevatāvat 5ni0)jīvamāṃpāhi satatamanayā pūjayā prabhokanakavarṇaḥ || (navagrahasthaguruvat 5 ni0)ūrdhvakeśaṃ virūpākṣamatigaṃḍeśvaraṃ bhajenīlavarṇaḥ || (dikpālanir-ṛtivat 4 ni0)śacīnāthanamastubhyaṃ pāhimāṃ svarṇanāyakakanakavarṇaḥ || (lokapāleṃdravat 4 ni0)prāṇadāḥ sarvalokasya pāṃtumāṃ viṣṇusaṃbhavāḥśvetavarṇāḥ || (paṃcabhūtāsthābdevatāvat 4 ni0)namaskurmassadāśāṃtiṃ prayacchaṃ tu phaṇābhṛtaḥśvetavarṇaḥ || (rāhvadhidevatāsarpavat 4 ni0)meghavāhanamārūḍhaṃ dhyāyet sarvārthasiddhayelohitavarṇaḥ || (paṃcabhūtasthavahnivat 4 ni0)
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: padmāsanasthaṃ deveśaṃ vaṃde jyotirgaṇeśvaramsiṃdūravarṇaḥ || (navagrahasthārkkavat 5 ni0)bhūmidevīmahaṃvaṃde mahiṣīṃ śārṅgadhanvanaḥśvetavarṇā || (paṃcabhūtasthabhūmivat 4 nio)vyāghātanāthaṃ marutaṃ mṛgārūḍhamahaṃbhajedhūmravarṇaḥsaṃpujayiṣye saṃtuṣṭassamebhīṣṭaṃ prayacchaturaktavarṇaḥ || (uttarānakṣatradevatāvat 5 ni0)nakravāhanamārūḍhaṃ pāśapātramapāṃpatimkanakavarṇaḥekadaṃtaṃ śūrpakarṇaṃ laṃbodaramaharniśamsiṃdūravarṇaḥtriṇetraṃtripurārātiṃ taṃ vaṃde pārvatīpatimraktavarṇaḥ || (ekādaśarudravat ni0 3)dhanadhānyābhivṛddhyarthaṃ devaṃ vai śravaṇaṃ vibhumvṛtrāsuraprabhṛtayoyatsutāstaṃ sadāmudāpāṭalavarṇaḥ || (viśvakarmabrahmavat 4 ni0)vaṃde devagaṇaśreṣṭhaṃ samebhīṣṭaṃ prayacchaturaktavarṇaḥ || (anūrādhānakṣatradevatāvat 5 ni0)pārvatīnaṃdanaṃdevaṃ devasenādhipaṃ guhampāṭalavarṇaḥ || aṃgārakapratyadhidevatāvat ni0 5)saptakoṭimahāmaṃtra śreṣṭhāṃvaṃde surārcitāmśvetavarṇā || (mādhyāhnikasāvitrīvat ni0 5 )vaṃderamāṃpadmamukhīṃ viṣṇuvakṣasthalālayāmkanakavarṇā || (viṣṇupatnīlakṣmīvat ni0 2)
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: girirājasutāṃgaurīṃ padamābhayakarānvitāmmarakatavarṇāvaṃdetau devabhiṣajaupustu(sta)kauṣadhipāṇikauśvetavarṇaupitṝnpiṃḍābhayakarānputrāyuśśrīpradānnṛṇāmdhūmravarṇāḥddibhujāṃpadmahastāṃtāmāyurārogyavṛddhayeraktavarṇā || 1atha ca catuṣpānnāgavakiṃstughnākhyānikaraṇānitapasvisaṃghasaṃsevyaṃ karaṇaṃpraṇamāmyahamdhātuvādavaṇigyānakarmasarvaṃbavehitam(dānam) - bavepāyasadānaṃsyātnetratrayojjvalamukhaṃ namāmi balavṛddhidamnṛpābhiṣekasaṃgrāma kramasidhyati bālave(dānam) - śayyādānaṃcabālavenamāmimokṣadātāraṃ vedāṃtapratipāditambālavoktākhilaṃkarma kaulave sidhyati dhruvam(dānam) - kaulavegorasāndadyātsarvagīrvāṇajaṃ vande putrapautrābhi vṛddhayetaṭākakūpakhananaṃ kāryaṃtaitulasaṃjñake(dānam) - tilāṃstaitulanāmanivāmāṃganityasaṃviṣṭahimādritanayojjvalamvāstukarmapraveśaṃ ca garaje tu vidhīyate(dānam) - garābhidhānelavaṇampramadāvrataparyaṃkaṃ śūlojjvalakarāṃbujam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: uktānuktākhilaṃkarma vaṇijesidhyati dhruvam(dānam) - vaṇijedeyamaṃbaramrudrākṣamālikodbhāsikaṃ dharaḥśubhavardhanaḥanalaśatasahasraṃcodgiraṃtīsamaṃtātpatatibhuvanamadhyekāryanāśāyaviṣṭiḥbhujaṃgamo mukhebhīmo na tu pucchedvidhocyateturaṃgamahiṣokṣādi karmaviṣṭyāṃ tu sidhyatiśubhakarmāṇisarvāṇi bhadrāyāṃ samudīrayetnābhau catasraḥ kaṭyāṃ ṣaṭpucchetisraśca nāḍikāḥ || 1 || - ||kaṭyāṃbuddhipradānābhau cyutiḥpucche dhruvojayākramāgatā tu yā viṣṭiḥ saivahālāhalopamā || 2 || - ||(dānam) - viṣṭaucaṣaṣṭikānnāniārogyadaṃpraṇamatāṃ jaṭāmaṃḍalamaṃḍitamdevatāpūjanaṃ caiva śakunau tu praśasyate(dānam) - śakunausarpirevacaamarastutyapādābjayugalāyanamonayaḥtarpaṇaṃ devatānāṃ ca catuṣpadi vidhīyate(dānam) - madhudānaṃcatuṣpadridhyāyetsamastasiddhyarthamuttuṃgavṛṣavāhanamvedhastu vaṃcanaṃ krūraṃ nāgavecātraśasyate(dānam) - dānaṃnāgecavāsasāmbhasmoddhūlita dehāya vedāṃta kṛtaśarmaṇeśobhanaṃśubhakarmāṇi kiṃstughne tu praśasyate || 1 || - ||(dānam) - dānaṃpriyaṃgoḥkiṃstughne || 1vakrāṃgo nṛpapūjyaśca bavajātodhanādhipaḥgobhūmivittabhṛtyāḍhyo nīcakṛtyo mahodyamaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mātāpitrorvidheyaśca daiṣṭikaḥ kaulavodbhavaḥtaitulekaraṇejāto mṛduvākpāṭhakaḥ sukhīgarajekaraṇejāto jitaśatrurjanapriyaḥguptakṛtyoti muṃḍaśca vaṇije karaṇe nṛpaḥsvataṃtraḥ karaṇe viṣṭyāṃ jātolubdhastu caṃcalaḥśakunau paritoṣī ca gobhūmiparivārakaḥnānāciṃtā kulorogī kāṃtaḥsyāccacatuṣpadivikaṭāṃgo guṇīmānī nāge jātolpabhugbhavetkiṃstughne karaṇe jāto bhogītyāgī naraḥ sukhī || 1mitrākhyaḥ pitarobhūmiḥ śrīrviṣṇuśca yamastathāmāṇibhadrodaṃdaśūkovāyurekādaśasmṛtāḥvajrāṃkuśābhītikaraṃ naumīṃdrāṇī manoharamkanakavarṇaḥ || (lokapāleṃdravat ni0 4 )akṣasruksruvakuṃḍāḍhyaṃ vaṃdemāṃpātusonvahampāṭalavarṇaḥgadāvaradahastaṃ ca vaṃdehaṃ divaseśvaramraktavarṇaḥsaṃtuṣṭāḥ pitaromahyaṃ bhaveyurvāñchitārthadāḥnīlavarṇaḥ || (maghānakṣatradevatāvat ni0 5)namasyāmi sadāsāmāṃ rakṣatācchūbhakārikāśvetavarṇā || (paṃcabhūtasthabhūmivat ni0 4)śaṃkhacakravarābhīti pāṇiṃseṣṭaṃprayacchatukanakavarṇādaṃḍapāśadharaṃvaṃde dakṣiṇāśāpatiṃ vibhumnīlavarṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śaṃkhacakragadāśārṅga dhāriṇaṃ naumisarvadānīlameghavarṇaḥyakṣeśvarasya sainyeśaṃsamebhīṣṭaṃ prayacchatunīlavarṇaḥvaṃdetānāyurārogyaputrapautrābhi vṛddhayeśubhravarṇaḥ || (aṣṭanāgasthaśeṣavat ni0 4)khaḍgacarmadharānvaṃde vāñchitārthāndiśaṃ tu medhūmravarṇaḥ || 1kapālapāśāṃkuśalāṃgalāḍhyahastaṃ sadālokabhayaṃkaraṃ cabhūṣaṇairāyasaireva bhūṣitāṃbhīmarūpiṇīmsaṃyuktāmaṣṭabhirhastaiḥ khaḍgaśūlagadāmiṣāmdhārayaṃtīṃ mahākāyāṃ mūrtiṃ kṛttvā vibhīṣaṇāmevaṃvidhasvarūpaṃ vai kṛtvā pātre nyaset tataḥ(dvitīyaghaṭikādevatāyamaḥ) || (tṛtīyaghaṭikādevatā agniḥ) || (turīyaghaṭikādevatāmṛtyuḥ)pāśakhaḍgāṃkuśagadāpāṇirmṛtyuḥsadāvatunīlavarṇaḥdivijajanasusevyaṃ śuklavarṇaṃ mahaujastadamṛtaśubhadaivaṃ sarvadābhāvayāmiśuklavarṇampaṃcāsyaḥpṛthudaṃṣṭrobhallakaraḥkharavahogulikaḥnīlavarṇaḥsarvāriṣṭakaroraudro bhūyobhūyostu me hṛdikṛṣṇavarṇaḥśubhamāṃjiṣṭhavasano nīlavarṇavibhūṣitaḥpātraṃprathamahaste tu dvitīye loṣṭha bhedanampaṃcame śṛṃkhalāṃhaste ṣaṣṭhe kavacameva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: navame caiva kuddālaṃ śrṛṃgikāmādimottarecaturthekārmukaṃ pāṇau paṃcamekartrikāmapiaṣṭame ca dhvajaṃ haste navamakukkuṭaṃśayenīlavarṇaḥśastrānvitobhuvipatanvinirīkṣyamāṇaḥ kāryāṃtakānvitanutevyatipātayogaḥraktavarṇaḥvaiprapātamidaṃrūpaṃ sadyomaraṇakāraṇamnīlavarṇaḥjanmarkṣaṃkrūrarūpaṃ karadhṛtakalaśaṃ prasphurallolajihvaṃ dīptākṣaṃtāmravarṇaṃ jvaladurudaśanodagradaṃṣṭrākarālamyuktaṃbhaumārkabhedairasakṛdapivarābhītimālāvahaṃtaṃ pūjāmaṃtraistu dānairdvijavaravacanaiḥ prītidaṃ bhāvayāmiraktavarṇaḥbhānumaddaivataḥ prokto dvitīyaḥ parivatsaraḥanuvatsarakaścaiva prājāpatyaḥ samīritaḥyugaṃ taiḥ paṃcabhirvaṛṣaiḥ ṣaṣṭi dvādaśabhiryugaiḥ || 3ahirbudhnyaśca pitaro viśvedevā niśākaraḥpuruhūtānalaudasraubhagaścaite kramātsmṛtāḥsaṃvatsaraparivatsaramiticedāvatsaraścaivaanuvatsaraśca tasmātparataścedvatsaroṃnteyaḥsauraṃ ca sāyanaṃ cāṃdramārkṣaṃ mānāni vai nava || 1tatomakarasaṃkrāṃte ravessyāduttarāyaṇam || 1surāsurāṇāmanyonya mahorātraṃ viparyayāt || 1triṃśatātithibhirmāsaścāṃdraḥpitryamahaḥ smṛtam || 1manvaṃtaravyavasthācaprājāpatyamudāhṛtamprakārāṃtareṇa kārtikādīnivarṣāṇiguruyuktodayāstataḥ || 1saurastusaṃkrāṃtivaśāddinasya
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nākṣatramiṃdorbhagaṇabhramāccatriṃśaddinaṃsāvanamāsaḥādyadinādamāṃtaṃkhalucāṃdramāhuḥ || 1tattanmāsairdvādaśabhistattadabdo bhaveddhruvamayane viṣuve caiva saṃkrāṃteḥ puṇyakālatāvratopavāsayātrādi kriyācāṃdreṇa gṛhyatesāvanānisyuretāni yajñakālavidhistutaiḥsūtakādiparicchedo dinamāsābdapāstathāraktākṣaṃ kuṃcitapadaṃ meṣaṃ hṛdivibhāvayeraktavarṇaḥkakudvirājamānāṃsaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ hṛdibhāvayaśvetavarṇaḥanyonyā śliṣṭahastābjaṃ mithunaṃ hṛdibhāvayekukṣivinyastavadanaṃ dhyāyāmihṛdikarkaṭampāṭalavarṇaḥdīrghalāṃgūlasaṃyuktaṃ siṃhaṃ hṛdivibhāvayedhūmrapāṃḍaravarṇaḥpūrṇacaṃdramukhīṃkāṃtāṃ kanyāṃ hṛdivibhāvayecitravarṇātuletināmnavikhyatāṃ saṃkhyārūpāmupāsmahekṛṣṇavarṇāātolyamānapucchāgraṃ vṛścikaṃ hṛdibhāvayekanakavarṇaḥāropitograbāṇāgraṃ dhanurhṛdivibhāvayepiṃgalavarṇam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jalajaṃ tu pratibhayaṃ makaraṃ hṛdibhāvayekarburavarṇaḥvainateyajavānītaṃ kuṃbhaṃ hṛdivibhāvayedhūmravarṇaḥmamābhīṣṭasyasiddhyarthaṃ mīnaṃhṛdivibhāvayeśvetavarṇaḥ || 1dāruṇaṃsāhasorājñāṃ meṣalagne praśasyatekṣetrāraṃbhaṇamakhilaṃ bhūṣaṇaśilpādikaṃ vṛṣabheadhikaṃ māhiṣameṣakṣitipatisevādikaṃ mithunepauṣṭikaṃkarmayatkiṃcit sarvaṃsidhyatikarkiṇidhātvākarādimeṣoktaṃ kuryāt siṃhodaye sadāudvāhaśāṃtipauṣṭikagajaturagoṣṭrādikanyāyāmprasidhyaṃti ca sarvāṇi tulābhāṃḍāśritāni cacauryakṛtyaṃ sthirāraṃbhaṃ kartavyaṃ vṛścikodayevastrāstrakṛṣivāṇijyaṃ kartavyaṃ kārmukodayenārīcatuṣpādādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ syān mṛgodayesthirabhūṣaṇavāstvādyaṃ kartavyaṃ ca ghaṭodayerathaturagoṣṭrapaśūnāṃkāryaṃ mīnodayeśreṣṭham || 1taulīsasasya dahanāplavagā ca kanyāśeṣāssvanāmasadṛśāḥ khacarāśca sarve || 1raudraḥparaśuṃsamudyataṃ dhatteraktavilocanaḥ pumānpuruṣaḥ | kṛṣṇavarṇaḥcaraikapādena ca meṣamadhyadrekkāṇarūpaṃ yavanopadiṣṭamstrī | raktavarṇāraktānivastrāṇibibharti caṃḍomeṣetṛtīyaḥ kathitastribhāgaḥpumān | kapilavarṇaḥ || 3
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pāśāṃkuśākṣasūtravarābhayagadāpadmapātrahastākāryā || 1 || hemavarṇaḥbījāpūraṃ kanakakalaśaṃ hemapadmaṃdadhānāmādyāṃ śaktiṃ sakalajananīṃ viṣṇuvāmāṃkasaṃsthām || 1 || svarṇavarṇaḥsarasvatīsitāraktā prītiḥ śyāmanibhākṛtiḥtuṣṭiḥ pītābhavetpuṣṭiśśyāmā devyastutāḥsmṛtāḥpadmadvayakarāścaiva varābhayakarāstutāḥpāṇibhyāmaṇipūrṇaratnacaṣakaṃ raktotpalaṃbibhratīṃ saumyāṃratnanidhistha savyacaraṇāṃdhyāyet parāmaṃbikām || 1 || sindūravarṇaḥmuktāhāralasatpayodharanatāṃ netratrayollāsinīṃ vaṃdehaṃsurapūjitāṃharavadhūṃ raktāraviṃdasthitām || 1 || nīlavarṇaḥbījāpūreṣupāśāṃkuśamusaladhanussrakkapālānihastairbibhrāṇāmāna- tāṃgīṃ stanabharanamitāmaṃbikāmānamāmi || 1 || raktavarṇaḥdīpaukaṃbuṃrathāṃgaṃkarasarasiruhairdhārayaṃtī jaṭāṃtassphūrjacchītāṃśukhaṃḍābhavatu bhayaharādevatā ca triṇetrā || 1 || citravarṇaḥraktāṃgarāgavasanābharaṇāṃtriṇetrāṃ dhyāyecchivasya vanitāṃmada vihvalāṃgīm || 1 || raktavarṇaḥsiṃhaskaṃdhādhirūḍhāṃ tribhuvanamakhilaṃ tejasāpūrayaṃtīṃ dhyāyeddurgāṃ jayākhyāṃtridaśaparivṛtāṃsevitāṃ siddhikāmaiḥ || 1 || kṛṣṇavarṇaḥgraiveyāṃgadahārakuṇḍaladharāmākhaṃḍalādyaistutāṃ dhyāyedviṃdhya nivāsinīṃ śaśimukhīṃpārśvastha paṃcānanām || 1 || kanakavarṇaḥtarjanīṃtriśikhaṃdorbhyāṃdhārayaṃtīṃ bhayaṃkarīm || raktāṃdhyātvāravairbiṃbe prajapedayutaṃ manummārayedacirādevaripūnbaṃdhusamanvitān || raktavarṇaḥhastābjairdadhatīṃtriṇetravilasadvaktrāraviṃdaśriyaṃ devīṃ baddhahimāṃśuratnamakuṭāṃvaṃderaviṃdasthatām || 1 || raktavarṇaḥśrīpustakaṃ japavaṭīmamṛtāḍhyakuṃbhaṃ vyākhyāṃ ca hastakamalair- dadhatīṃtriṇetrām || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥnetrotpalaistribhiralaṃkṛtapadmavaktrāṃtvāṃhārabhārarucirāṃ tripurebhajaṃti || 1 || raktavarṇaḥhastairvahaṃtīmaruṇāṃtriṇetrāmāsphālayaṃtīṃkaravallakīṃtām || 1 || raktavarṇaḥtāṭaṃkāṃgadamekhalāṃguṇaraṇanmaṃjīrabhābhūṣitāṃkairātīṃ varadābhayodyatakarāṃdevīṃtriṇetrāṃbhaje || 1 || śyāmavarṇaḥlaṃboṣṭhīkarṇikākarṇītailābhyaktaśarīriṇīvardhanmūrdhadhvajā kṛṣṇākālarātrirbhayaṃkarī || 2 || kṛṣṇavarṇaḥjaṭāmakuṭa saṃyuktāratnakuṃḍalamaṃḍitādukūlavasanādevī netratrayasamanvitādakṣiṇecākṣamālāṃ ca kuṃḍikāṃ vāmahastakevāgīśyākṛtirākhyatā || śvetavarṇaḥ

sanskrit: ābharaṇānyabhivāṃchatigaurīrūpamidaṃ prathamaṃ vṛṣabhasyastrī | gauravavarṇāskaṃdhamudvahati gopatitulyaṃkṣutparo'javadano malavāsāḥpuruṣaḥ | śvetavarṇaḥavimṛgalomāvyākulacitto vṛṣabhavarasya prāṃtagatoyaḥpuruṣaḥ | kanakavarṇaḥ || 3hīnātmajā ṛtumatīmṛdudīrghabāhurādyaṃ tṛtīyabhavanasya vadaṃtitajjñāḥstrī || haridvarṇākrīḍātmajālaṃkaraṇāttacittaṃkaroti madhyemithunasyacāyampuruṣaḥ | haridvarṇaḥnṛttavādanakalāsucavidvānkāvyakṛnmithunarāśyavasānepuruṣaḥ | haridvarṇaḥkroḍatulyavadanohayakarṇaḥkarkaṭeprathamarūpamuśaṃtipuruṣaḥ || pāṭalavarṇaḥśākhāṃpalāśasyasamāśritā ca madhyasthitā karkaṭakākhyarāśeḥstrī || pāṭalavarṇāhaimaiśca yutovibhūṣaṇaiścipiṭāsyoṃtya gataśca karkaṭepuruṣaḥ | pātalavarṇaḥ || 3rautimātṛpitṛviprayogatassiṃharūpamidamādyamucyatepuruṣaḥ | dhūmrapāṃḍuvarṇaḥdurāsadassiṃha ivāttakārmukonatāgranāsomṛgarājamadhyaḥpuruṣaḥ | dhūmrapāṃḍuvarṇaḥkūrcimanuṣyaḥ kuṭilaiścakeśairmṛgeśvarasyāṃtyagatatribhāgaḥpuruṣaḥ | dhūmrapāṃḍuvarṇaḥ || 3vastrārthasaṃyogamabhīpsamānāguroḥ kulaṃgacchatikanyakādyā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: strī | citravarṇāvipulaṃ ca bibhartikārmukaṃ romavyāptatanuśca madhyamaḥpuruṣaḥ | śyāmavarṇaḥdevālayaṃ strīprayatāpravṛttāvadaṃti kanyāṃtyagata tribhāgamkanakavarṇaḥ || 3bhāṃḍaṃviciṃtayati tasya ca mūlyametadrūpaṃ vadaṃti yavanāḥ prathamaṃ tulāyāḥpuruṣaḥ | kṛṣṇavarṇaḥkṣudhitastuṣitaśca kalatrasutānmanasaiti tulādharamadhyagataḥpuruṣaḥ | kṛṣṇavarṇaḥdhanurdharovānararūpabhṛnnarastulāvasāne yavanairudāhṛtahpuruṣaḥ | kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ || 3sthānacyutāsarpanibaddhapādāmanoramā vṛścikarāśipūrvāstrī | svarṇavarṇākacchapakuṃbhasamānaśarīrāvṛścikamadhyamarūpamuśaṃtistrī | svarṇavarṇāavati ca malayākarapradeśaṃ mṛgapatiraṃtyagataśca vṛścikasyapuruṣaḥ | svarṇavarṇaḥkratūpayuktānitapasvinaścara rakṣapūrvodhanuṣastribhāgaḥpuruṣaḥ | piṃgalavarṇaḥsamudraratnānivighaṭṭayaṃtīmadhyastribhāgodhanuṣaḥpradiṣṭaḥstrī | kanakavarṇaḥkauśeyakānyudvahate'jinaṃ ca tṛtīyarūpaṃ dhanuṣaśca rāśeḥpuruṣaḥ | kanakavarṇaḥ || 3yotrakajālakabaṃdhanadhārīraudramukhomakaraprathamaścapuruṣaḥ | karburavarṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vibhūṣaṇālaṃkṛtalohakarṇāyoṣāpradiṣṭāmakarasyamadhyestrī | śyāmavarṇākuṃbhamudvahatiratnacitritaṃskaṃdhagaṃ makararāśipaścimaḥpuruṣaḥ || karburavarṇaḥ || 3kośakāravasano'jināvṛtogṛdhratulyavadanoghaṭādikaḥpuruṣaḥ | babhruvarṇaḥmalinenapaṭenasaṃvṛtābhāṃḍairmūrdhagataissamadhyamaḥstrī | babhruvarṇābhāṃḍānilohavyatimiśritānisaṃcārayatyaṃtya gatoghaṭasyapuruṣaḥ | śyāmavarṇaḥ || 3bhāryāvibhūṣārthamapāṃnidhānenāvaṃplavatyādigatojhaṣasyapuruṣaḥ | śvetavarṇaḥvarṇenacaṃpakanibhā pramadātribhāgo mīnasya caiva kathito munibhirdvitīyaḥstrī | kanakavarṇācorānalavyākulitāṃtarātmāvikrośate cāṃtyagatojhaṣasyapuruṣaḥ | śvetavarṇaḥ || 3ākaṃṭhapādāṃtakacodvibhujo dīrghagodhikaḥbhrūmaṃḍalālakopetaḥ kṛṣṇaśubhrāṃśukānvitaḥiṣṭāpūrtasya sidhyarthaṃ pūjanīyo manīṣibhiḥkanakavarṇaḥśvetavastradharaṃ devaṃ jaṭāvalkaladhāriṇampadmavaktraṃ śuklavarṇaṃ divārūpaṃ vibhāvayet(divādhidevatāsūryaḥ prasidhaḥ navagrahasthasūryavat ni0 5 )rājābhiṣekamannādyaṃ vidyāraṃbhopanāyanampāśāṃkuśadhanurbāṇa dharāṃcaṃdranibhānanām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: (taddevatācaṃdraḥ prasiddhaḥ navagrahasthacaṃdravat ni0 5)garbhāntarādhānabaligrahārcāḥ kuṃbhapratiṣṭhā hyabhicārakarmarākṣasī cārdharātre syādbrāhmīmadhyāhna ucyate || 1āhāraṃ maithunaṃ nidrāṃ svādhyāyaṃ caiva nityaśaḥnidrātojāyate'lakṣmīḥ svādhyāyādāyuṣaḥ kṣayaḥśvetāruṇābhāṃ yuvatiṃ nānābharaṇabhūṣitāmpāṭalavarṇākuṃkumāruṇavarṇābhāmunnasāṃcitrabhūṣaṇāmsiṃdūravarṇāpāśahastāliromāṇaṃ namāmiśirasāvibhumkṛṣṇavarṇaḥśūlaṃcaḍamṛgaṃpāṇau bibhrāṇaṃ hṛdibhāvayeraktavarṇaḥgīrvāṇagaṇavaṃdyāṃghriṃ mṛtyuṃ mahiṣavāhanamnīlavarṇaḥjvalatpāvakakeśāṃtāṃ nīlameghasamaprabhāmdaṃṣṭrākarālavadanāṃ mahiṣoparisaṃsthitāmkheṭakā'gnyabhayāhīṃdrāndakṣavāmakrameṇa hikuhūṃkuhūviṣodbhūtarūpiṇīṃ praṇamāmyahamnīlavarṇājihvayāraktayādīptaṃ lelihānānijaṃmukhamnarāsthimālāṃbibhrāṇāmekhalīkṛtapannagāmdaṃḍaṃghaṃṭāṃ tathāśurpaṃ mārjanīṃ pāśakuṃḍikeadhirūḍhāṃ naraskaṃdhamaṃdhakārasamākṛtimevaṃ rūpadharāṃ kṛtyāṃ namāmi ripunāśinīm
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛṣṇavarṇādakṣiṇādhaḥ karekhaḍgaṃ dakṣordhve paraśuṃ tathābibhrāṇāṃ ca mahākṛtyāmarcayecchatrunāśinīmkṛṣṇavarṇāvarābhayāmṛtakalāmudrā amṛtakuṃḍikāmśvetavarṇāvaradābhayapāṇiṃ ca sinīvālīmahaṃbhajekṛṣṇavarṇālokābhīṣṭapradaṃdhyāye sarvāriṣṭanivṛttayekṛṣṇavarṇaḥvāmahaste tu phaṇinaṃ dakṣiṇe phaṇimudrikamśyāmavarṇaḥśvetavastro mahātuṃgo dakṣiṇe sarpamādadhatśyāmavarṇaḥśvetaśoṇābhavastroyaṃ śvetamuktāvibhūṣaṇaḥdadhānobhūtayepūjyo yogavṛddhyai sukhāya caśubhravarṇaḥdakṣiṇepaṃkajaṃnīlaṃ vāme sarpaṃ mahāphaṇamnīlameghavarṇaḥdakṣiṇe pustakaṃ haste vāme caiva triśūlakamnīlameghavarṇaḥśvetavastromecakābho mahāsattvasamanvitaḥdadhadrogavināśāya pūjanīyo hyaharniśamkṛṣṇavarṇaḥdakṣiṇe tu karedaṃḍaṃ vāme caivā bhayaṃkare
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śyāmavarṇaḥ || 1dakṣiṇe vallakīṃ pāṇau vāme śaktiṃ ca kārayetraktavarṇaḥ || 1pītavarṇoti hrasvastu tāmravastro mahodaraḥsa evakutupo - nāmavijñātavyomanīṣibhiḥpītavarṇaḥśubhravarṇoviśālākṣo nīlavaddhemakuṃḍalaḥdadhānaśśubhasaṃpattyai vijayārogyasiddhayeśubhravarṇaḥgauravarṇoruṇaśśveta vasanaśśveta kuṃḍalaḥgauravarṇaḥhemavarṇo bṛhatphālaḥ kṛṣṇaśvetāruṇāṃśukaḥdadhatprajñāsukhāptyarthaṃ pūjanīyovipaścitāmhemavarṇaḥnīlavarṇojaṭāmauliḥ pītavastro mahābalaḥnīlavarṇaḥraktavastro mahorasko ratnahemasukuṃḍalaḥraktavarṇaḥmuktāphalanibhaścaiva muktāhāravibhūṣitaḥśvetavarṇaḥnīlaśvetāruṇaprāṃtavasanonīlakuṃḍalaḥnīlavarṇaḥhṛdayasthaḥ sadābhūyādbhargobhayavināśanaḥśyāmavarṇaḥ || (ekādaśarudrasthabhargavat ni0 3)vīṇāvādanatattvajño pakṣavānaruṇaḥ smṛtah
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aruṇavarṇaḥnidhīśvaraḥ svarṇavarṇodhanadorūpavānprabhuḥsvarṇavarṇaḥ || (dikpālakuberavat ni0 4)pradakṣiṇaṃ dakṣiṇādhaḥ karādārabhya nityaśaḥdhautavarṇaḥ || (caturviṃśatimūrtisthaviṣṇuvat ni0 2)hemadaṃḍadharaḥśyāmo varṇato mohinī priyaḥśyāmavarṇaḥ || (dikpālavāyuvat || ni0 4)chāgasthaḥ sākṣasūtraśca saptārciḥ śakti dhārakaḥraktavarṇaḥ || (sūryādhidevatāvat ni0 5)ūrdhvakeśovirūpākṣaḥ karālaḥkālikā priyaḥnīlavarṇaḥ || (lokapālanir-ṛtivat ni0 4)saptāśvarathasaṃyukto dvibhujaḥ syātsadāraviḥpāṭalavarṇaḥ || (navagrahasthasūryavat ni0 5)khaḍgacarmagadāpāṇiḥ siṃhastho varado budhaḥvarābhayakaraśśuddho brahmājñeyaḥ sanātanaḥpāṭalavarṇaḥ || (rohiṇīnakṣatradevatāvat ni0 5)daṃḍinauvaradaukāryo sākṣasūtrakamaṃḍalūsvarṇavarṇaḥ || (navagrahasthaguruvat ni0 5)sahasrakarasaṃvītassamastāśāṃtarāṃtaraḥpāṭalavarṇaḥ || (dvādaśādityasthapūṣavat ni0 5)pītavāsāmaṇimayairbhūṣaṇairuttamairvṛtaḥmeghaśyāmavarṇaḥ || (caturviṃśatimūrtisthanārāyaṇavat ni0 2)hemadaṃḍadharaḥśyāmo varṇato mohinī priyaḥśyāmavarṇaḥ || (dikpālavāyuvat ni0 4)ūrdhvakeśovirūpākṣaḥ karālaḥkālikā priyaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nīlavarṇaḥ || (lokapālanir-ṛtivat ni0 4)ugrādyāstamasā yuktāḥ svānurūpaphalapradāḥtāsāṃnāmānirūpāṇi śṛṇupārvati tattvataḥ || 2śāṃtiḥkṣamājayāprajñānujñāsaumyā'bhayāvarāśuddhasphaṭikavarṇāśca jñānamudrā'bhayānvitāḥśvetavarṇāḥpiṃgalābhadrakādhanyā samṛddhirharṣaṇā dhṛtiḥratiḥpuṣṭiśca tuṣṭiśca yoginyo rajasā yutāḥraktavarṇāḥugrājyeṣṭhā tato raudrī śeṣaraudrī tataḥ parambalapūrvāvikarṇī ca balapramathinī tathāīrṣyādaṃbhāhaṃ kṛtiśca bhrāmarī saṃkaṭā tathāetāsāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye śruṇupārvati tattvataḥ || 4 || 20kapālābhayahastogrā vāmāvāmaphalapradāraktavarṇāpāṭalavarṇāraktavarṇāraktavarṇā dehe || mukhekṛṣṇavarṇākapālakartrikāhastā jñeyābhayanāśinīmeghaśyāmavarṇā dehe || mukheraktavarṇānīlavarṇāśvetavarṇābibhrāṇāśāṃtidā bhūtyai balapūrvāvikarṇikācitravarṇākapālapāśinī seyaṃ sarvaśatrubhayaṃkarī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: raktavarṇā dehe || mukheśvetavarṇākapālavajriṇīproktā sarvaśatrubhayaṃkarīraktavarṇākapālakhaḍginībhutyai śatrūṇāṃbhayavardhinīdehe nīlavarṇā || mukheraktavarṇākṛpāṇapālikāyukta karālokabhayaṃkarīśyāmavarṇākṛśodarīkare pātraṃ khaḍgaṃ dhatte vibhīṣaṇāraktavarṇākhaḍgaṃkheṭaṃdadhānā ca dīrghāṃgā kuṃcitānanādehe nīlavarṇā || mukheraktavarṇātuṃdilātuṃganāsā ca kapālamusalāṃcitādehe nīlavarṇā || mukheśvetavarṇākṛpāṇaṃkuṃḍikāṃdhatte baddhapadmāsane sthitācitravarṇāpāṭalābhonnatanasā-ṛjukāyā mahodarīpāṭalavarṇāghaṃṭādaṃḍakarākrūrā karālāsyā jaṭāvilānīlavarṇākṛṣṇaśvetacchaviśśyāmā khaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇīkṛṣṇaśvetavarṇāulmukaṃ ca karedaṃḍaṃ dadhānā lokabhīṣaṇāraktavarṇā || kaṃṭhenīlavarṇāvyomavaṃdyaikarudrākṣakacalaṃbitamālikāpūjanīyā viśeṣeṇa jñānavijñāna hetave
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śvetavarṇāaṣṭādaśabhujopetā jñānamudrā samanvitānīlavarṇāakṣasūtraṃ kare dakṣe jñānamudrāṃ tathottarekṛṣṇavarṇaḥjaṭātrimaulikopetaścaṃdanāliptavigrahaḥśubhravarṇaḥanyatrāṣṭasthalānyāhurbhārateṣṭauśataṃtathā(pradyumnaṃ) ca pramodākhye saṃmode (cāniruddhakam)kṣīrābdhau (śeṣaśayanaṃ) śvetadvīpe tu (tārakam)eteṣvaṣṭasthaleṣvevaṃ rūpaṃmāṃ viddhisusthitam(pāṃḍye 18)'ṣṭādaśa (kerale 13) bhagavataḥṣaṭsaptakaṃ (cottare 12 ) deśādvādaśapūrvasūribhiralaṃvyāsādibhiḥsannutāḥ || 1(nārāyaṇaṃ) badaryā'khye naimiśe (hari) mavyayammadhurāyāṃ (bālakṛṣṇaṃ) māyāyāṃ (madhusūdanam)aṣṭādaśasthitānkāṃcyāṃvakṣyevāraṇaparvate(yathoktakāriṇaṃ) grāme (paramaṃ) parameśakegrāmagrahābhidhe sākṣādunnattyā'ḍhyaṃ (trivikramam)(gajeṃdravarada)ñcāṣṭabhujañcāṣṭabhujasthalesthalemeghaniketākhye (meghākārasamāhvayam)vrajasthāne ca (varadaṃ) kāmakoṭyāṃ (svayaṃharim)(pravālavarṇadevaṃ) tu pravālavanasaṃjñiteśarvasthāne (mahāviṣṇu)metānaṣṭādaśaśrayebṛṃdāvane (naṃdasūnuṃ) (goviṃdaṃ) (kāliyahrade)gomaṃtaparvate (śauriṃ) haridvāre (jagatpatim)gaṃgāsāgarike (viṣṇuṃ) citrakūṭe tu (rāghavam)
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṃkuśenākṣasūtreṇa pāśapustakadhāriṇīmsitenadarpaṇābhe navastreṇaparibhūṣitāmjaṭākalāpasaṃyuktāṃpūrṇacaṃdranibhānanāmkaṭakaissvarṇaratnāḍhyairmahāvalayabhūṣitāmśabdabrahmamayīṃdhyā yeddhenuvāgīśvarīṃ parām || 5 || śvetavarṇaḥnijakarakamalodyallekhinīpustaka śrīssakalavibhavasaṃghaiḥpātuvāgdevatānaḥ || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥhemaratnojjvalannakrakuṃḍalaṃ karṇamaṃḍanamsayauvanāsuramyāṃgīkuṃcitabhrūsuvibhramāśirasomaṃḍanaṃ śaṃkhacakrasīmaṃtapadmakampaṃkajaṃ śrīphalaṃ vāmedakṣiṇebibhratīparāmekhalākaṭisūtrāṃkā lakṣmīlakṣmīvivarddhinī || 5 || padmavarṇaḥādyaṣṭakaṃsuvarṇābhaṃ triśūlaṃḍamaruṃ tathāatha dvitīyakaṃ dhyāyedakṣamālāmathāṃkuśamjvālāṃśaktiṃgadāṃkuṃtaṃ dadhānaṃnīlavarṇakamkhaḍgaṃkheṭaṃ paṭṭiśaṃ ca dadhānaṃ paraśuṃ tathākuṃtaṃkheṭaṃ ca parighaṃbhiṃḍivālaṃ tathaiva capaṃcamāṣṭakametaddhiśvetaṃ syātsumanoharampītaṃṣaṣṭhamṛṣīraktamaṣṭamaṃ ca taṭitprabhamdivyayogāmahāyogā siddhayogāmaheśvarīkaṃkālī raudravetālīhuṃkārībhuvaneśvarīphaṭkārīvīrabhadrā ca dhūmrākṣīkalahapriyākāmākṣīcogracāmuṃḍābhīṣaṇātripurāṃtakābhairavīhastinī krodhadurmukhīpretavāhinīasthinīcakriṇīgrāhākaṃkālībhuvaneśvarīśaṃkhinīpadminīkṣīrāhyasaṃdhā ca prahāriṇī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrīkūrme (kūrmarūpaṃ) canīlādrau (puruṣottamam)kṛtakośe (pāpaharaṃ) śvetādrau (siṃharūpiṇam)ahobale (hiraṇyaghnaṃ) pāṃḍuraṃge tu (viṭhṭhalam)(nārāyaṇaṃ) yādavādrauvyaṅkaṭādrau (ramāsakham) śrīmadgṛdhrasarastīrebhāṃtaṃ (vijayarāghavam)gajasthale (garjātighnaṃ) bhaktasāre (jagatpatim)(mahābalaṃ) balipuregopapuryāṃ tu (gopatim)(mahāvarāhaṃ) śrīmuṣṭe śrīrāme (jānakīpriyam)śrīraṃge (raṃganāthaṃ) tamākāśanagare (harim)śrīnivāsasthale (pūrṇaṃ) maṇikūṭe (mahāprabhum)utpalāvarttake (śaurīṃ) maṇipūryāṃ (surapriyam)śvetahrde (śāṃtamūrti) cakratīrthe (sudarśanam)kuṃbhako (gho)ṇe (śārṅgapāṇiṃ) bhūtisthāne tu (śārṅgiṇam)khaṃḍane (haraśāpaghna) (muttamā) khyamanuttamenaṃdapuryāṃ (mahānaṃdaṃ) kṛṣṇakoṭyāṃ (madhudviṣam)sārakṣetre (sāranāthaṃ) śaraṇye (śaraṇābhidham)(jagadīśaṃ) dhanuṣkoṭyāṃ madhurāyāṃ tu (suṃdaram)goṣṭhī pure (goṣṭhapatiṃ) (balāḍhyaṃ) bhramarasthalesthale tu darbhaśayane vasaṃtaṃ (darbhaśāyinam)anaṃtaśayane devaṃ (padmanābhaṃ) manoharamyassmaret satataṃbhaktayācetasānanyagāmināaṣṭottaraśataṃviṣṇossthānāni paṭhatāsvayamavagāḍhānitirthānijñātaḥ sabhagavānhariḥsaṃpāditā tathāmuktiḥ paramānaṃda dāyinī || 108śrīmuṣṭeveṃkaṭādrau ca sāligrāme ca naimiśe (ṣe)aṣṭaumemūrtayassaṃti svayaṃvyaktā mahītale
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrīhastiśailaśikharojjvalapārijātaṃ śrīśaṃ namāmi śirasāyaduśailadīpamśayyābhujaṃgātmatayāpratītaṃ (śrīsaumyajāmātṛmuniṃ) prapadyebhaktāṃghrireṇumunivāhacatuṣkavīṃdrānmādhuryakāvyatulasī- prabhavānyatīṃdrānśrīpāṃcajanyojani (divyayogī) sarobhidhānaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye(bhūtābhidhanaṃ) munimutpalāṃtācchrīmadgadāṃśaṃśaraṇaṃprapadyebhaktyāmahāṃśaṃ (mahadāhvayaṃ)taṃ śrīnaṃdakāṃśaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadyesudarśanāṃśaṃyamudārakīrtiṃtaṃ (bhaktisāraṃ) śaraṇaṃ prapadyesaudarśanīṃmūrtimupāgataṃcataṃ (bhaktisāraṃ) śaraṇaṃ prapadyesenāpateḥpadajakārigṛhevatīrṇaṃ śrīśāspadaṃ (śaṭharipuṃ) śaraṇaṃ prapadyeśrīkaustubhāṃśaṃ (kulaśekharākhyaṃ) sārakṣitīśaṃśaraṇaṃ prapadyegarutmadaṃśaṃśvaśuraṃmurāreḥ (śrīviṣṇucittaṃ) śaraṇaṃ prapadyeraṃgeśakelisukhamūrdhvaśikhaṃdvijeṃdraṃ (bhaktāṃghrireṇu) managhātmaguṇaṃ prapadyeśrīvatsāṃśakaphaṇiśāyibhaktibhājaṃpāṇākhyaṃ (varamunivāhanaṃ) prapadyeraṃgeśakaiṃkairyataraṃgitāṃśaṃ (catuṣkavīṃdraṃ) śaraṇaṃ prapadyegaṇāṃśabhājaṃ (madhuraṃkavīṃdraṃ) śaṭhāriśiṣyaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadyeudetāmudāraguṇaraṃganāyakaprivavallabhāṃ (vasumatī) mupāsmaheśrīśodaṃcaddarśanasthāpanārthaṃ prādurbhūtaṃ (bhāṣyakāraṃ) prapadyeguptaṃratnaṃ lokarakṣā nimittaṃyodātprītyāta(nmahāpūrṇe)mīḍeprajñāviśeṣanilayaṃprativāditūlajhaṃjhānilaṃ hṛdayaciṃtaya(yāmunārya)mtaṃ (rāmamiśraṃ) kumudākṣaśaktiṃ padmākṣaśiṣyaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadyehṛṣṭaṃjayatsena vipaścidaṃśaṃ (śrīpuṃḍarīkākṣa)mahaṃprapadyedīptodayaṃ divyagajānanāṃśaṃ bhaktāgragaṃ (nāthamuniṃ) prapadyepadmāmaśeṣajagatāṃ jananīṃ praṇamya śrīkāṃta(mādipuruṣaṃ) śaraṇaṃ prapadyeteṣāṃ harernityavibhutisaudhasukhāvahārohaṇamūrjitaṃ syātjñātvāvimucyetanarassamastaissaṃsārapāśairiti caiva viṣṇum

sanskrit: svareṇamaṃtreṇa sadāhṛdisthaṃ parātparaṃ yanmahato mahāṃtamavaśyaṃdhārayennityamurdhvapuṃḍraṃ suśobhanamsiṃdhutīre ca valmīke tulasīmūlasaṃśritemṛda etāstu saṃgrāhyāḥ varjāhyanyatramṛttikāḥvakṣasthalemādhavaṃ tu goviṃdaṃ kaṃṭhakūbaretrivikramaṃ skaṃdhadeśe vāmanaṃvāmapārśvakepṛṣṭhe ca padmanābhaṃ tu trikedāmodaraṃ nyasettatprakṣālanatoyena vāsudevaṃ ca mūrdhanidhārayedūrdhvapuṃdrāṇi caturaṃgulamāyatambāhvorvakṣasthale puṃḍraṃ dvādaśāṃgulamucyate || 2tattatpuṃḍreṣutanmūrtiṃ dhyātvāmaṃtreṇa dhārayetekapuṃḍra tu nārīṇāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca vidhīyate || 2lalāṭe hṛdaye dve tu phāletvekaṃ vidhīyatelalāṭādi krameṇaiva dhāraṇaṃ tu vidhīyatedve ca goviṃdakṛṣṇākhye tvekaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ dhareteṣapuṃḍravidhiḥ proktaḥ sarveṣāṃ girije mayāpadmakuṭmalasaṃkāśaṃ mohanaṃ tritayaṃ smṛtamdaṃḍākāraṃ tu vaide vidhārayedūrdhvapuṃḍrakam || 2pārśvaudvyaṃgulamātrausyādūrdhvapuṃḍrasthalakṣaṇambahiṣ.kṛtāhyabhikruddhā pāpātpracyā vayaṃtiteakṛtairvāpi sukṛtaiḥ taistaiḥ prīṇāti karmabhiḥtoṣayannūrdhvapuṃdreṇa sāyaṃsvātmagataṃharimabhiṣiktaṃ tu yaccūrṇaṃ viṣṇubiṃbe sadānaraḥsavaiṣṇavo lalāṭe tu śriyaṃ māṃ ca vyapohatiramāvṛṣākapi(?)dhanyāvṛddhirijyātatheṃdirā

sanskrit: tṛtīyaṃ kamalāproktaṃ caturthaṃśāṃtiśobhinīsaptamaṃ tu varārohā cāṣṭamaṃ harivallabhāekādaśaṃ tu lakṣmīśca dvādaśaṃsurasuṃdarītṛtīyākamalāproktā caturthī lokasuṃdarīsaptamī tu varārohā hyaṣṭamī harivallabhānavamīśārṅgiṇīproktādaśamīdevadevatāśrīcūrṇasyābhi māninyo dvādaśaitāḥ parāśśubhāḥ || 4avaiṣṇavassavijñeyo taṃ kupyati hari priyānānāratnāṃśubhinnābharaṇaśatayutaṃśrīdharāśliṣṭapārśvaṃvaṃdedossakta-cakrāṃburuhavilasitaṃ viśvavaṃdyaṃmukuṃdamnārāyaṇaṃ ghanaśyāmaṃ catuśśaṃkhaṃ namāmyahamcaṃdravarṇaṃ catuśśārṅgaṃ goviṃdamabhisaṃśrayecaturmusalamabjābhaṃ saṃśraye madhusūdanamvāmanaṃ bālasūryābhaṃ caturvajraṃ samāśrayecaturmudgaramabhyemi hṛṣīkeśaṃ taṭitprabhamdāmodaraṃ catuḥpāśamiṃdragopanibhaṃbhajeūrdhvapuṃḍreṣviti śrīśaṃnityaṃ dhyāyītanāmabhiḥmāhātmyaṃ śrītulasyāstu kathayasva sureśvaratadarcanavidhiḥkīdṛgudyāpana vidhiḥ kathamśṛṇvaṃtumunayassarve tulasīvratamuttamamdaṃpatyoḥprītijanakaṃ putrapautrābhivṛddhidamsadāvijayadaṃrājñāṃ vignaughadhvāṃtanāśanamutpannaiṣātadā devī tulasīkāmarūpiṇīpūrṇacaṃdrānanāśyāmā kṛśamadhyāsukeśinīśaṃkhārī ca gadāpadme dadhānāgaruḍā sthitāevaṃrūpā ca sā devī bhaktepsitavarapradā

sanskrit: ārādhitā mayā viṣṇu śaṃbhuśakrādibhissuraiḥevaṃ prabhāvāsā devīyayedaṃ dhāryate jagatiyaṃ hi guptarūpā tu dṛśyate bhuvisarvadātvadanyaḥ saṃśayasyāsya cchedakona hi vidyatetasya bhāryā hi cārvaṃgī surūpācāru yauvanāśyāmāsumadhyātanvaṃgī nāmnā vṛṃdeti viśrutāsukeśīpadmavadanā pīnonnata payodharājalaṃdharā sureṃdrasya sarvaśīlaguṇānvitāanurakto bhavattasyāṃ bhāvamāyā vimohitaḥjalaṃdharanareṃdrasya rājyalakṣmīrvinirgatātaccitābhasmani tadātatparobhūtsuduḥkhitaḥtaccittaugulmarūpeṇa rūpaṃdadhaturuttamamtatobṛṃdāvanecāru tulasīvanamāśrītātataḥ prabhṛtilokesminnāmnāvṛṃdā vanaṃ smṛtamprāsaṃgikī mahāpuṇyā prasaṃgātpāpanāśanīśubhāyāṃ hemagarbhāyāṃ siktāyāṃ tīrthavāriṇātulasīropaṇaṃ kuryāt svastivācanapūrvakampaṃcamyārdrāsamete suraguru divase karkaṭākhye vilagne śrīmānrāmānujāryassamajaninigamāṃtārthasaṃrakṣaṇārthamekāṃtibhirdvādaśabhissahasraiḥ śrīraṃga āsteyatisārvabhaumaḥgītābhāṣyamathaprapatti viṣaye gadyatrayaṃ cākarottasmai lakṣmaṇakṣaṇāyamunaye tubhyaṃ namaḥ kūrmahegatvātāṃ yāmunākhyāṃ saritamathayatīṃdrākhyapadmākareṃdraṃ saṃpūryaprāṇisasyepravahati bahudhādeśikeṃdra bhramaughaiḥbalabhadrastṛtīyastu kalaukaścidbhaviṣyatiahīnāmīśvaraḥ sākṣādabhūdrāmānujo muniḥkāṃtimatyātmajaśśrīmāllīṁlāmānuṣavigrahaḥnārāyaṇakṛpāpātraṃ śrībhūtapuranāyakaḥ

sanskrit: kāṃcīpūrṇapriyasakhaḥ praṇatārti vināśanaḥyādavāpāditāpārtha vṛkṣacchedakuṭhārakaniraṃtarajanājñānanirmocanavicakṣaṇaḥparābhiprāyatattvajño yāmunāṃguli mocakaḥpūrṇāryalabdhasanmaṃtraḥ śauripādābja ṣaṭpadaḥraṃgeśakaiṃkaryaratovibhūti dvayanāyakaḥvararaṃgānukaṃpāttadrāviḍāmnāyasāgaraḥcatussaptati śiṣyāḍhyaḥ paṃcācārya padāśrayaḥpraṇatārtiharācāryaḥ dattabhikṣaikabhojanaḥkūreśaṃdāśarathyādi caramārthaprakāśakaḥdevarājārcanaratomūkamukti pradāyakaḥvaradācāryasadbhakto yajñeśārtivināśanaḥśrīśailapūrṇakaruṇālabdharāmāyaṇārthakaḥvyāsasūtrārthatattvajño bodhāyanamatānugaḥadvaitamatavicchettā viśiṣṭā dvaitapālakaḥvināśitākhilamatāśeṣī kṛtaramāpatiḥbhāṣādattahayagrīvo bhāṣyakāro mahāyaśāḥśrīveṃkaṭācalādhīśaśśaṃkhacakrapradarśakaḥkṛpāmātraprasannāryo gopikāmokṣadāyakaḥkṛmikaṃṭhanṛpadhvaṃsī sarvamaṃtramahodadhiḥśrībhaktagrāmapūrṇāḍhyo viṣṇuvardhanarakṣakaḥnagarīkṛtavedādriḥ ḍillīśvarasamarcitaḥsaṃpatkumārajanakaḥ sādhulokaśikhāmaṇiḥgodāgrajodigvijetāgodābhīṣṭaprapūrakaḥavyāhatamahadvartmāyatirājojagadguruḥ

sanskrit: yaḥ paṭhechṛṇuyādvāpi sarvānkāmānsamaśnutetajjivabhūtaṃbhuvi vaiṣṇavānāṃ babhūvarāmānujamānasānām || 29pravaktācchaṃdasāṃvaktāpāṃcarātrasya yaḥ svayamanugrahamayīṃvaṃde nityamajñānanigrahāmyadvetraśikharaspaṃdeviśvametadvyavasthitamśrutīnāṃviśramāyālaṃśaṭhāriṃtamupāsmaheyasyanaigamikaṃ tattvaṃhastāmalakatāṃ gatamśuddhasattvamayaṃśaureravatāramivāparamaspṛṣṭamadarāgaṃtaṃ rāmaṃturyamupāsmahenirastajihmagasparśe yatrakṛṣṇaḥ kṛtādaraḥyena viśvasṛjoviṣṇorapūryatamanorathaḥprasādayatiyatsūktiḥ svādhīnapadikāṃ śrutimśaraṇāgatasārthavāhamīḍe śikhayāśekhariṇaṃ patiṃ yatīnāmapṛthakpratipannayanmayatvairvṛdhepaṃcabhirāyudhairmurāreḥaparopitavāñchruterapārthānnanurāmāvarajaḥ sa eṣabhūyaḥvinivartayituṃ yatīśvaroktirvidadhethāsthiranītipaṃjarasthāmahatīgurupaṅktihārayaṣṭirvibudhānāṃ hṛdayaṃ gamāvibhātiyadudbhavāḥ śuddhasuvṛttaśītalāḥbhavaṃtimuktāvalibhuṣaṇaṃ bhuvaḥakalaṃkayogamajaḍāśayodayaṃyatirājacaṃdramuparāgadūragamharibhaktidāsyarasikāḥ parasparaṃ krayavikrayārha daśayāsamiṃdhatesvadatemamādyasubhagāsarasvatī yatirājakīrtikatakairviśodhitācalacittavṛttivinivartanauṣadhaṃ śaraṇaṃ yatīṃdracaraṇau vṛṇīmahepratipādayaṃti gatimāpavargakīṃyati sārvabhaumapadasātkṛtāśayāḥraṃgeśabhaktajanamānasarājahaṃsorāmānujaḥ śaraṇamastumuniḥ svayaṃ naḥviṣvaktanaṃ viṣayalobhaviṣaṃ nijābhirgāḍhānu bhāvagaruḍadhvajabhāvanābhiḥ

sanskrit: dhūrjaṭīmālinīghorākapālīviṣabhojinīcatuṣṣaṣṭissamākhyātā yoginyovarasiddhidāḥnāsāṃte phālamadhye ḍaphakaṭhasahite kaṃṭhamadhye svarāṇāṃ haṃkṣaṃ tattvārthayuktaṃ sakaladalagataṃ varṇarūpaṃnamāmiśarāsanaṃ varaṃdakṣedhatte vāmeśarābhayau || 1 || raktavarṇaḥdhatte khaṭvāṃ ca kheṭaṃ ca krameṇaivavarābhayau || 1 || śyāvarṇaḥcaṃdrahāsavarau dakṣe vāmedhattegadābhayau || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥśārikāṃ ca varaṃdakṣe vāmedhatteṃkuśābhayau || 1 || svarṇavarṇaḥdakṣeśūlāṃkuśavarānvāme pāśagadābhayān || 1 || śubhravarṇaḥraktācaturbhujā dhattekhaḍgakheṭavarābhayān || 1 || raktavarṇaḥdakṣepāśavaraudhatte tathā vāmeṃkuśābhayau || 1 || raktavarṇaḥśūlaṃpāśaṃvaraṃ dakṣevāme khaḍgagadābhayāndadhānāraktasiṃhasthākrūrālokabhayaṃkarī || śvetavarṇaḥcaturmukhāṣṭahasteyaṃ dhattestrāṇikaraiḥparaiḥkhaḍgaṃ kapālamusalābhayānpītāṃbarāśubhā || 2 || śyāmavarṇaḥraktādaśabhujārdhena dakṣādikramaśaḥkaraiḥvāmaiḥkaraiḥkhaḍgakheṭagadāśaktyabhayāṃstathā || 2 || raktavarṇaḥraktāviṃśadbhujā siṃhavāhanāphālalocanāakṣasūtraṃ ca cinmudrāṃbhuśuḍīṃmudgaraṃ varamkapālaṃdahanaṃśoṣaṃdaṃḍaṃ caiva gadābhayau || 3 || raktavarṇaḥmayūragāṣaḍbhujeyaṃ raktakeśaiśca saṃvṛtāvāmaiḥśaṃkhaṃgadāṃgurvīṃkarairdhatte'bhayaṃ tathā || 2 || śubhravarṇaḥmayūragārkabāhussyāddhattedakṣeṃkuśaṃśaramvāmeśūlaṃ kārmukaṃ ca kheṭaṃmusalameva capustakaṃcābhayaṃ caiva sarvaśatrubhayaṃkarī || raktavarṇaḥekavaktrāvakranetrābhrukuṭīkuṭilekṣaṇā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dakṣiṇakare cinmudrā | vāmepustakam | kakṣetridaṃḍaḥ | padmāsanam(prakārāṃtareṇa) - sāṃjalibaṃdhopi || 1tīrthārcāberamityete paṃcaberāḥ prakīrtitāḥsnapanaṃsnapanārthaṃsyādutsavaṃtūtsavārthakambalyarthaṃ baliberaṃ ca paṃcaberānsamarcayettvatprasādānmayāsarvaṃ jñātaṃjñeyaṃ vidhedhunātasyotpattiṃ nidānaṃ ca varṇaṃkṣetraṃ phalāphalamtathārcanāyāṃ yogyatvaṃ tvadvākyena caturmukhamayocyate vidhānena sāligrāmasya lakṣaṇammūrtibhedaṃ ca pūjāyāṃ yogyatvaṃ munipuṃgavasāligrāma itikṣetre haricakraśilāmayetatraivagaṃḍakyā khyātā nadīpāpapraṇāśinītasmin parvatamūle tu cakratīrthaṃ mahatsaraḥtasmin parvatatīrthesti sākṣāccakradharohariḥtacchilāsu ca sarvāsu harikṣetra gatāsu casarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktā sāligrāmaśilā bhavetutpattistacchilānāṃ tu puṇyakāleṣu vidyatevajrakīṭa itikhyāto jaṃturbhutvāharissvayamsāligrāmaśilāgarbhamāsādyakalanissvanaḥnānāvidhāni cakrāṇi nānārupāṇi līlayāsānnidhyaṃ kurute tatra sākṣāllakṣmīpatissadāutpattirnāradoktaivaṃ vijñeyā munipuṃgavakapilā ca tathādhūmrā kalaṃkā bahuvarṇinīevaṃ vidhaistathā varṇairūpairnānāvidhāśilāpītāhairaṇyagarbhāsyādraktāpradyumnarūpiṇī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrīmannārāyaṇakṣetraṃ haritāṃgaṃ vidurbudhāḥkalaṃkākṣayakārīsyādanaṃtobahuvarṇabhāksaṃdigdhavarṇāhaṃtrīsyāditikṣetraphalaṃ munepuṣṭidā vṛddhidā śyāmā raktārājyakarītathābahuvarṇā śrīkarīsyādvivarṇā niṣpalā tathātadaṣṭāṃśa pramāṇaṃ syāduttamaṃ yasya gahvarambhāgatrayaṃ jaghanyasyāt sāligrāmasya lakṣaṇamsamavaktraṃ viśiṣṭaṃ syāt pārśvāsyaṃ bhāgya hṛdbhavetmūrtibhedaṃsamāśodhya paścāllakṣaṇamādiśetmatsyaḥkūrmovarāhaśca nārasiṃhotha vāmanaḥrāmorāmaśca rāmaśca budhaḥkalkarimedaśaśrīvatsabiṃdumālāḍhyāṃ matsyamūrtiṃ śubhāṃviduḥpālāśohemabiṃdu śrīrmahākūrmastu durlabhaḥdvāradeśelasaccakraṃ vārāhaṃ tadvidurbudhāḥśirodṛṣṭordhvacakraṃ ca pārśvayorvāpi dṛśyatenārasiṃha itikhyāto yogyomaskari pūjanelakṣmīnṛsiṃha ākhyāto bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥhrasvaṃ suvartulaṃ caiva vāmanaṃ paricakṣatenābhideśalasaccakro rāmassyājjamadagnijaḥnābhicaktraṃ bahucchidraṃ śyāmaṃ dāśarathiṃ viduḥmadhubiṃdudharaḥ śrīmānrāmassaṃkarṣaṇaśśubhaḥśvetavarṇamatiślakṣaṇaṃ sarvajñaṃ śrīghanaṃ viduḥśvetavarṇo dīrghamukhaḥ kalkirityabhidhīyateabjacihnaṃ sūkṣmacakraṃ kṛṣṇamenaṃ pracakṣatenīraṃdhraṃ vartulaṃ vāpi dīrghaṃ vāmālikā yutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ dīrghākāraṃ mahodaramśrīgopālamimaṃprāhussarekhāvaṃśagahvaramvāmanaṃnīlaraktāṃgaṃ vadaṃti dadhi vāmanammūrtidadhātigotrīsyād dadhi gopālavāmanaḥsasmātsaṃtānagopālo putrapautrābhi vṛddhidaḥaṃkuśākāravadano dharmacakrasamanvitaḥ || 2dhanurbāṇāṃbujadharaṃ pradyumnaṃ ceṣṭadaṃ viduḥsuvarṇarūpyarekhāḍhyamaniruddhaṃ vidurbudhāḥpakvajaṃbūphalākāraṃ hayagrīvaṃ vadaṃtyamumkiṃcidviṣamacakrāḍhyaṃ śrīdharaṃ śrīkaraṃ viduḥdvāradvaye catuścakraṃ vāme vā dakṣiṇepi vāśrīvatsaśaṃkhacakrāḍhyaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ viduḥpadmanābha itikhyātastaṃ bidurnākadaṃ budhāḥdaśaraṃdhrasamāyukto viṃśaccakrasamanvitaḥgoviṃda itivikhyātaḥ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥviśvarūpa itikhyāto bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥsamaṃsūkṣmaṃ lasaccakraṃ paṃkajadvayaśobhitamlakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ prāhurdurlabhaṃ śīghrasiddhidamnārāyaṇamimaṃprāhurnāradeṣṭaphalapradamvanamālālasaccakraṃ prāhurdāmodaraṃ muneanaṃtamūrtirvijñeyo harirlakṣmīpradāyakaḥvanamālādharaśśrīmāntrivikrama udāhṛtaḥnanārdana itikhyāto himāṃśupariśītalaḥnābhicakradharaśśāṃto vāsudeva itīritaḥpaṃcāyudhadharaśśrīmān viṣṇurityucyate budhaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sūkṣmacakrassamaśślakṣṇo hyacyutassamudīritaḥupeṃdramūrtirvikhayātā harissaukhyaśubhapradāśivanābhassavijñeyo durlabhassarvakāmadaḥhiraṇyagarbhaḥ khyātosau hemagarbhaḥ śubhapradaḥdīrghassuṣiravānvāme gopālomadanā hvayaḥjanārdanaṃ vijānaṃti vanamālābhiveṣṭitamvanamālāyutaṃ ślakṣṇamāhustaṃ ca janārdanamdve dve cakre tvadhaścordhvaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇa smṛtaḥvṛttākāraṃ tu dīrghaṃ vā dvāradṛṣṭaika cakrakamraktamūrdhvamitiprāhurmahograṃ yati pūjanekapilaṃ vakravadanaṃ tatpārsve vanamālinammahājvālā nṛsiṃhaṃ taṃ yatipūjyaṃ mahāmuneśrīkaraṃśivanābhākhyaṃ sarvasaubhāgyavardhanambuddhākāraṃ vijānīyāccakraṃ vā malināvahamlakṣmīnṛsiṃhaṃkapilaṃ varṇataḥ kṣetrabhāvanāvanamālāyutaṃ ramyaṃ śvetaṃ vārāhamucyateaṃkuśākāravadanaṃ bhūvarāhaṃ śubhapradamkarburaṃ vāthakapilaṃ śyāmaṃ kūrmaṃ vidurbudhāḥśyāmalaṃ komalākāraṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ pracakṣatevanamālānvitaṃ śyāmaṃ keśavākhyaṃ vidurbudhāḥmūrtaṃtamacyutaṃ jñeyaṃ sūkṣmaraṃdhraṃ suśītalamvanamālānvitaṃ śyāmaṃ vaikuṃṭhaṃ komalaṃ viduḥviṣṭaraśravasaṃprāhusthūlaṃ dīrghaṃ ca cakriṇamhiraṇyagarbhamāhustaṃ dvāradṛṣṭasudarśanammālātrayeṇasaṃyuktaṃ mūrtitrayamidaṃ viduḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viṣṇulakṣaṇamāsyaṃ cāpyāsya cakraṃ samīpagamkūrmamūrtirvarāhaśca durlabhaṃ sarvakāmadamdaṃṣṭre vā śaktiliṃgaṃ ca vaktre tu viṣamasthitevarāhamūrtirvijñeyā sarvakāmaphalapradāvanamālā suniṣpannaṃ pṛthucakraṃ sudarśanambrahmacaryeṇasaṃpūjyā bhuktimuktipradāyinīkṣataṃ kuṃḍalasaṃyuktaṃ vaktre vā biṃdupūrvakamhrasvaṃ ca vartulaṃ caiva vāmanaṃ parikīrtayetśyāmalaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ cāpyāsya cakraṃsamīpagamkṛṣṇavarṇaṃ mahāsnigdhaṃ biṃdunoparibhūṣitamdadhivāmanamityāhurbhuktimuktiphalapradamlakṣmīnṛsiṃho vijñeyo bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥdhanurbāṇākhyarekhāḍhyaṃ padmarekhāsamanvitamrāmaṃ rāmaṃ ca rāmaṃ ca durlabhaṃ sarvakāmadamsavyāpasavyatūṇīraṃ pṛṣṭe cāpavirājitamrāmaṃdāśarathiṃviddhi durlabhaṃ bhuvanatrayedvāradeśe same cakre kalpavṛkṣa su cihnakamsītārāmaṃ tu taṃ viddhi bhuktimukti phalapradampṛḍṭhe suṣiramāramya vaktremakarakuṃḍalamgopālakṣetramutpattyā sa rāmaṃ tasya lakṣaṇamaputreputraphaladaṃ sarvamaṃgalakārakamsuvartulaṃ tathāpītaṃ pṛṣṭhatassuṣiraṃdhruvambrahmamūrtistu vijñeyā bhogamokṣaphalapradādvāradeśe samecakre dṛśyete nāṃtarīyakeapamṛyuharaṃścaiva sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ || 2
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛṣṇavarṇaṃ suvikhyātaṃ sarvamṛtyuharaṃ śubhamdīrgharekhāsamākrāntaṃ suvarṇavanamālikamayaṃ nārāyaṇo jñeya apamṛtyu haraśśubhaḥdīrgharekhāsamākrāntaṃ catuścakrasamanvitamlakṣmīnārāyaṇākhyaṃ ca mukhenābhau ca nāradasarvasaubhāgyadaṃ nṝṇāṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ viduḥ || 3kadaṃbakusumākāraṃ sarvasiddhipradaṃ śubhamsaṃkarṣaṇaṃvijānīyādraktābhañcātiśobhanamsuṣirairbahulaiścaiva dīrghākārastu tadbhavetkṛṣṇavarṇaṃ tathāviṣṇuṃ sthūlacakraṃ suśobhanamkṛṣṇamūrtissuvijñeyā bhogamokṣaphalapradāsakṛṣṇavarṇabiṃdussyānnirmalaḥ parikīrtitaḥkūrmastvevaṃ sa vijñeyassarvakarmaśubhapradaḥdhvajākārā tadārekhā lakṣyate madhyadeśataḥcakratrayodaśaṃ puṇyaṃ caturdaśamahāphalamcakraśaṃkhagadāpadma vanamālāvibhūṣitamanaṃtaṃ taṃ vijānīyāt sarvasaubhāgyadāyinamdve cakre caikabhāge tu pūrvabhāge tu puṣkalaḥtrivikramassavijñeyo hyapamṛtyuharaḥ śubhaḥ || 2veṇulāṃgalacihnaṃ ca kuṃḍalābhyāṃ suśobhitamputralābhaṃ tathāmokṣaṃ bhuktiṃmuktiṃ dadāti ca || 2sthūlacakro bhaveddevo harirlohitavarṇakaḥśyāmavarṇo mahāsnigdhaśchatrākārastathaiva caśirṣe tu puṣkalaṃ bibhranmahāsnigdhaṃ ca komalamputralābhaṃ tathāmokṣaṃ gavāṃ vṛddhiṃ dadāti sā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: chatrākāraṃmahāsnigdhaṃ dvāraṃ nāsti sa biṃdukampṛṣṭhabhāge tathāhema biṃdunāparibhūṣitaḥvārāhakṣetramuptattyā(catuścakraṃjanārdanaḥ) - catuścakraṃjanārdanaḥtricakraṃ cācyute jñeyaṃ catuścakraṃ janārdanesaptacakraṃ tu vārāhe cāṣṭakaṃ ca puruṣottameekādaśa tu pradyumne tvanaṃte dvādaśa smṛtāmanyeṣubahūcakreṣu paramātmāpratiṣṭhitaḥśivanābhasahasraṃ ca sāligrāmasahasrakamtāvatyomūrtayassaṃti sāligrāmeṣunāradana śakyate mayāvaktuṃ kalpakoṭiśatairapiacakraṃ tu tathāghṛṣṭaṃ vakrāsyaṃ bhinnamevavādīrghaśobhitamacchāṃgamasaumyākṛtimeva vābahubāṇasamāyuktaṃ sphuritālakṣyacakrakambaṃdhanaṃ baddhacakraṃ ca krūracakraṃ tathā tyajetdardduraṃ sphuṭitaṃ dagdhaṃ trikoṇaṃ parivarjayetbahurekhaṃ paricchidraṃ tiryakcakraṃ tathā tyajetbaṃdhakaṃbaddhacakraṃ ca trikoṇaṃ baṃdhunāśanamarthadhnīvimalā ca syāt karkaśaṃ kṣetrameva caghanatvaṃ vṛddhamālokya gṛhṇīyādbuddhimānnaraḥtasmādasyapradānena prītobhavatu mādhavaḥtāvubhaupuṇyakarmāṇau narakīkrayavikrayīsāligrāmavapuryatra tatra doṣo na vidyatekhaṇḍitā sphuṭitā vāpi sāligrāmaśilā śubhākeśavaṃ vā śivaṃ vāpi spṛṣṭvā naraka maśnute
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yaśśūdreṇārcitaṃ liṅgaṃ viṣṇuṃ vā praṇamennaraḥsa sarvayātanābhogī yāvadā candratārakampaṃkābhaṃ barbaraṃ caiva mṛgendrasadṛśākṛtimsaumyaścedgṛhibhiḥ pūjyahyonyathā pūjanaṃ na hidve cakredvārakāyāstu nārcyaṃ sūryadvayaṃ tathābhagnāṃ ca pratimāṃ caiva matsyādi daśakaṃ tathāetāsāṃ pūjanānnityamudvegaṃ prāpnuyādgṛhīviṣamānaiva pūjyāstu viṣameṣveka evahisarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇusāyujyamāpnuyātdhāryaṃ ca muninābhaktyā lakṣmīpatimude sadādharmārthakāmamokṣārthaṃ bhaktimānyassame priyaḥśrāddhalāle viśeṣeṇa pitṝṇāṃ dattamakṣayamprāṇaṃsītpadayugapaṃkaje vidhātustatpūjāmakurutanāradopi bhaktyākathito bhavatābrahman kṣetravarṇaṃ śubhāśubhamśyāmaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca nīlaṃ ca tathā vai pītavarṇakamdhūmravarṇaṃ tathādagdhamitinānāvidhāśśilāḥpuṣṭivṛddhipradāśyāmā śuklāmokṣapradāyinīatiriktā mṛtyukarī kṛṣṇā kīrtipradāyinīvāsudevassitojñeyo raktassaṃkarṣaṇassmṛtaḥśyāmo nārāyaṇo devaḥ kṛṣṇo vaiṣṇava ucyatepāṃḍuro vāsudevaśca śuklaśukla adhokṣajaḥmayākṣetrasya kathito vistāro munipuṃgavaiti śrītattvanidhyākhyagranthe viṣṇukṣetravaiṣṇavasā(śā)ligrāmādilakṣaṇādinirūpaṇaṃnāma ṣaṣṭhonidhissaṃpūrṇaḥ(kailāsādrau) paraśivaḥ (sūryabiṃbe) sadāśivaḥ(sūryajyotiṣi) siddheśaḥ paṃcāmutravasaṃti hi || 2
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: (kaivalyaśaile) śrīkaṃṭhaḥ kedāro (himavatya) pi(prayāge) nīlakaṃṭheśo (gayāyāṃ) rudranāmakaḥ(drākṣārāme) tu bhīmeśo (māyūre) cāṃbikeśvaraḥvṛṣadhvajābhidhaśśrīmāñ (chvetahastipure)śvaraḥ(śrīrūpā)khyetyāgarājo (vede)vedapurīśvaraḥ(madhurāyāṃ) cokkanātho (mānase) mādhaveśvaraḥ(gajāraṇye) tu vaidyeśaḥ (tīrthādrau) tīrthakeśvaraḥ(kaṇvapūryāṃ) tu kaṇveśo (madhye) madhyārjuneśvaraḥ(viriṃcipuri) māgeśaḥ (paṃcanadyāṃ) giriśvaraḥ(trimakūṭe) tvagastyeśaḥ (subrahmaṇye)'hipeśvaraḥraviṇāpūjito (dakṣiṇāvarte)'rkeśvarassvayammūrtitrayātmakaḥ (somapuryāṃ) someśvarābhidhaḥ(mahānaṃdipure) sāk.ānmahānaṃdipureśvaraḥmahāpuṇye tatra (kakudgirau) gaṃgādhareśvaraḥnaṃdīśvaro (naṃdigirau) caṃḍeśo (badhirācale)(ghanānaṃdācale) somo (nallūre) vimaleśvaraḥ(ekāṃte) rāmaliṃgeśaḥ (śrīnāge) kuṃḍalīśvaraḥ(matsyatīrthe) tūtīrtheśaḥ (trikūṭe) tāṃḍaveśvaraḥ(gaṃḍakyāṃ) śivanābhastu (śrīpatau) śrīpatīśvaraḥ(vāṇigrāme) viriṃceśo (nepāle) nakuleśvaraḥ(dharmasthale) maṃjunāthovyāseśastu (trirūpake)(puṃḍarīke) jaiminīśo('yodhyayāṃ) madhureśvaraḥ(maṇikuṃḍalatīrthe) tu maṇimuktānadīśvaraḥ(stanitā)'khye tu malleśaḥ (iṃdrakīle)'rjuneśvaraḥbhuvaneśaḥ (citrakūṭe) (tūjjinyāṃ) kālikeśvaraḥ
