sanskrit: bṛhatīśaḥ (taṃjāpūryāṃ) rāmeśo (vahnipuṣkare)(viṃdhyācale) varāheśonṛsiṃhassyād (ahobale)tathāparaśurāmeśaḥ (setau) rāmeśvarābhidhaḥ(tattvakṣetre) cakalkīśaḥkṛṣṇeśassyān (mahendrake) || 29jalaliṃgaṃ (jaṃbunāthe) tiruvānanadīpatiḥ(kālahastigirau) vāyuliṃgaṃnāgābhipūjitam(chāyāvane) mahāpuṇye tatra cchāyā vaneśvaraḥkṣetre (hyāmrātakā) bhikhye sūkṣmeśvara iti sthitaḥmuktiḥkarasthā bhavati nātrakāryā vicāraṇāprātaḥkāle tu pūjāṃte smartavyāni manīṣibhiḥteṣāṃ phalapravacane śaktaḥ śeṣopi na kvacit || 7 || 8somāskaṃdeśvaraṃ gaurīṃ caṃḍeśaṃ ca kirātakammahānṛṃttapravṛttaṃ ca navaberāḥ prakīrtitāḥtattatphalāni vakṣyāmi śṛṇudevi śubhāni canavanītaṃ ca rudrākṣaṃ bhasmacaṃdanakūrcajamkṣaṇike maṃḍale toye tvātmārthaṃ yajanaṃ smṛtamsarvarogavināśāya gomayaṃ tu prakīrtitamāsuraṃ lavaṇotthaṃ ca sarvalokavaśaṃkaramtaṃḍulodbhavapiṣṭena liṃgaṃ vidyā pradaṃ smṛtamdūrvāguḍūcisaṃbhūtamapamṛtyunivāraṇamikṣusāramayaṃliṃgaṃ bahudraviṇakāmakṛtpitṝṇāṃ muktaye pūjyaṃ liṃgaṃrajatasaṃbhavampūjyet tāmrajaṃ liṃgaṃ puṣṭikāmastu saṃtatamkīrtikāmorcayell.imgaṃ sadākāṃsya samudbhavamśoṇacaṃdanajaṃliṃgamāyuṣkāmorcayetpumān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṣaḍbhujārkakarairdhatte śūlaṃkhaḍgaṃvaraṃ tathāgadākheṭābhayānvāmedadhānā ca mahodarī || śyāmavarṇaḥmahodarīmahāvyāghravaravāhanamāsthitācaturbhujāśūlapāśavarābhayakarāmatā || kṛṣṇavarṇaḥraktāpītāmbarākrūratarakṣuvaravāhanāvāmeṃkuśa mahākheṭābhayāndhattekaraiḥkramāt || 2 || raktavarṇaḥtriśūlaṃ ca varaṃdakṣe vāmeṃkuśamathābhayam || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥkhākhyākhadyotinīkhaḍgavarābhayakarāmatā || 1 || pītavarṇaḥdhūmrābhādakṣiṇe dhatteśūlaṃ cākṣaṃsruvaṃvaramvāme tu pustakaṃkuṃḍīṃkapālamabhayaṃkramāt || dhūmravarṇaḥṣaḍbhujāśūlakhaṭvāṃgavarān dakṣabhujaiḥ kramātvāme khaḍgaṃ tathā kheṭamabhayaṃśatrubhaṃjanī || kṛṣṇavarṇaḥṣaḍānaneṣu cāpāsikheṭadānābhayānvitā || 1 || raktavarṇaḥkhaḍgakheṭadharācākhyāvarābhayakarāśubhā || 1 || svarṇavarṇaḥtriśūlaṃ kṣurikāṃpāśaṃkheṭaṃ ca dadhatīśubhā || 1 || pītavarṇaḥcaturbhujākhaḍgakheṭavarābhayakarānvitā || 1 || raktavarṇaḥpāśaṃvarābhayau dhattenakrasthāśubhadānṛṇām || 1 || śubhravarṇaḥtriśūlāṃbujacinmudrābhayānvitakarāśubhā || 1 || śubhravarṇaḥdhattemattamataṃgasthā pāṭalābhāsitāṃśukā || 1 || pāṭalavarṇaḥdhatte siṃhavarārūḍhā caika vaktrāruṇāmatā || 1 || aruṇavarṇaḥcaturbāhuḥkukkuṭasthāvarābhayakarā ca sā || 1 || śubhravarṇaḥtaṭidgaurīkarairdhatte śūlaṭaṃkavarābhayān || 1 || hemavarṇaḥekavaktrāśūlaśaktivarābhayakarāśubhā || 1 || raktavarṇaḥekavaktrākarairdhatte vīṇātaṃ trīvarābhayān || 1 || śubhravarṇaḥśārikāṃḍamaruṃdhatte vṛṣārūḍhāvarābhayau || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kastūrīsaṃbhavaṃliṃgaṃ graṃthakāmaḥ samarcayetkāṃtikāmastu satataṃ liṃgaṃkauṃkumakesaramsarveṣāṃ kāmadaṃ liṃgaṃ kṛṣṇāgarusamudbhavamgodhūmapiṣṭajaṃliṃgaṃ gokāmo nityamarcayetmāṣapiṣṭamayaṃliṃgaṃ nityaṃ puṣṭivivardhanamliṃgaṃbrīhimayaṃpūjyaṃyaśaskāmenanityaśaḥkāmavatsupriyonityaṃbhavetstrīṇāṃhimānavaḥpūjayitvānaroścattayāprāpnotimahtīṃkṛṣimihacāmuṣmikelokesukhībhavatimānavaḥpūjayāparamāṃsiddhiṃ bhaktyāprāpnoti mānavaḥbhaktyāsamarcyamatimāñchivena saha modatesvarvapāpaṃ vidhūyāśu modate brahmaṇā sahasarvānkāmānavāpyātha prāpnoti paramāṃ gatimkṛtvāliṃgaṃ samabhyarcya gāṇāpatyamavānuyāt(tathāvakṣyamāṇarītyāpadmarāgakāśmīra puṣyarāgendranīlagomedakagārutmatavidrumamauktikahīrakapāradabāṇaliṃgānyapi-pūjyāni)sa mahāpātakī tasya durvṛttasya durātmanaḥtīrthāni vividhā yajñāḥ śivārcā caikataḥ samāḥtathānāstītināstītiśāstrāṇāmeṣaniścayaḥpūjayitvā narobhaktyā śivasāyujyamāpnuyātpadmarāgācca kāśmīraṃ kāśmīrātpuṣyarāgajamtatogārutmataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vidrumaṃ ca tataḥ paramsuvarṇādadhikaṃśreṣṭhaṃ hīrakaṃ pāradaṃ parampārthivena tu liṃgena bahavaḥ siddhimāgatāḥdevāsuramanuṣyāśca siddhagaṃdharvayakṣakāḥdvāpare pāradaṃśreṣṭhaṃ pārthivaṃ tu kalau yuge || 1
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mṛdbāṇarasaliṃgākhyaṃ teṣāmādyamanuttamamaṣṭamūrtiṣusarvāsu mūrtirmepārthivī varāyathāsarveṣu deveṣu jyeṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭho maheśvaraḥyathāsarveṣu vedeṣu praṇavo hi mahāntsmṛtaḥpārthivārādhanaṃ dharmyamāyurvardhanamuttamamṣaḍakṣareṇakartavyaṃ puruṣaistu prayatnataḥsthāvareṣvapi divyeṣu samantraṃ parvaṇi spṛśetcaṃḍa dravyaṃ bahiḥkṣiptaṃ nirmālyaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ smṛtam || 1pratimāsu ca sarvāsu na doṣomālyadhāraṇenirmalatvācca (nirmālyaṃ) nṛṇāṃnairmalyakāraṇātpādodakaprasādānnaṃ saṃgṛhṇanmokṣamāpnuyātsiddhapratiṣṭhite tāmraraupyakāñcanalohajecaṇḍādhikāronoyatrabhoktavyaṃ tatra bhaktitaḥdaṇḍavadbhuvi devārthaṃ tadaṣṭāṅganatirbhavet || 1yathākathaṃcidrūpeṇaramaṇīyaṃ prakalpayetdvikhaṃḍaṃ hi prakurvāṇo naiva pūjāphalaṃ labhetpārthivaṃ piṣṭajaṃ pauṣpamakhaṃḍaṃ tu prakārayetye kurvati narāmūḍhā na pūjāphalabhāginaḥvedoktavidhināsamyak saṃpūrṇaphalasiddhayebrahmayajñaṃ vidhāyādau tatastarpaṇamācaretpūjayetparayābhaktayā pārthivaṃ liṃgamuttamamśivālaye śucaudeśe pārthivārcā vidhīyateśvetāḥśoṇāḥ pītakṛṣṇāḥ mṛdovarṇacatuṣṭayāḥānīyamṛtikāṃ śuddha deśāt snigdhāṃ prayatnataḥpaścālliṃgaṃ vidhāyāśu krameṇānena bhaktimān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śivaḥpaśupatiścaiva mahādeva itikramātsnapanaṃ pūjanaṃ caiva kṣamāpaṇavisarjanamnamonādātmane tubhyaṃ namobiṃdukalātmanetvaṃ mātā sarvalokānāṃ tvamevajagatāṃpitāpārthivasyāsya liṃgasya yanmayāpūjanaṃ kṛtamśivodātāśivobhoktā śivassarvamidaṃ jagatpūjāphalaṃ mamasamastamupaitvavighnaṃ pūrṇaṃ vidhehi parameśvara pāhimāṃ tvampraviśatvaṃ mahādeva sarvairāvaraṇaissahapūjāvidhiṃ na jānāmī kṣamasva parameśvaraiṣṭakāmyārthasiddhyarthaṃ punarāgamanāya canayāti nyūnatāṃ tattu bāṇaliṅgamitīritam || 1kurvītāṅguṣṭhato hrasvaṃ na kadācit samācaretṣaṭpañcakacaturmānaṃ madhyamaṃ trividhaṃ smṛtamevaṃ navavidhaṃproktaṃ caraliṅgaṃ yathākramāt || 2paridhistattriguṇitastadvatpīṭhaṃ vyavasthitamtriṣvādyaṃbāṇamutkṛṣṭaṃ rasaliṅgaṃ tatodhikamrudrāṣṭakamitikhyātaṃ tatpatnīputrasaṃyutamyathāhapūrvaṃ tatsarvaṃ vadāmitavanāradabhīma ugromahādeva eterudrāḥ prakīrtitāḥteṣāṃbhāryāśca putrāśca nāmāni kathayāmitesvāhā viśā ca dīkṣā ca rohiṇī ca yathākramātrudrapatnya imāścāṣṭau putrāṃśca śṛṇunāradavasaṃtassvargasaṃtānau budhaścaiva yathākramātpuṇyakāle tu saṃprāpte śanau vā bhūtimicchatācaturaśrāṃ samāṃbhūmiṃ liptvāgomayavāruṇā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hastamātraṃ dvihastaṃ vā navakoṣṭhasamanvitambrahmāṇaṃ madhyame koṣṭhe sauvarṇaṃ viniveśayetsauvarṇānaṣṭarudrāṃśca brahmārddhena vinirmitāntasyāpyardhena sauvarṇān pratyekaṃ rudrapārśvataḥsvasvamaṃtreṇa pūjāsyānnamaskāra yutena capradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā praṇamya ca yathākramampūjayitvopadeṣṭāraṃ dadyān maṃtreṇa madhyamamevaṃ rudrāṣṭakopetaṃ dānaṃ dadyādyathā vidhiāyurārogyasaṃyuktaḥ putrabāndhavavānsukhībhuktvābhogānyathecchaṃ ca svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca viṃdatiakṣamālāṃsruvaṃbibhratpustakaṃ ca kamaṃḍalumpāṭalavarṇaḥbhajāmibhajatāṃkalpa pādapaṃparayāmudāpītāṃbaramudārāṃgaṃ bhajatāṃkāmadaṃ sadāvibhrāṇaṃprāṇirakṣārthaṃ sarvakālamatandritammailāraṃrūpamāsthāya śaṅkaraśśaṃkarobhavatduṣṭāñchatrūnvinighnaṃ tuṃturageṇa cacārahadvāradeśe sthitaiḥ śaśvatsevyamānamataṃdritaiḥsarvadāsarvarakṣārthamudyataṃ taṃ bhajāmyahamyasya toṣaṃ saṃjanayetpāyasena guḍena vāakleśe naiva sidhyaṃti godhanaṃ vājināṃ ca yaḥsaṃsāraduḥkhasaṃtāpa nāśanāya sukhāya caharidrayā kṛtaṃ ramyaṃ bhaṃḍāraṃ bhajatāṃ nṛṇāmyasya cihnaṃ suvarṇāḍhyaṃ bhaṃḍāraṃ bhajatāṃ sadāmāyālakṣmīrmahālakṣmīrmāyāvatyabhi māninī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvādaśaitāni nāmāni rahasyāni tavāṃbikenāmāni yāni te devi pratyahaṃ bhaktibhāvataḥna tasya bhītiḥ śatrubhyaḥ na vyādhibhyaḥ kadācanatasya ciṃtitakāryāṇi sidhyaṃtyeva na saṃśayaḥrudraliṃgārcanaṃ caiva mukhyamāhurdvijāstikāḥtripuṃḍreṇavinādānaṃ rākṣasaṃ tatprakīrttitamtripuṃḍreṇavināvipro nādhikārī śivārcanedhiganīśārcanaṃ janmadhigvidyāmaśivāśrayāmyāvaṃti śrautakarmāṇi kriyaṃte pratyahaṃ dvijaiḥbhasmadhāraṇahīnāṃgo yadi vipro bhaviṣyatitasmātsarvaprayatnena tripuṃḍraṃ dhāryamanvahamsa eva brāhmaṇo rājan satyaṃsatyaṃ na saṃśayaḥsapatatyeva narake yāvadā caṃdratārakamlokevaśīkaraṃproktaṃ bhasmatrailokyapāvanamnāsye śivamayīvāṇī taṃ tyajedaṃtyajaṃ yathāśrutismṛtipurāṇādau saṃghuṣṭaṃ niścitaṃ hitamye pūjayantyaharahaśśruti tattvabhūtaṃ tānevaghoranarakādahamuddhariṣyekadācidapi na tyājyaṃ yathāśakti samācaretnaivapramaditavyaṃ vai bhramādapi kadācanabahiṣṭhassarvadharmebhyastatastannityamācaretcaturarṇavaparyaṃtā tena dattā vasuṃdharāspṛṣṭvā tu salilaṃ bhasmaprakṣeptavyaṃ viśuddhayebhasmatripuṃḍrakaraṇādbhavaṃprāpto bhaviṣyatibhavati śrīmahādevaṃ pūjayetyabravīcchrutiḥna gṛṇhāti jalaṃśaṃbhurgāṃgaṃ vā kimutetarat
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhūtiyuktāni deyāni mūlamaṃtreṇa śaṃbhavedhāraṇaṃ bhasmano hyuktaṃ mantrapūrvaṃ dvijanmanāmyadi syād bhasmarahitaṃ pīyūṣamapi tatparampākāgārepi deyaṃ syād bhasmakiṃcijjalānvitamtenakīṭādi saṃbaṃdha doṣopi suvinaśyatikiṃ tayāsudhayāputrāḥ kiṃcidbhasmānvitaṃ yadikartavyāmūlamaṃntreṇa tayā tuṣṭo bhavecchivaḥtatsarvaṃ bhasmadahati yathāgnistejasāvanamvedokte naivamārgeṇa tripuṃḍre jāyate ratiḥnityaṃprayatnataḥ kuryān mumukṣurmucyate'cirāttatrabhuṃkte sa patnīko vṛṣadhvaja iti smṛtaḥsarvapātaka yukto hi sa sadyaḥ pūyate naraḥsarvapātakayuktopi pūyate mānavo hi saḥsarvapātakayuktopi sa sadyaḥ pūyate naraḥkulaikaviṃśamuttārya sa gacchet paramāṃ gatimpaṃcagāvaḥ samutpannāḥ tābhyobhasmotthitaṃ nṛṇāmbhavaṃti paṃcanāmāni hetubhiḥ paṃcabhiḥ kramāt(bhasitaṃ) sarvapāpānāṃ bhartsanāt (kṣāra) māpadāmdagdhagomayamutkṛṣṭaṃ tadapyagnimukheparampaṃcagāvovibhorjātāḥ sadyojātādi vaktrataḥnaṃdādīnāṃgavāṃ varṇāḥ krameṇaparikīrtitāḥaghorādbhasmasaṃjātaṃ kṣāraṃtatpuruṣāttathārakṣāceśānavaktrācca naṃdādi dvārato bhavatyatīnāṃyathoṃcitam || trivarṇāśramiṇāṃcitāgnijam || sarveṣāṃ devālayasthitam || śivāgnihotrajāvibhūtiḥ śivālayamaṃtrasaṃskāradagdhāvāācamyoktāsanesthitvāprāṅkhovāpyudaṅkhaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tato mūlenabhasitamaṣṭakṛtvobhimaṃtrya caurodeśamaghoreṇa nābhiṃvāmena gopateevaṃ snānakramaḥproktastasmādevaṃ samācaretsadyaḥ prabhṛtibhirmantraiḥ bhasmānyuddhūayecchanaiḥādareṇasamādāyaśuddhepātre nidhāya tatgṛhītvābhasmatatpaṃca brahmamaṃtraiḥ śaniḥkaretairevasaptabhirmaṃtraistrivāramabhimaṃtrayetśivābhidhānaṃ yatproktaṃ bhāsanādbhasitaṃ matamvartaṃte ye mahābhāgā mukhyāste bhasmadhāriṇaḥgṛhītvābhasmatatpaṃca brahmamaṃtraiḥ śanaiḥ karetairevasaptabhirmaṃtraistrivāramabhimaṃtryatatsaṃyojyabhasmanātoyamagnirityādibhiḥ punaḥīśānena tu maṃtreṇa svamūrddhani viniḥkṣipetguhye vāmadvaye naiva sadyojātena pādayoḥuddhūlanasya snānāṃ te prakṣālyakaramācametathabhasmādāyābhimaṃtrayet (5) - īśānassarvavidhānam śivomtatpuruṣāya pracodayātaghorebhyaḥ rudrarūpebhyaḥvāmadevāyanamaḥ manonmanāyanamaḥsadyojātaṃ bhavodbhavāyanamaḥhastapādādivacchiṣyā itiśiṣṭābruvaṃti hidhāryaṃtripuṃḍraṃ strīṇāṃ ca yatīnāṃ jalavarjitammadhyāhnātprāgjalairyuktaṃ paratojalavarjitamṣaḍagulāyatamapi cādhikaṃ mānatastathāakāronāmikāprokto hyukāromadhyamāṃguliḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: madhyamānāṃmikāṃguṣṭhairanulomavilomataḥmūrddhā caiva lalāṭaṃ ca karṇaukaṃṭhastathaiva capaṃcāṃgulairnyasemūddhri praṇavena tu maṃtrataḥsadyenadakṣiṇe karṇe vāmadevena vāmataḥhṛdayaṃ hṛdaye naiva tribhiraṃgulibhisspṛśetvāmabāhau nyaseddhīmān kavacena triyaṃgulaiḥnaimittikeṣu bhasitaṃ rakṣākāryeṣu sarvadākṣāraṃ ca mokṣakāryeṣu prayoktavyaṃ sadābudhaiḥ || 2kalpañcaivānukalpañcāpyupakalpamakalpakamyathāśāstrokta vidhinā gṛhītvā gomayaṃ navamśoṣayetpuruṣeṇaiva dahedghorācchivāgnināvaneṣugomayaṃyacca śuṣkaṃcūrṇī kṛtaṃ tathāvastreṇottaritaṃ bhasma gomūtrādbaddhapiṃḍitamdeśakālocitaṃbhasma gṛhītvā'śucivarjitamsādhāraṇamidaṃ(bhasma)tvakalpamadhūnā śṛṇuśrautasmārtāgnidāvāgni virajāgniśivāgnijamvaidikairevatadgrāhyaṃ bhasmapaṃcavidhaṃ ca tat || 4 || 1caṃdanenobhayaṃkuryādititanmanurabravītardhacaṃdraṃ tu śūdrāṇāmanyeṣāmūrdhvapuṃḍrakamnetrayugmapramāṇaṃ tu tripuṃḍraṃ dhārayed dvijaḥtattripuṃḍraṃbhavecchastaṃ mahāpātakanāśanamśucirevabhavennityaṃ tripuṃḍrasya ca dhāraṇātbetālarākṣasāḥpretāḥ ye cānye kṣudrajaṃtavaḥsatāṃpaṅtipunātyeva sakalāṃ caturānanasthāneṣu paṃcadaśasu śarīre sādhakottamaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: galebhujadvaye caiva hṛdinābhau ca pṛṣṭhaketripuṃḍraṃ bhasmanādhāryaṃ mūlamaṃtreṇa sādhakaiḥ || 3amaṃtrapūrvamanyeṣāṃ śudrāṇāṃ dharmavedināmyathā hi yajñakarmādau patnīsādhye hi karmaṇisarvamaṃtrādhikarosti tathābhasmādi dhāraṇevibhūtirauṣadhaṃpuṃsāṃ muktistrī vaśyakarmaṇi || 1tasmādvāruṇamutsṛjya snānamāgneyamācaretevammuktvā ṛṣīndevāntsnāto devaḥ śivaḥ svayamsarvakarmasuyatnena bhasmasnānaṃ prakurvateanenaivaśarīreṇa sa rudronātrasaṃśayaḥādraṃ tu prakṛtiṃvidyāt prakṛtiṃ baṃdhanaṃ viduḥdhiganīśārcakajanāndhigvidyāmīvāśrayāmbrahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ trayyagnīnāṃ ca dhāraṇamsāmaveda adhastācca vedatrayadharobhavetvibhūtidhāraṇetvanyonāsti pratinidhirdhruvamtāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi rauravaṃnarakaṃ vrajetudapaśyatpurāyogamunmīlitavilocanaḥtebhyojātā yatastasmād rudrākṣā itikīrtitāḥnetrātsūryātmanaśśaṃbhoḥ kapilā dvādaśoditāḥkṛṣṇādaśavidhājatāḥ vahnirūpādvilocanātevamutpattito bhedādrudrākṣā bahudhā smṛtāḥrudrākṣarahito vipro narake patati dhruvamrudrākṣadhāraṇaṃ vakṣye rudrarūpasya siddhayedvitridvādaśavaktrāṇi śirasitrīṇidhārayetdaśasaptapaṃcavaktrān ṣaṭṣaṭkarṇadvaye tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paṃcāśaddhārayedvidvāṃścaturvaktrāṃstu vakṣasipratyekaṃ dvādaśatathānavāsyānmaṇibaṃdhayoḥdvātriṃśatkaṃṭhadeśe tu catvāriṃśacca mastakeekamevopavīte tu dhārayedbhāvayañchivamsametāndhārayedyastu rudrākṣānsa śivo bhavetrudrākṣāvidhijāḥ proktāssarvapāpavināśakāḥekatraveṇikāyāśca darśanena phalaṃ tu yatsamatāmevatatprāptaṃ tasmāddhāryaṃ trayaṃ budhaiḥekaṃmukhaṃ tu yasya syāt pratipūraṃ vrajedihatrimukhī ca yadā syād vaiśastraghātādikaṃ na hijale tu mucyamānāsānatarenmajjati kṣaṇātjalemajjati sā jñātvā dhāryādharmavivṛddhaye || 4avadhyatvaṃ pratisroto vahnistaṃbhaṃ karoti catrivaktro hyagnijanmātha pāparāśiṃpraṇāśayetpaṃcavaktrastu kālāgniragamyāgamapāpanutsaptavaktrastvanaṃtassyāt svarṇasteyādi pāpahṛtbhairavonavavaktrastu śivasāyujyakārakaḥekādaśamukhorudro nānāyajñaphalapradaḥtrayodaśamukhaḥ kāmaḥ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥcaturdaśāsyaśśrīkaṃṭho vaṃśoddhārakarassmṛtaḥyatraliṃgāni śaivāni tatrasannihitaḥ śivaḥviśveśvaro vā viṣṇurvā brahmā vā na bhaviṣyatinamaste astubhagavannityādi śrutibhissadāsomaḥpavate ityādi śrutyāsomaḥ sadāśivaḥīśānaḥ sarvavidyānāmityādi śrutibhirmuhuḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dhattebjaṃ śārikāvīṇāṃḍamarveṇa varābhayān || 1 || aruṇavarṇaḥvṛṣasthā śārikāmabjaṃkarairdhatte varābhayau || 1 || śyāmavarṇaḥekavaktrātaṭidgairīdhatte padmavarābhayān || 1 || hemavarṇaḥdhattekaraiḥ paṃcavaktrāphullapadmāsanāruṇā || 1 || raktavarṇaḥphākhyāśukaiṇāsikheṭavarābhayadharāśarānpāśaṃcaḍamṛgaṃdhatte krameṇadaśabhiḥkaraiḥ || pāṭalavarṇaḥdhattekrameṇadaśabhiḥkaraiḥ pūrvavadāyudhān || 1 || babhruvarṇaḥudyadravinibhādhatteśaracāpavarābhayān || 1 || siṃdūravarṇaḥvīṇāvādana tattvajñāvarābhayakarāśubhā || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥśūlacāpeṣu pāśāsikheṭadānābhayānvitā || 1 || śubhravarṇaḥpaṃcāsyāṣṭakarairdhatte dakṣavāmakrameṇa sā || 1 || khaḍgakheṭāṃkuśagadāpāśaśūlavarābhayān || śyāmavarṇaḥṣaḍbhujāṃkuśaśūlāsikheṭadānābhayānvitā || 1 || svarṇavarṇaḥsphuṭapadmāsanādhatte padmadvayavarābhayān || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥsahasrapadmapīṭhasthā divyābharaṇabhūṣitācaturbhujākarairdhatte padmadvayavarābhayān || kanakavarṇaḥpītāṃbarākarairdhatte padmadvayavarābhayān || 1 || raktavarṇaḥpāṭalābhākarairdhatte cidaṃbujavarābhayān || 1 || pāṭalavarṇaḥpāṭalābhākarairdhatte cidaṃbujavarābhayān || 1 || pāṭalavarṇaḥṣaḍbhujāṃkuśaśūlāsikheṭadānābhayānvitā || 1 || svarṇavarṇaḥpaṃcāsyā pāṭalādhatte khaḍgaśūlavarābhayān || 1 || pāṭalavarṇaḥśrīnārāyaṇodevatā (śeṣasaṃhitāyām) nārāyaṇonīlotpaladalaprabhaḥ paṃkajāṃtaḥ sthitaḥ pītāṃbaraḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ śrībhūbhyāṃsahitaḥ śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaḥviṣṇurdevatā (pādmasaṃhitāyām) padmakiṃjalkavarṇaḥ pītāṃbaraḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ gadāpaṃkajaśaṃkhāridharaḥmadhusūdanodevatā (pādmasaṃhitāyām) aruṇapaṃkajavarṇaḥ pītāṃbaraḥ cakraśaṃkhābjagadādharaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ sthitaḥtrivikramodevatā (pādmasaṃhitāyām) kālānalavarṇaḥ pītavāsāḥ padmadaṃḍāriśaṃkhadharaḥ sarvābharaṇayuktaḥ sthitaḥvāmanodevatā (pādmasaṃhitāyām) bālārkavarṇaḥ pītavastraḥ śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaḥ ābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ sthitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: umayāsahito devassoma ityabhidhīyaterudrākṣadhārakassoma itiśāstravidoviduḥbāhvoriṃdoḥ kalābhiḥ nayanayugakṛtepyekamekaṃśikhāyāṃ vakṣasyaṣṭādhikaṃ yaḥ kalayatiśatakaṃ sa svayaṃ nīlakaṃṭhaḥabhasmarudrākṣadharoyadi syād dvijonatasyāsti phalopapattiḥśrutismṛtibhyāmiha codyamānā vibhūtirudrākṣa dhṛtissamānārudrākṣaṃdhārayetprājñaśśivapūjāparāyaṇaḥduṣṭacittādurācārāduṣprajā apimānavāḥtrissaptakulamuddhṛtyarudralokaṃ sa gacchatimlecchovāpyatha caṃḍālo yukto vā sarvapātakaiḥkhādanmāṃsaṃpibanmadyaṃ saṃgacchaṃnnaṃ tyajāmapisarvayajñatapodānairvedābhyāsaiśca yatphalamśirasādhāraṇe koṭiḥ karṇayordaśakoṭayaḥayutaṃcopavīte tu lakṣakoṭirbhuje dhṛterudrākṣadhāraṇācchreṣṭhaṃ na kiṃcidiha vidyateyaḥ punarmaṃtrasaṃyuktaṃ dhārayedbhaktito naraḥśatakoṭiguṇaṃpuṇyaṃ dhāraṇāllabhate naraḥjapāccalabhate puṇyaṃ nātrakāryā vicāraṇātasya puṇyaphalasyāṃtaṃ na cāhaṃ vaktumutsahekimuyedhārayaṃtismanarārudrākṣamālikāḥmucyate sarvapāpebhyo rudrākṣasya ca dhāraṇātsarvapāpavinirmuktassayāti paramāṃ gatimabhijño vā na bhijño vā rudrākṣasya tu dhāraṇātrudrākṣaṃdhārayetprājñaśśivapūjāparāyaṇaḥavṛttaṃ yamalaṃ vakramaṣṭāvetānvivarjayetnavyaṃparaṃparāprāptaṃ dhāryaṃ rudrākṣamuttamam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dṛṣṭvonnatāsane sthitvā rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajetjapastu śaṃkhamaṇināśatamaṣṭottara bhavetpadmākṣeṇa sahasraṃ syāt sphaṭikenā yutatrayamatassarvaprayatnena rudrākṣaissarvadā japetpuruṣo vai rudra itiśrutireṣāyatomatāsarvavyāpī ca bhagavān tasmāt sarvagataḥ śivaḥsunirmalamidaṃśāṃtamīśānajyotiravyayammanasākarmaṇāvācā śivaṃ yo bhajate sadāmuktimuktāvarṣakopaṃ śivamaṃtraḥ śrutiśrutaḥmokṣārthī tu śivādanyaṃ yaḥ pūjayitumicchatisa unmatta itijñeyo vedamārgādbahiṣkṛtaḥyasmin kule samutpannaḥ śivapūjāparo bhavetdadau vaikuṃṭhamamalamatodevottamaḥ śivaḥtadanyaṃ nastuvaṃtyeva matodevottamaḥ śivaḥsatyaṃsatyaṃpunassatyamuddhṛtyabhujamucyatepuṇyasaṃghaikanilayaṃ śiva ityakṣaradvayamyatraśaivāḥ śivaparāstatrasannihitaḥ śivaḥdurlabhāśāṃbhavī vidyā śivebhaktiśca durlabhākālamṛtyurna cāyāti kimutānye ca mṛtyavaḥpūjayasva mahādevaṃ tasmānmā pramado'bhavamśaṃkarārcana yogyāni bhavaṃtīti hinaḥ śrutamarpitānyapi bilvāni prakṣālya ca punaḥ punaḥśuṣkaṃ khaṃḍitamārdraṃ vā bilvapatraṃ śivapriyamsaṃpādyapūjayaṃtīśaṃ navālābhe vicakṣaṇāḥvinikṣipyamahāpāpairmucyate nātrasaṃśayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tathānānyenasuprīto bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥbilvapatraṃ vināpūjā na sāṃgāpārvatī pateḥvastrādidānatopyetadbhavatyeva hi puṇyadambilvapatrārthamanyattu na bhavatyeva sarvathātatopikoṭiguṇitaṃ bilvapatrārcane prabhoḥsadyonaśyaṃti bilvena pūjite tu maheśvarebhoktavyamanyathāviprairanvahaṃ yāṃtiyātanāḥyatneṣu pūjanīyeṣu bilvapatraṃ viśiṣyateārdraṃ vā yadi vā śuṣkaṃ śīrṇaṃkhaṃḍitameva vāgaurīgaurāṃgakodbhūtasvedabiṃdusamudbhavaḥsā yujyādiphalāvāpti sādhanaṃ tarurāḍyataḥsvodyānodbhavavṛkṣasya svahastopārjitairnaraḥadhomukhairbilvapatrairatramesaṃśayo mahānmadhyapatre sthitassākṣāt sāṃbassarvārthasādhakaḥpṛṣṭabhāgesthitāyakṣā abhaktānāṃ niṣedhakāḥtato vai pūrvabhāgena pūjayedgirijāpatimadhomukhaṃ bilvapatraṃ śivasya vacanaṃ yathāpūjayetpārvatīnāthaṃ siktaṃ caṃdanavāriṇāmahākailāsabhavane śivena sahamodatepratyahaṃniyame neti prāhurjābālavādinaḥahorātrakṛtaṃpāpaṃ naśyatyeva hi nāradayaḥkuryādbhrūṇahāpāpānmucyate nātrasaṃśayaḥharanāmajapaṁllakṣaṃ brahmahatyāṃ vyayohatipūjayedgirijānāthaṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥtenirguṇā apiguṇāṃbudhayobhavaṃti viṃdaṃtimuktimupabhuktasamastabhogāḥ

sanskrit: kariṣyatyavatāraṃsvaṃ śaṃkaro nīlalohitaḥupadekṣyatitajjñānaṃśiṣyāṇāṃ brahmasammitamsarvavedāntasāraṃ ca dharmānvedanidarśanānbrāhmaṇaḥ pūjayet paṃca paṃcayajñaparāyaṇaḥ || 1brahmeśvaraubhūtabalirgaṇādhipoyajñeśvarāssyuryajanīyadevatāḥ (?)dhyānasyavighnāpanudaṃbikāsutojñānapradaḥsthāṇuritīryate budhaiḥ(gaṇeśapaṃcāyatanam) - laṃbodare'jeśvarenāryāḥ - śaṃkaradiṅmukhāstuśubhadāḥ vyatyastato hānidāḥmadhyasthitasya devasya devā īśānyataḥ śubhāḥdevasyamukhamārabhyadiśaṃprācīṃprakṛlpayetaṣṭadhārāmamūrtiḥsyādvīrarāmādibhedataḥ || 1kodaṃḍaṃkukkuṭāṃḍābhaṃśyāmalaṃpratibibhratamdhanurākṛtikārekhā dṛśyate pārśvayordvayoḥpṛṣṭhato vā bhavedyasya daśakaṃṭhakulāṃtakaḥcāpabāṇāṃkuśacchatradhvajacāmarasaṃyutaḥsarvābhīṣṭapradaścoktaḥ sarvatravijayapradaḥ || 2bāṇataṇīracāpāḍhyasītārāmaḥ sraganvitaḥekenadhanuṣāyukto vartulaḥ kiṃcidāyataḥ || 2dakṣabhāgepaṃcarekhāścāpobāṇaśca pārśvayoḥdivyabāṇenasaṃyuktaścāpatūṇīrasaṃgataḥ || 1yasyādvijayarāmākhyaḥ kesarāpītacakrakaḥ || 1hṛṣṭarāma itikhyāto bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ || 1dadhāccakraṃsuvadanakṛṣṇavarṇaḥsuśobhanaḥ || 1(sadārāmamūrtiḥ) - sudārāmastuvijñeyaḥpūjitassuphalapradaḥkṛṣṇaḥpītaḥśvetatanuḥ bhittipārśve tu cakrayukkṛṣṇovṛttākṛtissākṣātsarveṣāṃpāpanāśanaḥ

sanskrit: śrīdharodevatā pītavarṇaḥ pītavastraḥ padmacakragadāśaṃkhadharaḥ bhūṣāyuktaḥ sthitaḥhṛṣīkeśodevatā taḍidvarṇaḥ pītavastraḥ gadāripadmaśaṃkhadharaḥ bhūṣāyuktaḥ sthitaḥpadmanābhodevatā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ jvālākeśaḥ sthitaḥvāṇīdevatā sphaṭikavarṇā akṣamālāpadmaśukapustakadharā prādakṣiṇyena sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitāśārṅgadhārīdevatā hemanibhaḥ narākṛtiḥ dakṣiṇahaste tarjanīmudrānvitaḥ vāmahastenakaṭimavalaṃbya sthitaḥ svacihnāṃkitamastakaḥ sthitaḥnaṃdakodevatā dūrvādalaśyāmaḥ narākṛtiḥ dakṣiṇahaste tarjanīmudrānvitaḥ kaṭivinyastavāmahastaḥ svacihnāṃkitamastakaḥnaṃdakodevatā śeṣaṃ pūrvavatyamodevatā kālavarṇaḥ abhayadaṃḍapāśavarahastaḥ mahiṣārūḍhaḥ karālavadanaḥmusalīdevatā sasyaśyāmaḥ narākṛtiḥ dakṣiṇahaste tarjanīmudrānvitaḥ kaṭivinyastavāmahastaḥ mastake svahnāṃkitaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥaṃkuśadhārīdevatā hemavarṇaḥ narākṛtiḥ dakṣiṇahaste tarjanīmudrānvitaḥ kaṭivinyastavāmahastaḥ svacihnāṃkitamastakaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥbhṛgurdevatā dūrvādalaśyāmaḥ dakṣiṇahaste vijñānamudrāṃ vāme pustakaṃ ca dadhānaḥ upavītajaṭādibhiryuktaḥkūrmodevatā kāṃcanasannibhaḥ abhayacakraśaṃkhavaradahastaḥ pītāṃbaradharaḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥpaṭṭābhirāmodevatā śyāmavarṇaḥ pīṭhe madhyesukhāsīnaḥ tadvāme hemavarṇāsītāpurataḥ kanakavarṇo hanumān paścime hemavarṇolakṣmaṇaḥ pārśvayoḥ śyāmavarṇo bharataḥ raktavarṇaḥ śatrughnaśca vāyavye hemapiṅgalaḥ sugrīvaḥ kālavarṇovibhīṣaṇaḥ raktavarṇoṃgadaḥ kanakavarṇo jāṃbabān etaiḥ parivṛtaḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥgaruḍodevatā kāṃcanaprabhaḥ kuṃcitadakṣiṇapādaḥ pṛṣṭhenikṣipta vāmapādaḥ prasāritobhayapakṣaḥ hṛdibaddhāṃjalipuṭaḥ nānābharaṇabhuṣitaḥ

sanskrit: tiṣṭhanti brahmanikaṭe tasmādupaniṣatsmṛtāmokṣaikahetubhūtāni nṛṇāṃ śravaṇamātrataḥvidhimantrārthavādāśca vedeṣu gaditāstrayaḥmīmāṃsā śāstramaparaṃturyaṃ vedāṃtanāmakamṣaḍetāni hi śāstrāṇi jagadetairniyamyate || 2tarkaśāstrānnītiśāstraṃ nānāthaparibṛṃhitammīmāṃsāśāstrato dharma śāstraṃ karma kriyāhvayamyogaśāstrāttatvaśāstramātmajñānapradarśanamsaṃgṛhītānimunibhirupaśāstrāṇi yāni ca || 4śabdaśāstraṃ mahābhāṣyaṃ sūtravyākaraṇānvitam || 1sūtraṃ bhāṣyaṃ vārtikaṃ ca trayaṃśāstreṣu varṇyateākṣeposyasamādhānaṃ vyākhyānaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ matam || 1nāradīyāhvayaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ mārkaḍeyaṃ tu saptamamlaiṃgyaṃ vārāhakaṃskāṃdaṃ vāmanaṃ kaurmameva caaṣṭādaśaprabhedāni vyāsenoktānibhāmini || 3cāturlakṣa 400000 pramāṇena cakrepārāśaromuniḥskāṃdaṃ ca śivadharmākhyaṃ daurvākhyaṃ nāradīyakamvāruṇaṃ kālikākhyaṃ ca māheśvarasamīritametānyupapurāṇāni vedavyāsoditānihi || 4śaivavaiṣṇavasārākhyairaticitrakathānvitaiḥpurāṇābhinnānyanyānikānicitsaṃtibhāminiitihāsottamaṃ tadvaditihāsasamuccayamśeṣadhārmahvayaścānyaḥ kathitolokapāvanaḥ || 2teṣvādimohariścandramāhātmyakathanakramaḥcaturthastunalodaṃtassaudāsodaṃta eva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatorukmāṃgadodaṃtodauṣyaṃtodaṃta eva caśivadharmāhvayaṃ śāstraṃ viṣṇudharmāhvayaṃ tathāpurāṇabhinnānyetānikīrtitānimanīṣibhiḥ || 5vaidyādharastu prathamonānācitrakathāśrayaḥyāyātastucaturthassyātpaṃcamomohanāhvayaḥete sarvārthadātaṇāṃ śravaṇātpāpahāriṇaḥ || 3tṛtīyaṣṣoḍaśīkalpaḥ kalpaḥ pañcākṣarābhidhaḥrāmatārakakalpaśca śūlinī kalpa eva catatodhūmāvatīkalpaśśītalākalpa eva calakṣmīnṛsiṃhakalpaśca kuhūkalpastataḥ paramaśvatthakalpaḥ tulajābhavānīkalpa eva catathaivabagalākalpaḥ kalpovaṭukabhairavaḥrājamātaṅgikākalpaḥ kalpobrahmāstranāmakaḥdattātreyābhidhaḥ kalpaḥ kārtavīryābhidhaḥ parametekalpāvedamūrti saṃkhyākāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 9śātatapovasiṣṭhaśca yamāpastaṃbagautamāḥśaunakoyājñavalkyaścetyaṣṭādaśamunīśvarāḥetaiḥ pravartitāloke smṛtayoṣṭādaśottamāḥjābālirnāciketaśca skaṃdalokākṣikaśyapāḥvyāghraḥ kātyāyanobabhruḥ jātūkarṇaḥ kapirnalaḥsumaṃturetemunayastathopasmṛtikāriṇaḥ || 3prāyaścitta kramaḥśrāddhaṃ paṃcasmṛtiṣuyojitāḥ || 1vaṃśānucaritaṃ caiva purāṇeṣu prakīrtyate || 1udyānasalilakrīḍāmadhupānaratotsavāḥmaṃtraṃdyūtapramāṇāni nāyakābhyudayastathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kāvyetvaṣṭādaśavidhāvaṇyartakāvyavedibhiḥādauvaidikataṃtrāṇāmanukramaṇikocyateāruṇeśvarataṃtraṃ ca viśuddheśvaranāmakamkālāsāraṃ kālavādataṃtraṃ yogīśvarī śatampaścimāmnāyakābhikhyamuttarāmnāyanāmakamkuṃḍīśvaramataṃ vīṇātaṃtraṃ guhyāhvayaṃ ca tathṛdbhedaṃ mātṛbhedaṃ ca vātulaṃ vātulottarambahurūpāṣṭakaṃ caiva yāmalāṣṭakameva caanusṛtyatuvedoktakarmāṇyanucaraṃtihi || 8mahāmāyāśaṃbaraṃ ca yoginījālaśaṃbarammahāsaṃmohanaṃ caiva rūpikāmatameva capariśiṣṭānaṃdataṃtramamareśvarameva capaṃcāmṛtaṃ ca kalyāṇaṃ bhūtākhyaṃ vaibhavāṣṭakammahākālīmataṃ caiva mahāvīrāvatīmatammahākuleśvarīcūḍāmaṇitaṃtramanuttamamtrayastriṃśatprabhedāni hyavaidikavatāṃ nṛṇām || 33 || - ||mahāmāyāśambaraṃ ca yoginījālaśambarambahurūpāṣṭhakaṃ caiva pātalāṣṭakameva cavāmajaṣṭaṃ mahādevaṃ vātūlaṃ vātulottaramkalāvādaṃ kalāsāraṃ tathānyatkuṇḍikā matampañcāmṛtaṃ rūpabhedaṃ bhūtoḍḍāmarameva casarvajñānottamaṃ caiva mahākālīmataṃ tathāpūrvapaścimadakṣaṃ cāpyattaraṃ ca niruttaramvimalaṃ vimalorjaṃ ca devīmatamataḥ paramkaṃkālabhairavaṃ taṃtraṃ kālāgnyākhyaṃ ca bhairavam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahābhairavataṃtraṃ ca tathā bhairavanāthakam || 2indrāṇī caiva cāmuṇḍā śivadūtī kumārikāetannāmānitantrāṇi bahurūpāṣṭakānihimaṃtrārṇavaṃ maṃtrasāraṃ mahākālaṃ tu śāṃbhavamuḍḍāmareśvaraṃ rājataṃtraṃ lākulīkeśvaramsaubhāgyavallarītaṃtraṃ tālaṃ caṃḍeśvaraṃ tathāpaṃcavakrasya vakrebhyaḥ paṃcabhyaḥ parijajñire || 4teṣāmādyaḥ kāmikākhyo dvitīyaḥ kāraṇāgamaḥyogajaścaiva vedasya sadyojātamukhāccayutāḥsvāyaṃbhuvanalānāmatvaghoramukhasaṃbhavāḥbiṃbākhyovimalākhyaśca mukhāttatpuruṣāccyutāḥsarvottaraśca saṃtāna kiraṇau pārameśvaraḥpāñcarātrāgamaḥ proktaḥ kāraṇāgama eva caṛtusaṃkhyāstu vijñeyā āgamāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 2vijñānalalitaṃ ceti catvāro vaiṣṇavāgamāḥ || 1ṣaṇnavatyuttaraśatasaṃkhyākāḥ parijajñire || 1hayagrīvaśca garbhaśca śaunako manureva cavyāsobṛhaspatiścaiva yamogautama eva caśātātapovāmadevo vṛddhaśātātapastathājābālirjailanityaśca jānaṃntirjahnureva caśālihotraḥ suhotraśca vasuhotrastadanaṃtaraḥnityahotraḥ prāṇahotraḥ sahastotrastathaiva capṛgādhacūlībhṛgavaḥ suyajñaśca tataḥ paramvṛṃdāvanaścolūkaśca vātsyāyanamṛkaṃḍukaukapilonaidhruvaḥ kāśyapa evaṃ ṛṣyaśṛṃgakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: medhātithiścalaugākṣiḥ śuddhakālapradīpakaubṛhadukthyaḥ kapiścaivahārītaḥ kutsa eva cabāṣkalaśca phaṇīpūtimāṣonakula eva cayoganārāyaṇīyāṃśuratnamālyābhidhāstathāsanatsujātoyavanovālakhilya iti kramātvedopavedavedāṃgā gamataṃtrakramādikamtattatkartṛprabhedaśca kīrtitaścaivamatrahiśuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśastripuṃḍrāṃkitamastakaḥbaddhapadmāsanodvyaṣṭabhujaiḥ khaṭvāṃgaśūlakecinmudrikāṃcākṣamālāṃ pustakaṃ ca kamaṃḍalumśvetavarṇaḥbaddhapadmāsanaḥ proktaḥ śvetavarṇaścaturmukhaḥcinmudrāṃpustukaṃkuṃḍīmakṣaṃdakṣāditaḥ kramātjaṭībaddhakirīṭī ca sadādadyācchubhāninaḥśetavarṇaḥbrahmacārīgṛhasthaśca vānaprasthaśca bhikṣukaḥṭīku - taṃtrasāroktavāda upadeśapaṭaladalli brahmavettarugaliṃda helalpaṭṭiruvadenaṃdarebrahmacāriyu gṛhasthanu vānaprasthanu yatiyuaśreṣṭhānāṃ hareśre'ṣṭhā guravaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 2ṭīku - varṇāśramātītanāda avadhūtayogiyu yī aidujanaru yogyarāgiddare vabbarigiṃtavabbaru śreṣṭharādaguruvenisuvaru | yalai viṣṇuve tamage yogyatekaḍameyāgiddare tamagiṃta śreṣṭharu kramavāgi gurugalenisikkolluvaru | adu hyāgeṃdarevidyotkarṣabalenaiva gururbhavatinānyathāṭīku - gṛhasthāśramavaṃtanige brahmacāriyu yatige vānaprasthanu vidyotkarṣabaladiṃda mātrave guruvenisuvanu | mattoṃduprakāradiṃdalu āgubadillāvidyotkarṣabalenaiva gururbhavatinānyathāṭīku - hāge hṛhasthanu vānprasthanige guruvāguvanu | vanasthanu yatigū guruvāguvanu | yalai kamalākṣane āśramadallikaḍameyādāgyu vidyotkarṣadiṃda śreṣṭhanāgiruvanendu anisikkolluvanu yī arthadallisaṃśayavillavidyotkarṣabalenaivagururbhavatinānyathāṭīku - hāge vānaprasthanu saṃnyāsigu guruvāguvanu | yalai puruṣottamane varṇāśramagalannu atikramiśiruva avadhūtayogiyādāgyu vidyābalavilladiddare guruvāguvadilla
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nakasyāpibhavecchiṣyo yathāhaṃ puruṣottamaṭīku - kalai viṣṇuve varṇāśramagalannatikramiśida yogiyu sarvarigiṃtalu śreṣṭhanāguvanu | ātanu tannaṃte yārigū śiṣyanāguvadillaathavā brahmavitprājño yogyābhāvetayorvaraḥṭīku - matteneṃdare stīyarigu śūdrarigu upadeṃśavannu māḍuva gurutvādhikāravu illave ila | ādaru strīyarige patiyemukhyaguruvu | ātanigiṃtalu taṃdeyu guruvenisuvanu | avaribbarigu maṃtropadeśamāḍaluyogyateyu sāladiddalli brahmajñāniye uttama guruvenisuvanupurāṇapaṭhanemaṃtre jñānamārgapradarśaneṭīku - śūdrarige purāṇapāṭhavannu maṃtropadeśavannu jñānopadeśavannu māḍuvadakku tamagiṃtalu vaiśya kṣatriya brāhmaṇa yī kramadiṃda vabbarigiṃtavabbaru uttamottamaguruvenisuvaruvratamaṃtropavāsesyādanyathāniṣphalaṃ bhavetṭīku - strīyarunalige maṃtropavāsamodalāda taṃtramārgādhikāramātrave patiyājñeyiṃda uṃṭāguvadu | patiya ājñeyillade prabartisalusakalavu niṣphalavāguvaduabhāvejanakasyājñānaṃ svātaṃtryaṃ bhavet striyaḥṭīku - strīyarige patiye mukhyaguruvāddariṃda avanige maṃtropadeśadayogyateyilladiddare avana ājñeyiṃdale mattobbaguruvannu āsrayisabeku | avanataruvāya taṃdeya ājñeyanāśrayisabeku | strīyarige svātaṃtryavillajātāśauce mṛtāśauce rajodoṣaprasūtiṣusuvāsinyāśśirasnānaṃ natvabhyaṃgaṃ vinā kvacitṭīku - śaivaratnākaradalli sūtasaṃhiteyalliruvadenaṃdare - suvāsinīyaru puṇyakṣetra puṇyatīrthagalalliyu grahaṇādipuṇyakāladalliyujātāśaucādigalalliyu rajasvale pādāgaluprasavavādāgalu putrīputravivāhadalliyu patiyu ācarisuva yāgādidīkṣegalalliyu śiraḥ snānavannu māḍabahudu | yī prakṛtagalallade abhyaṃgahoratāgi śiraḥsnānasarvathā yogyavallamadarcanaṃ hi kalyāṇyāni yogobhartturasti cetsānārīnirayaṃ yātinātrakāryā vicāraṇāṃpurāṇapaṭhanaṃ śreyā na vedādhyāyanādikamnamontaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃśāktaṃ śaivaṃvācānyadaivatammahāpātakadāvāgnissoyaṃ maṃtraḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥṭīku - nityavu gaurīpaṃcākṣarīmaṃtradiṃdale gaurīpūjeyaṃmāḍabeku | strīyarige praṇavavarjitavāgiyemaṃtropadeśavaṃmāḍatakkaddu | āddariṃdavaiṣṇavaśaktiśaivamaṃtragalu namoṃtavāgiye upadeśamāḍatakkaddu | yīmaṃtravu namoṃtavādakāraṇaklībamaṃtraveniśikolluvadu | āddariṃdayidekramaddiṃdale strīyarige upadeśavaṃ māḍabeku | brahmottarakhaṃḍadalli heliruvadeneṃdare praṇavayuktavāda yī maṃtrave mahāpātakagalige dāvāgnisvarūpavāda ṣaḍakṣarīyanisuduyidemaṃtraveṃ praṇavarahitavādare paṃcākṣarīyanisikkolluvadunālaṃkriyānahomaśca na saṃskāro na tarpaṇamprāṇāyāma manenaiva tenaivācamanaṃ varampratimāsvarcayed viṣṇuṃ devīṃ vāgarikanyakāmdevatāyāḥ kalāhvānaṃ na pratiṣṭhāvidhistriyāḥṭīku - strīyarugalu śivapūjeyannu gaurrīpūjeyannu yidemaṃtradiṃdale māḍatakkaddu | yāva ākṛti yannu yiriśipūjisebeṃkadare viṣṇuvannu gauriyanniriśikoṃḍepūjisatakkaddu | īśvaranaṃpūjisabekādare śivaliṃgavanniriśikkoṃḍepūjisatakkaddu | migilādadevategalannumaṃḍaladalliyepūjisatakkaddu | yiṣṭehoratu strīyarugalige devatā kāla āvāhaneyu prāṇapratiṣṭhāvidhānavukaḍadu | āddariṃdapuruṣariṃda prāṇapratiṣṭhitavāda liṃgavigrahagalannu pūrvoktarītiyiṃdalepūjisabeku || (maṇḍalavaṃdare raṃgavalyādicitra)paṃcame tu dvayaṃ proktamabdānāṃ varṇakaṃ budhaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṛtūnāṃ tu trayaṃmutau netrasaṃkhyā trayaṃ tathāyugasaṃkhyā dvayaṃproktaṃ māsānāṃ varṇato mayādvisaṃkhyāyāṃ trayaṃproktaṃ tithīnāṃ varṇitā budhaiḥekaṃ vai yugasaṃkhyāyāṃ vārāṇāṃ kathito janaiḥaṣṭakaṃ ca dvisaṃkhyāyāṃ traye caikādaśa smṛtāḥdvisaṃkhyāyāṃ paṃcadaśatraye caiva daśa smṛtāḥaṣṭake tu trivarṇāḥ syurakṣisaṃkhyā dvayaṃ tathādvisaṃkhyāyāṃ rasāḥ proktāstrisaṃkhyāpaṃcakaṃ tathāvedasaṃkhyā dvayaṃproktaṃ dvisaṃkhyā ṛṣayastathāśakeśālīvāhanasya catuṣpañcamunīndukeśrīmaccaṇḍī kṛpādṛṣṭyā kathitākṛṣṇabhūbhujāabdādigrahaparyaṃtā varṇasaṃkhyā satāṃ mudeiti śrīmatsamastabhūmaṃḍalamaṃḍanāyamānānikhiladeśāvataṃsakarnāṭakajana-padādhiṣṭhānabhūta- śrīmanmahīśūramahāsaṃsthānamadhyadedīpyamānāvikalakalānidhikulakramāgata-rājakṣitipālapramukhanikhilanijarājādhirājamahārājacakravartimaṃḍalānubhūta-divyaratnasiṃhāsanārūḍhaśrīmadrājādhirājarājaparameśvaraprauḍhapratāpāprati-mavīranarapatibirudeṃteṃbaragaṃḍalokaikavīrayadukūlapayaḥ pārāvārakalānidhiśaṃkhacakrāṃkuśakuṭhāramakaramatsyaśarabhasālvagaṃḍa-bheruṃḍadharaṇīvarāhahanumadgaruḍakaṃṭhīravādyanekabirudāṃkitaśrīmanmahī-śūrapuravarādhīśaśrīkṛṣṇarājamahārājaviracite śrītattvanidhyākhyagraṃthe āgamādinirūpaṇaṃnāma aṣṭamonidhissaṃpūrṇaḥiti śrītattvanidhyākhyagranthe - aṣṭama āgamanidhissaṃpūrṇaḥsenānīrvīrabhadraśca rāmakṛṣṇaumahāphaṇīmanmathomohinī caiva kramāt ṣoḍaśadevatāḥrājārājñīrathovājī padātirdhvaja eva caataḥ paraṃ tu vijñeyāścakravartipadaṃgatāḥrājarājeśvarī cādau kālīlakṣmīḥ sarasvatīvārāhī ca tatheṃdrāṇī daṃḍinī maṃtriṇī tathāiṃdrākṣī cānnapūrṇā ca tathāṣaṭcakradevatāḥādau cāmuṃḍikārpyāṇihaṃsapatrāṇi sapta vaitattadaṃkānusāreṇakhelanīyyāvicakṣaṇaiḥdakṣavakraṃ hanūmāṃśca vaṭacchadaśayastathāmakarassyātpañcabāṇā hastasthaśśuka eva ca

sanskrit: sauvarṇaiścātiraktaiśca pāṭalaiḥśśvaitavarṇakaiḥsaindūrasthālathalyenayutoharita eva cavartirūpastathāgauroraktotyasitavarṇayukṣoḍaśānāṃ ca jātīnāṃ rājarājeśvarī kramātśukacchadānāṃvarṇastu raktojñeyovicakṣaṇaiḥsarveṣāmekarūpeṇa raktovarṇastu nānyathācāmuṇḍāyāḥ krīḍanakepradhānācaṇḍikā smṛtāekaikapatrarītyā tu caturṇāṃ patrikā tadāpṛthakcaturbhirgrāhyāḥ syurviṃśatiḥ kuśalaiḥ smṛtāḥrājādimīnaparyantaṃ dūrbalaṃ hyuttarottaramsvīyapatreṣu yacchreṣṭhaṃ tatpradāyamanīṣiṇādvitīye haṃsaparyāye caṇḍikābhāgapūrikācāmuṇḍāyai samarpyāṇi haṃsapatrāṇi nānyathākrīḍātvādausvapatreṣu prabalaṃ tulyajātikamyenapradīyate tatra prabalaṃ hyādadītasaḥyenānte krīḍane dattaṃ jayinaṃtaṃ vinirdiśetparityajyaviśeṣoktīragrimakrīḍaneṣuvaiśrīcāmuṇḍākṛpālabdhalakṣmīvāṇīsamṛddhināāṣāḍhe citrabhānostu śuklaikādaśake ravauchūṭa cakravartigala yalegalu 25 kke (1) - mahākālī (1) - mahālakṣmī (1) - mahāsarasvatī (1) - brāhmī (1) - māheśvarī (1) - kaumārī (1) - vaiṣṇavī (1) - vārāhī (1) - iṃdrāṇī (1) - maṃtriṇīśyāmalā (1) - daṃḍinīvārāhī (1) - yoganidrā (1) - bālā (1) - bhuvaneśvarī (1) - iṃdrākṣī (1) - annapūrṇā (1) -śarīrasthaṣaṭcakradevategalu (1) - śākinī (1) - kākinī (1) - lākinī (1) - rākinī (1) ḍākinī (1) - hākinī (1) - vāgīśvarī (1) - ratidevī || vaṭṭu ī 25 yalegaligu igalīkadabaṇṇa || - || cāmuṇḍeśvarī mīrā baṃdavara āṭave modalāguvaddariṃda cāmuṃḍeśvarī hukumige koḍatakka iṃgalīkada baṇṇavulla haṃseyalegalutāṃḍavaścaivakaṃkālomatsyādyādaśamūrtayaḥekasyādevatāyāstu smṛtisaṅkhyāmitacchadāḥekādirāśisaṃkhyāntaṃ tattaccihnaṃ pravakṣyatematsyaḥ kūrmo varāhaśca mṛgarājaḥ kamaṇḍaluḥhaṃsomataṅgajaścaiva jñātavyāḥ kramaśo budhaiḥ

sanskrit: vināyakaśca śrīkaṇṭhaḥ kālīlakṣmīḥ sarasvatīvārāhī ca tatheṃdrāṇī vaṭapatraśayohariḥvaikuṇṭheśohariharohyardhanārīśamanmathauliṃgodbhavogajaharorājagopāla ityamūḥśukānāṃ navapatrāṇi cāmuṇḍārpyāṇi cāgrataḥtattaccihnānusāreṇa khelanīyā vicakṣaṇaiḥcaṇḍīmukhyātvatrarājñīśeṣaṃ prāgvadbhaveddhruvamdeyonānyastu tatsattveśukānāṃ patrikāsvapicatvāro vā pañcavāsyuḥ krīḍakāstvatrakhelanebhāgāstu viṃśatissyurvai catuṣpatra krameṇa cacakravarticchada iti lakṣayeccakravartināmsauvarṇaścitravarṇaśca pāṭalaścaiva caṃpakaḥpītaśca vartivarṇaśca haricchvetenasaṃyutaḥkṛṣṇaśca haritaḥ śveta yutovarṇastu pāṭalaḥanyeṣāṃ vai cakravarti śukānāṃ svarṇa varṇakaḥkrīḍakāyatrapañcasyuśchadā vā saptatiḥ pṛthakbhāgā aṣṭādaśaivaṃ syuḥ krīḍakāṇāṃ krameṇavaikṛṣṇajātivibhāgeṣvantimepatre tu mohinīgarutmatpatrikāyena khelanente pradīyateśakeśālīvāhanasya ṅaghaḍendu miteśśubheśrīcāmuṇḍādayābhājā kṛṣṇarājakṣamābhujārāmārāmaścarāmaśca kṛṣṇaḥ kalkī ca mohinīrājārājñīrathovājī padātirdhvaja eva caataḥparaṃ tu vijñeyāścakravartipadāṃkitāḥgajānanaśca senānīḥ sūryaścandrodigīśvarāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: devyāśchatrādidhāriṇyassaptapatreṣu ceṭikāḥtattadaṃkānusāreṇa khelanīyā vicakṣaṇaiḥtrayāṇāṃkrīḍane caivaṃ viśeṣojñāyatāmiyāncakravarticchadāstena smṛtā ekoviṃśatiḥahardivaṃsyāccāmuṇḍārājñītasmādvicakṣaṇaiḥmohinījātibhāgeṣvanti maṃmīnāṃkitaṃ chadamavarṇāstveṣāṃ yathāpūrvaṃ kalpyāssyuratiyuktitaḥśrīcamuṇḍākṛpātrakṛṣṇarājamahībhujāekaikasya tu devasya pṛthagaṣṭā daśacchadāḥmeṣādimīnaparyaṃtaṃ pūrvasmāddurbalaṃ parametaccihnānusāreṇa khelanīyā vicakṣaṇaiḥrājatoraktavarṇaśca haritpītaśca rājataḥjātayaśca dvādaśaikajāteraṣṭādaśacchadāḥjñeyaḥ krīḍākramaścaiva yathāpūrvamudīritaḥketujātaumīnapatramante yena pradīyateśrīcāmuṇḍākṛpāpūrṇakṛṣṇarājamahībhujānakulassahadevaśca kauravo bhīṣma eva caekaikasya tu nāthasya parvasaṃkhyāyutacchadāḥpatākācaikamārabhya sūryasaṃkhyā vadhikramātchurikāmuṣṭibāṇau ca pāśasarpakaśāḥ kramātdivākṛṣṇaṃ puraskṛtya rātrau tu parameśvaramatiraktaḥ pāṭalaśca śvetoraktastathaiva canīlaścitraṃ cetivarṇāśchadānāṃ saṃprakīrtitāḥviṣṇujātyantimaṃ patraṃ mohinyai yena dīyateśiṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ krīḍanādi caṇḍikāvatsmṛtaṃ budhaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: racitāvardhatāṃ nityaṃ mahābhārata peṭikāmahālakṣmīstṛtīyā ca kamalāsanasaṃsthitābrāhmīmāheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathāekasyā devatā yāstu purāṇagaṇitacchadāḥpattidhvajaucakraśaṃkhau mṛgedraśca mataṃgajaḥbakamatsyāvitiproktāḥ durbalāḥ parataḥ kramātsiṃdūraśvetavarṇau ca caṃpakaḥ pāṭalastathātattadvarṇānusāreṇakhelanīyāvicakṣaṇaiḥetaddevacchadāṃtaṃtu vakṣyantelakṣaṇāni vaimayūrogaruḍaścaiva mahiṣogaja eva cakrīḍakāśca bhavantyatra trayaścatvāra eva vākrīḍārambhastena kāryastvindrāṇyāścāntimacchadaḥśeṣaṃ sarvaṃ caṇḍikāyāḥ krīḍāvaditi tadvidaḥśrīkṛṣṇanṛpacandreṇaśaktikautukapeṭikāpavanodhanadaśceśo mohinitidaśa kramātrājārājñī rathovājī padātirdhvaja eva caetāsāṃ devatānāṃ tu tattacihnaṃ pravakṣyatesāraṃgāśvauvṛṣaśukaukramājjñeyābudhaiḥ sadāuktacihnānusāreṇa khelanīyā vicakṣaṇaiḥatiraktaḥ pāṭalaśca pītovaivartikā tathājāticihnānivakṣyante siṃhaśca kamalāsanaḥpārśvayoreka śiraso maṇḍaleravicandrayoḥrātrindivaṃ caṇḍikaivarājñīsyāttasya khelanamevaṃ vai mohinījāterantimaṃ śukapatrakamcāmuṇḍikākrīḍanavacchiṣṭaṃ jñeyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ

sanskrit: caturāṇāṃ vinodāyacakredikpālapeṭikāmhayagrīvaśca senānī mahendraśca rati priyaḥpṛthagekasyadevasya kalāsaṃkhyāmitacchadāḥekādidaśasaṃkhyāṃtaḥ pūrvasmāddurbalaḥ paraḥsiṃhovṛṣovānaraśca khagendrohaṃsaghoṭakaurājarājeśvarīcādau śrīkaṃṭhaśśarabhastathāvighneśastāṃḍavaścaiva divākaraniśākarauādaucāmuṇḍikārpyāṇi padmapatrāṇisapta vaiuktakramānusāreṇa khelanīyā vicakṣaṇaiḥśvetayukto haridvarṇaḥ śvetogairikavarṇakaḥcakravarticchadānāṃ ca padmānāṃ svarṇavarṇakaḥsvīyottamacchadaṃ dattvā caturbhiḥkhelanaṃ bhavetmārajāterantyapatraṃ śuka mohinikābhidhamcāmuṇḍikā krīḍanavacchiṣṭaṃ jñeyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥkalpitā ca vinodāya śrīmanohara peṭikāpuraṃdarodinakaroniśākararatipriyaupṛthagekasyadevasya purāṇa gaṇitacchadāḥmeṣādimīnaparyaṃtaṃ tattadevāṃkaśobhitāḥśrīkaṇṭhovighnarājaśca ṣaṇmukhovaṭapatragaḥkalāsaṃkhyāsamāyuktāḥ svatantrāścakravartinaḥsiṃhastriśūlaṃ cakraṃ ca haṃsovajrāyudhaṃ tathāsvarṇavarṇotiraktaśca pītaḥśveto harittathācakravarticchadānāṃ vai svarṇavarṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥmīnākhyokrīḍyate yena sajayyanye parājitāḥśrīcāmuṇḍākṛpāpūrṇa kṛṣṇarājakṣamābhujā

sanskrit: mahāsarasvatī caiva vīṇāvādanatatparātrayaṃ trayaṃ trayaṃ ceti navaitā devatāssmṛtāḥādaurājā tatorājñī maṃtrīsenāpatistathāpūrvaṃ proktāḥ chadāramyāḥ tattaddevāṃkaśobhitāḥrājarājeśvarīcādau daṃḍinīmaṃtriṇī tathāvārāhī ca tatheṃdrāṇī svataṃtrā navaśaktayaḥsarvaṃ militvā patrāṇāṃ ṣaṣṭyuttaraśataṃmatamsvarṇavarṇonīlapītaḥ vartivarṇaśca pītakaḥcandravarṇa itiproktā navaratnasya vai navamahācāmuṇḍikārājñī deyāsyai siṃhapatrikākrīḍārabhyā yasya haste cāmuṇḍāpatrikā bhavetyastusaṃkrīḍatente vaisajayyanye parājitāḥśrīcāmuṇḍākṛpāpūrṇaḥ kṛṣṇarājamahīpatiḥraktapītaharitkṛṣṇavarṇayuktā imematāḥrājārājñītathāmātyaḥ padātirdhvaja eva cabheruṇḍasālvaśarabhasiṃhamatte bhavājinaḥjātayassyuścatasrotrakṛṣṇeśa brahmavajriṇāmbhavedrātrindivaṃrājā kṛṣṇa eva yatastataḥkṛṣṇajātyantimaṃ patraṃ mīnadvayasulakṣitamathaibhirevakrīḍāsyācchadairanyāmanoharāpatrikāṇāṃ samākhyātāḥ saṃkhyāḥ krīḍanako vidaiḥcatasraśca padātessyurdhvajasyaikamitikramātekajātīyakaṃtasmai viṃśatirmukhyayostayoḥsaṃkhyā aṣṭādaśātrasyurjñeyāssaṅkhyā viśeṣataḥevaṃ saṅkhyāyena labdhāsajayyanye parājitāḥ

sanskrit: rājādayodhvajāntāssyurekajāticchadā yadāśrīmaccāmuṇḍikāpūrṇakaṭākṣaśubhalakṣitāekaikasya tu devasya māsasaṃkhyāyutacchadāḥvāhanaṃ cāyudhaṃchatraṃ rathohastī hayaḥ kramātetadvarṇānusāreṇakhelanīyā vicakṣaṇaiḥsarveṣumukhyā cāmuṇḍā rātrindivamitismṛtāśrīcāmuṇḍā dayāsāṃdra kṛṣṇarājendrakalpitāekaikasya tu devasya ratnasaṃkhyā yutacchadāḥmudrārājārājapatnī bhṛtyaśceti catuṣṭayampaṃcacchadānmelayitvā navakaṃ navakaṃ pṛthakāṅglacchadānāṃ krīḍevakrīḍeyaṃ parikīrtitākṛtālokopakārāyanavyā śrīrāma peṭikāekaikasmindale lekhyā adha ūrdhvābhigāminaḥekaikasmin koṣṭhakāni daletryaṣṭa krameṇa vaiyugadikpālāgni koṣṭhāni ṣoḍaśadaleṣu vaisarveṣvapiprakalpyaivaṃ tatraśārānvi nikṣipetathavātrasyuraṣṭeti jñeyaṃ krīḍāvicakṣaṇaiḥcatuḥśārakrameṇakṣāvakṣyante kramaśodhunāpītapaṭṭāḥ kṛṣṇapaṭṭāstathāharitapaṭṭakāḥūrdhvādhaḥ śvetapaṭṭāssyureta evaṃ prakīrtitāḥūrdhvādhaśca haritpaṭṭā ūrdhvādhaḥ kṛṣṇapaṭṭakāḥevaṃśārāścatuṣṣaṣṭiḥ krīḍakāṣṣoḍaśāṣṭavāḥekaikasminpārśvabhāge saṅkhyā sūcaka lakṣaṇamcaturastatraśārānvaisaṃsthāpya krīḍanaṃ bhavetsaṅkhyāvabodhanārthāni pārśveṣu syustuśārayoḥ

sanskrit: dvādaśaivaṃ ṣoḍaśetisumasaṅkhyā dvayostathāṣoḍaśānāṃ khelane syācchāra ekaḥ prakīrtitaḥśālīvāhaśakasyābde gha ṅachendumite śubheśrīcāmuṇḍākṛpāpūrṇa kṛṣṇarājamahībhujātisrovidhyastu ṛjavovīdhyāṃ koṣṭhāṣṭakaṃ caretsyussaṃhatyadaleṣveṣu dvinavatyuttaraṃ śatamvartulaṃ parikalpyātra catuśśārīṃ vinikṣipetkrīḍāṃraktāstathāpītāḥ kṛṣṇāharitavarṇakāḥūrdhvādhoharitāścordhvamadhaścaivāsitāstathāakṣau dvau pūrvavatkalpyau viśeṣastatra kathyateetadbhāgasyacottānekrīḍānātrapravartatekrīḍā tu suprasiddhākṣakrīḍāvaditi niścayaḥkharaphālgunaśuklasya hyekādaśyāṃbudhetviyamracitācāṣṭavaktrākṣakrīḍeyaṃ sumanoharādalamūle tu catvāri koṣṭhāniparikalpayetsaṃsthāpyārambhaṇaṃ kuryāt krīḍāyā iti nirṇayaḥṣaṭṣaṭśārā ekavarṇājñeyāḥ krīḍanakovidaiḥṣaṭkoṇākṣau tu vijñeyau daśāntaṃ sumakalpanamkhelanaṃ syāt prasiddhākṣa krīḍāvaditi niścayaḥphālgunasya siteśukre paurṇamāsyāmidaṃ kṛtamcaturāṇāṃ hitārthāya ṣaṇmukhākṣasukhelanampṛthagdale likhet tatra vīdhyastisrobhavanti hicaturdalānāṃ koṣṭhāni dvādaśottarakaṃśatamcaturbhiḥ krīḍakaiḥ pañca sthāpyāśśārāssvakāstvihaburajākhyaṃ dalaṃ hyevaṃ catuṣkaṃ syād dalāntare

sanskrit: saṃhṛtyasarvakoṣṭhāni dvātriṃśadadhikaṃ śatamramyāñchukānvṛttakoṣṭhe caturovilikhet kramātanyatrayugmaṃ na bhaved burajorityadīritamtrikoṣṭhīmantarekṛtvā koṣṭhe kuryāt sumaṃśubhamkramājjñeyamathākṣau dvauṣaḍaśrau parikalpayetdvecatvāriṣaḍaṣṭau ca tato daśa tato'sumamviṃśatiśca caturviṃśatiśca niṣkusumaṃ bhavettasya vakṣyephalaṃtvagrenāmānyevaṃ vicintayetṣaṭsumonissumenasyādrasa ityabhidhiyatedaśasaṅkhyonissumenadikchabdenābhidhīyateṣoḍaśāṅkonissmumenakalāśabdenagīyateviṃśatyaṅkonissumena hyuttānaḥkṛtirucyatenissumonissumenottānaścetyūjya itīryatesasaṅkhyākṣauyadottānau bhavetāṃnissumaṃvināśiṣṭākrīḍāprasiddhākṣakrīḍevakathitā budhaiḥnandanāṣāḍhaśuklasya tvekādaśyāṃ raverdineburajvakṣakrīḍanasya prakāraṃ vyavṛṇotsvayamlikhetpratidalaṃramyaṃ koṣṭhadvādaśakaṃ kramātdvādaśāṃśaṃ rāśicakramidamityanumanyatāmkoṣṭhānitānijānīyānnavāṃśaistriṃśadaṃśakaiḥnavagrahāssvākṛtayaśśārāssyussumanoharāḥśvetaraktaśca haritaḥpītaḥśveto'sitastathāravyādīnāṃ ca saptānāṃ gatissavyena vai smṛtāaticāragatirvakrāstambhaścaivamṛjurmatāakṣaudvaucaturaśrau syātāṃ vā pārśvacatuṣṭaye

sanskrit: ekasminnevamanyasmindve ca trīṇi ca pañca cayadaikasaṅkhyaścottānastadāsiṃhādimāṃśakevidhuṃtrisaṅkhyaścottānaḥkujaṃmeṣādimenyasettathottānaḥpañcasaṅkhyoguruṃminādimenyasetsaptasaṅkhyoyadottānomakarādauśaniṃnyasetnavasaṅkhyoyadottānaḥ syāt keturvṛścikādimeekādidvādaśāntāsyādṛjvīvakrāparā smṛtāsthāpanaṃhananaṃ caiva lokasiddhākṣavat smṛtamśārāṇāṃnobhavetkintu stambhaḥsyāditi tadvidaḥnandanenabhasaḥ kṛṣṇe tvaṣṭamyāṃ ravivāsarenavagrahākṣakrīḍāyāḥ prakāroyaṃ prakāśitaḥtatrādimassyātprākāraścatuṣṣaṣṭi gṛhānvitaḥcatvāriṃśatkoṣṭhakaistu tṛtīyassaṃyutobhavetdvātriṃśatkoṣṭhasaṃyuktaḥ prakārassyāt tu pañcamaḥtadantare syāt prākāraścaturviṃśatikoṣṭhakaḥaṣṭāviṃśatisaṅkhyānāṃ madhye tasyāstyanuttamamprākārātprathamādvāhye prākpratyagdakṣiṇottareyataḥkrīḍāpravarteta catvāraḥkrīḍakāssmṛtāḥharitassyāttathākṣāśca catvāraścaturaśrakāḥtathānyecaturakṣāssyuścaturaśrāḥprakīrtitāḥsvasthānācchārakānramyānakṣapuṣpakrameṇa vaiphalatomuktimāpannā itikrīḍāsukovidāḥśakeśālīvāhanasya ṣaṣṭyuttaramunīndukeśrīcāmuṇḍākṛpāpūṇa cāmarājatanubhavātatropariṣṭādvīdhyastunavakalpyāmanoharāḥ

sanskrit: kamalaṃ śrīcakramiti paṇḍitairatrakīrtitambṛndāvanantu kalaśā kṛtyāyatnena saṃlikhetūrdhvaṃ daśamavīdhyāṃsyānmahatkoṣṭha tu madhyametadadhovilikhetṣaṭ ca vīdhyaḥ koṣṭhaiḥ susaṃyutāḥtadadhastanavīdhyoḥ koṣṭhānipañcadaśa kramātkoṣṭhānisaptadaśavaivilikhetkhelane paṭuḥekaviṃśatikoṣṭhāni likhitvāpārśvayoḥ pṛthakśārādvādaśasaṃsthāpyāḥ ṣaṭṣaṭvarṇa krameṇa tucaturviṃśatiśārāṃstāndalayoḥ pārśvayoḥ kṣipetsaṃhṛtyaṣaḍaśītyuttaraśatadvayakoṣṭhakamkāryakāraṇabhedenabhinnacihnaṃ manoharamkoṣṭhānyekottaraśataṃ śārasthāpana hetaveekonapaṃcāśaccasyuḥ sāyujyāyaikamuttamamsarvakoṣṭheṣu saṃcāryabṛndāvanasamākṛtausāyujyaṃ prāpaye danta itikrīḍāvidoviduḥsumānisyuḥpārśvabhāge pṛthakpṛthaganukramātcatvāaridveṣaḍaṣṭau syuritipakṣāntarasmṛtamsukhaṃ śayītatatreti krīḍākrīḍanakovidāḥcihnitānyanulomenavilomenāpicālanamśiṣṭaṃprasiddhākṣatulyamitidvidbhirīritamvilambyāśvinaśuklasya paurṇamāsyāṃ budhe śubheśrīcakradaśapatrākṣakrīḍeyaṃ nirmitā śubhāvyādhāssyuraṣṭā catvāriṃśaccatvārobhavantihivyādhaissandhāvevasadāvyāghragrahavadīritamcāmuṇḍikāṃcāmarājabāhuvikramapoṣiṇīm

sanskrit: bhūnāthasaṃtatinutāṃ somakhaṃḍāvataṃsinīmsamūḍhasumamaṃ ca sthāṃ vāhābhūṣāphaṇāmaṇimśāṭīluṭhattārahārāṃsiṃhaveṣarathasthitāmbālāveṣadharāṃ devīṃ vaṃdehaṃ viṃdhyavāsinīmkīrtiṃbhāgyaṃsusaṃtānaṃ vijñānaṃ labhate varaḥvikramāśvinaśuklasya prathamāyāṃravauśubheuddiṣṭākṣaravacchlokāracitābudhatuṣṭaye || 8|| - ||ekādikamacāṃsthānedaśakaṃdīrghabodhanesaṃkhyāyāḥkādinavakaṃ pādabhedasyaṭādikamniṣkāditulaneśādi biṃdornoviśramasyañaḥyaṃprastuvaṃti vidvāṃso bṛhaspati samā apiśakeśālīvāhanasya tricatussaptabhūmitesaṅkhyālipīnālipibhissaṃkhyānāṃ bodhako mahāncarmabhasmamṛdasthīni rajataṃ nakhagomayeannaṃkāryāsakaṃ puṣpaṃ carma caiva pravālakaḥdhānyaṃ ca gomayaṃ caiva lohobhasmādayassmṛtāḥ || 3 || - ||keśomaṇiśca rajataṃ kārpāsomṛccapatrakamlavaṇaṃ ceti vai proktāḥ padārthāṣṣoḍaśātrahi || 5 || - ||lohastāmraṃ bhasmacāsthi sañjīvaḥ keśa eva carajataṃ caiva karpūraṃ pravālo ratnameva caasthyaśmākeśalavaṇaupuṣpabhūtī iti smṛtāḥ || 8 || - ||sajīvomūlaśuṣke ca rasa ityādayo gatāḥśuṣkaṃ mṛdeṣuvijñeyamiti vai tadvidoviduḥśilārasaśca lavaṇamityādīṃstadvidoviduḥmūlaṃrasassajīvaścetyevaṃ jñeyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vikramāśvinaśuklasya trayodaśyāṃ bhṛgordinemuṣṭipraśnottaravidhirevaṃ rūpeṇa varṇitaḥkaṃdaṃjīvaśca śuṣkaṃ ca tṛṇaṃ gomayameva caśilādhānyaṃ pravālaśca maṇimatsyau tathaiva cabhasmaromāsthikarpūra tvagbhedādgaṇita kramaḥtṛtīyaṃsyā tu kārpāsaṃ caturthe karmakathyatesaptamaṃparṇamatrasyādaṣṭamaṃ gomayaṃ tathāekādaśaṃ śaṣkamatradvādaśaṃ lavaṇaṃ bhavetrasaḥ paṃcadaśojñeyaḥ śrūyatāmaṃbike śive(ṭīku) - padyadalli baṃda lekkhavannu noḍikkoṃḍu iṃthā padārthaveṃdu gaṇitavannu suṇisikkoṃḍu heluva ślokagala yaraḍuprakāragalannu īgaṇitakke yaraḍu prakāra sūtragalannu saha baradu ive || ivannu buddhivantaru noḍi tilidu kkolatakkadducinnavu nīru verpabala śippe śilā guḍa carma bhasmagalu | maṇṇele velaliyu nakhavu gomaya nīrasa tāmravādiyol || 1 || annavu hatti togalu gurpavalaṃpū tṛṇa kappura cannele | belli berdavasa gomaya lohavu bhasmavādiyol || 2 || kappura veru nīraḍike kāyi kurul maṇi belli hatti | maṇsophele śippe tāmra togaluppugalīpa dinārujātiyol || 3 || tuppavu bella hullaḍike kappura lohavu tāmra bhasmavu meluppu sajīva keśa yallu śippeyu gomaya śupkacarmagalu || 4 || belliyu kappura pavala ratnavu hattiyu śippe tuppamu | bellavu kālu maṇṇeluvu kalkuruluppu puṣpabhūtigalu || 5 || yallapadārthabhedagala kelidabellava | pelveniṃdirāvallabhasodarī karuṇadiṃdalikautukamāda rītiyim(ṭīku) - yale hatti dhānya loha yalegal jīvanu beru śuṣka rasa modalāgi || 1 || phala hatti śileya rasadol yaleyaṃ śuṣka maṇṇugalivarol || 2 || phala carma dhānya jīvaru yale śile rasa uppu modalādavagal || 3 || yalu śuṣka sagaṇi uppugalaśile beruṃ rasa jīvarīparitorumvedāste bahavastatopi bahavaśśāstrādayo bhārataṃ kāvyaṃ cādyamapīkṣītuṃsapadinonaivāsti buddhiḥ kalauitthaṃbodhita eṣa kṛṣṇadharaṇī pālojaganmātṛkā devīsarvasurādhike tyupaviśatyuddāmavāgvaibhavaḥsaṃkrīḍanaṃsaṃracitaṃ suramyaṃ jīyādbhacandrāvadhibhūtalesmin || 3 || - ||eteṣāṃ kāraṇībhūta sadanāni tathaiva hietanmilitvāṣaṭtriṃśaduttaradviśataṃpadamśūlanārakamārabhyasakāraṇagṛhāṇi vaianṛtaṃ yastu vadati (narakakrimi) revasaḥsvāmidro hī bhavati yo (mahāraurava) maśnutemitradrohī bhavati yaḥ (tapanaṃ) narakaṃ vrajetatyapekṣī bhavati yassa (piśāco) bhavennaraḥrājahelanamātanvan (kumbhīpākaṃ) vrajet pumān(asīpatrā) khyanarake jāyate rājadūṣakaḥrājadārānkāmayāno ('ndhatemā) narakaṃ vrajetdayāvihinobhūteṣu (gaṇḍaśailo) bhaveddhruvam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sūryodevatā raktavarṇaḥ prabhāmaṃḍalamadhye'ṣṭadalapadma āsīnaḥ dvibhujaḥ padmadvayadharaḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitaḥsūryodevatā anyatsarvaṃ pūrvavatpūrvoktabhīma nṛsiṃhodevatā anyatsarvaṃ pūrvavatśrīmadrājādhirājarājaparameśvaraprauḍhapratāpā pratimavīranarapatibiru deṃteṃbaragaṃḍalokaikavīrayadukulapayaḥ pārāvārakalānidhiśaṃkha cakrāṃkuśakuṭhāramakaramatsyaśarabhasālvagaṃḍabheruṃḍadharaṇīvarāha hanumadgaruḍakaṃṭhīravādyaneka birudāṃkitamahīśūrapuravarādhīśa kṛṣṇarājamahārājaviracite śrītattvanidhyākhyagraṃthe cāmuṃḍādi śaktisvarūpanirūpaṇaṃnāmaprathamonidhiḥ saṃpūrṇaḥmahātalaṃviśvasṛjassugulphau talātalaṃ vai puruṣasyajaṃghemahītalaṃtajjaghanaṃ mahīpatenabhasthalaṃnābhisarogṛṇaṃtitapolalāṭaṃvidurādipuṃsassatyaṃ ca śīrṣāṇisahasraśīrṣṇaḥnāsatyadasrauparamasyanāse ghrāṇaṃ ca gaṃdhomukhamagniriddhaḥtadbhrūvijṛṃbhaḥ parameṣṭhidhiṣṇyamāposyatālūrasa eva jihvāhāsojanonmādakarī ca māyā duraṃtasargoyadapāṃgamokṣaḥkastasya meḍhraṃ vṛṣaṇau ca mitraḥkukṣissamudrāgirayosthi saṃghāḥannaṃ ca vīryaṃśvasitaṃ mātariśvāgatirvayaḥ karmaguṇapravāhaḥavyaktamāhurhṛdayaṃ manaśca sa caṃdramāssarvavikārakośaḥaśvāśvataryuṣṭragajānakhāni sarve mṛgāḥ paśavaḥśroṇideśaḥgaṃdharvavidyādharacāraṇāpsarassvarāḥ smṛtirhyasurānīkavaryaḥsvāhāsvadhāvīryaguṇopapannohavyātmakaḥ karmavitānayogaḥsaṃdhāryatesmin vapuṣisthaviṣṭhe manassvabuddhyānayato stikiṃcit || 13vimāneśu śubhedivye saṃsthito bhagavānhariḥnānāratnamaye divye nānāratnasamanvitekarṇikāyāṃsuramyāyāṃ lakṣmībīje śubhākṣaredivyonārāyaṇaḥ śrīmānāsīnaḥ paṃkajāsanesarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannādivyābharaṇabhūṣitāvāmataḥpṛthivīdevīnīlotpaladalaprabhāvahāsāhyūrdhvabāhubhyāṃ ramyaṃraktotpaladvayamgṛhītacāmarā divyāśaktayovimalādayaḥ

sanskrit: jñānaṃprāpyavṛthābhūyādyadigoraktapobhavetjyotiṣepvanṛtaṃvakṣyan (pallikā) sobhijāyatedhānyacoryeṇajīvedyassa (ākhu) rbhavitānaraḥ anyāyataḥ kimapyutkvānatyajedyadi (godhikā)patyurgarapradānena (saraṭa)ssonyajanamaniarjayitvādhanaṃ satsunadadyān (madhumakṣikā)samīcīnodayāśūnyassa (śilā) jāyate naraḥviṣayuktāśayoyastusa (sarpa) ssarvathā bhavetyaḥkṣudravārtayājīvetsa (matsyo) jāyate naraḥatyantavaṃcanāyukto (jambuka) ssabhavennaraḥdṛṣṭvāyojñāninovṛdhā na dṛṣṭveva vrajet (taruḥ)annacauryeṇayojīvet savṛko nātrasaṃśayaḥbādhate yojanānnīre (nakra) janmasamaśnutesatkarmācaraṇemando bhaved (ajagaro) hi saḥsadākāmī bhavatiyaḥ (kalaviṃka)ssajātedāṃbhikadhyānamātanvan (bako) 'nyasminbhavebhavetkālajñāne nṛtaṃ vakṣyan (kukkuṭa)ssobhijāyatestriyaṃbalādyoramate (gogāṃgūlo) 'nyajanmanihīnācāraratonityaṃ (vānara) ssonyajanmaniabhijātonāṭyajīvīyadi (barhi) bhaviṣyatibādhate durbalānyastu (śyeno) 'nyasminbhavebhavetbhaṅtvāparagṛhaṃsvasya gṛhaṃbadhnāti (kīcakaḥ)śṛṃgāraceṣṭāsusadāyo vartetasa (kokilaḥ)garveṇavṛddhānyoniṃden (mahiṣa) ssonyajanmaniśaivamaṃtropāsanāyāṃ bhraṣṭaścet (śarabho) bhavetviṣṇumantropāsanāyāṃbhraṣṭo (bheruṇḍa) evasaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yo nityaṃ mṛgayā yuktassa (sālvo) 'nyabhave bhavetcalacittassatkriyāsubhavenyasmin (mṛgo) hisaḥparabudhdhyāyastu jīvedbuddhihīnaḥ (śuko) bhavetpatiṃsaṃbhartsayānāstrī (poṭā) 'nyasminbhavebhavetekāśītitamegehe patiṃhitvā paraṃ naramaśītitamasaṃkhyāke sadane vakṣyatedhunāpañcāśītitamenārīparaputrānasūyatīekonenavatitamelajjāṃhitvā caret pathigṛhenavati saṃkhyāke mātṛsvasrādi bandhutāmsaptayaṅnavatitametryaṃśaṃdroṇaṃ karoti yaḥaṣṭādhikanavatyākhyasaṃkhyākesadanedhruvamekonaśatasaṃkhyākesvānuṣṭhitasukarmaṇāmnavayukchatasaṃkhyāke sadane yo naro bhavetsaptadaśottaraśatakegehe yo yaṃ hi kāmanāyuktaḥsapādaśatasaṃkhyākeyastu śāstrānusārataḥaṣṭāviṃśottaraśatagehekūpahṛdādikamekaviṃśacchatatameyo bhajennīcadevatāḥṣaṭtriṃśaduttaraśatasaṃkhyedāsyatiyonaraḥsārdheśatesāṃgavedānuccarannādarātsadāpañcapañcāśadadhikaśatasaṃkhyākaveśmanisaptapaṃcāśadadhikaśatasaṃkhyākaveśmaniekonaṣaṣṭisaṃkhyāyukchatasaṃkhye karoti yaḥekaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatedharmasūkṣmaṃvicāyan || 56 |||saptaṣaṣṭyuttaraśateyuddhānnāpasaranmṛtaḥekonāśītisahitaśatasaṃkhyākamaṃdire
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paṃcāśītyuttaraśatasaṃkhyāke śivamaṃdiramaṣṭāśītyuttaraśatasaṃkhyāke veśmani dhruvamekayuṅnavatiśatasaṃkhyākesadanenaraḥtriyugdviśatasaṃkhyāke hyanekakapilāgavāmnavayugdviśatemartyaḥ satkarmāṇi karoti yaḥdaśayugdviśataṃgehamārabhyāsaptamaṃ śṛṇu(nigamabrahmavidyā) ca (yogārūḍha) stataḥ param(mantrayogo) (jñānayoga) evaṃsaptagṛhāṇi vaivarjitadhanasutadāraḥ (satyeloke) mahīyate manujaḥyo vīraśaiva iti saṃprathito dharitryāṃ (kailāsa) metivibudhādibhirapyagamyamśrīśaṃkhacakraparikarmitabāhumūlo (vaikuṇṭhaloka) mupayātisurairalabhyam(nāmasmaraṇa) (nādānusandhānā) ('rcana) (dāsatā)(sākṣātkāraḥ) tataḥ paścāt (saṃsārasya vimocanam)ekatriṃśottaraśatadvaye ('ṅkita) vilekhanamgṛhāṇipañcakramaśaḥ (pādasevāprapattikā)ṣaṭtriṃśaduttaraśatadvayasaṃkhyagṛhentimeatraivapāśakasthānāṃ biṃdūnāmapi lakṣaṇampuṣpasaṃkhyāpatedatra hyekamārabhyāviṃśatiḥsadmānisarpagatyaivadraṣṭavyānimanīṣibhiḥrājāṃkitaṃ saṃlikhitaṃ paṭhedyaḥ gṛhairathopaṃcabhirādareṇaadhovīdhyāṃ paṃcadaśakoṣṭhāvissyuranukramātekāśordhvaṃkoṣṭhāni tvekavīdhyāṃ bhavanti cayajjanmāpekṣyate sarvaiḥ prārabhyaṃ krīḍanaṃ bhavetprasiddhākṣakrīḍanavadanyajjñeyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥpārśveṣu syussumānyatratriṣvekadvitriṃsaṃkhyayā

sanskrit: vīdhidvayesaptadaśatataḥ pañcadaśopariekādaśasyuḥ koṣṭhānividhyāmuparitatparepṛthak tadūrdhvaṃvīdhyoḥ syurdvayorekādaśa kramāttadūrdhvaṃsyussaptadaśavīdhyāṃ koṣṭhāni saṃlikhetkoṣṭhānikalpyānyatreti krīḍāsu kuśalaissmṛtamakṣāścātra trayojñeyānissumā ekapārśvataḥekokṣonyastathājñeyo daśasaptacatussumaḥsumānyatrasuvijñeyā nīticākṣavicakṣaṇāḥāṣāḍhesitapakṣakebhṛgudine caikādaśī saṃyute śrīliṃgākṛtimātanodimamihaśrīkṛṣṇabhūvallabhaḥśivaliṃgadākṛtiyacitrapaṭadalidevisāyujyamuktiyaṃbāṭadolagekailāsamodalāgikeltattvamārgāṃta-ūrdhvalokadamanegaloṭṭumāḍebhedagalasadanagaluberadihavuhādinelugoviniṃmodalāgikuritunoḍalśūlanarakavumodalugoṃḍuvaitaraṇiyanukaḍeyoleṇisaluhanneraḍumanegalsadgurukaṭākṣādisarasasadanaṃ galigekāraṇagaleyillakaleyayidanumanegalavenūrāruyaṇisalaṃkitagūḍhayinnūramūvattumeleyāruvijayasaṃvatsaradavimalavādāṣāḍhaśuddhayekādaśiśukravāramāḍiruvadevisāyujyadāṭavācandratārakavidāḍisukhadimakṣatripārśvabhāgeṣusumānitriṣuvinyasetāṣāḍhesitapakṣakebudhapiturvāretharākādinesarpākāratayemamevaracayāmāsa-kṣaṇādbhūpatiḥśālivāhanaśakavusāviradayelnūra-aivatta-āraneyaidutiruvakalpiśirutirppasarpadākṛtiyādacitrapaṭavanunoḍiśiṣṭarellaadhovīdhyāṃsaptakoṣṭhamekādaśatathopariūrdhvaṃsaptadaśaivaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ vīdhīṣupañcasutadūrdhvaṃsyussaptadaśatadūrdhvāṃsyuḥ pṛthakpṛthakekādaśatadūrdhvaṃsyuḥ koṣthānyekādaśāntataḥ

sanskrit: devīsāyujyavatsarvamakṣāstraya udīritāḥekaṃdvetrīṇicatvāridvādaśāṣṭasumānihicaturaśrākṣakeṣvevaṃ vyavasthāsaṃprakīrtitāvijayaśrāvaṇekṛṣṇenavamyāṃśukravāsaredevīsāyujyamuktyartha viśvarūpākṛtiḥkṛtācaturaśrākṛtiyāda devīsāyujyamuktiyāṭada paṭhabannu viśvarūpākṛtiyāgi raci śiruvadakke padyaślokada paṭhavannu racisiruvakrama ḍālagala lekkhasaha (sīsa) 'srīmahābalaśailaśṛṃgavāsiniyādalokamāteyaviśvarūpadolage || ṣaṭtriṃśadadhikadviśatamaṃdiragalolcetanācetanasṛṣṭibaradurucisidaśrīkṛṣṇarājamahārājanakhilarusanmārgavariyuvantekaviyavāsaradolsakalakavigaloppedhareyaliruvaṃteyācandratāravāgiādautrivīdhīṣu koṣṭhānisyurekonaviṃśatiḥtataścaturvīdhikāsu koṣṭhānisyustrayodaśavīdhyostataḥ pṛthakkoṣṭhāni bhavantīti tadvidaḥtadūrdhvamekādaśasyuḥ tatassaptadaśordhvataḥadhovāmāditaḥ proktaṃ sarpākārekṣa cālanamnissumaścaikapārśvassyāt trayāṇāmitareṣu tuevaṃpaṃcadaśātho vai caturdaśasumānyahovijayekārtikasitedvādaśyāṃ bhānuvāsaredevīsāyujyamuktyakṣa krīḍāviracitāpṛthaknaśyeccapāpanicayaṃsūlabhopidharmodevīkaṭākṣalavataḥ sulabhābhavecchrīḥūrjasyaivavalakṣapakṣaka ihaśrīdvādaśīsaṃyutebhānorahnimahīpatissamakarovṛṃ?dāvanākāratāmśālivāhanaśakavusāviradayelnūra aivatta āraneyaidutiruvakalpisibṛndāvanākṛtiyacitravanumāḍaluvīkṣisinīvumodadiṃdapṛthakpṛṭhak tataḥ koṣṭhānikuryātkrīḍanepaṭuḥcaturaṅgairbalairvyūhamabhedyaṃ gāruḍaṃ bhavetpadātayo dvādaśasyurekapakṣe tathānyataḥuṣṭrapārśverathastasya pārśvesthāpyāpatākikā

sanskrit: rājñaḥsthitissyātsvasthānemantrīṣaṣṭhe hi rājataḥcaturthe syāt paṃcame tu patākāsyānmanoharāhastīsamorathabalasya kramāt ṣaṭbalāni capadātiḥ kariṇaḥ dve tu samestastu yadātadāabhedyogāruḍavyūho bhavediti budhaissmṛtamabhedyagāruḍavyūhoracitaścaturaṃgaketanagedurāginālkanemaneyolvaṃṭerathanālkarali-aidaralipatākeārumoharusāligārukelagaḍepyāde karimukhadoloṃduyaraḍusamadikamalasaṃbhavahokkarukaṭṭalahude caturaguṇasāṃdrakṛṣṇarājakṣitīṃdrarāgālāpakarārāvagītakāmarasolbaṇaḥgeharatnapadollāsīnānārāmakathonmanāḥkṛṣṇarājaturaṃgasya cāturaṃgasyariṃgaṇevṛttatrayaṃ ca dharaṇī sadanatrayaṃ ca śrīcakrametadūditaṃ paradevatāyāḥcatuścatvāriṃśadvasudalakalāśratrivalayatrirekhābhiḥ sārdhaṃ tava caraṇakoṇāḥ pariṇatāḥbhūgṛhaṃ svarapatrābjaṃ vasvaraṃ bhuvanāśrakamtrailokyamohanaṃ cakraṃ sarvāśāparipūrakamsarvārthasādhakaṃ cakraṃ sarvarakṣākaraṃ paramsarvānandamayaṃ madhyaṃ navamaṃ cakranāyakamprakaṭāśca tathāguptāstathāguptatarāḥ parāḥparāpararahasyāstā atipūrvarahasyakāḥtripurātripureśī ca sundarīpuravāsinīatyāpaddharamevedaṃ vijñāsaṃketasaṃjñitamatrātipūrvarahasyakā-itivacanātparāpararahasyākhyāyoginītvatipūrvaketi dakṣiṇāmūrtivacanātparāparātirahasyayoginītinavacakrayoginīnāmānīti śivamiti śrīmatsamastabhamaṃḍalamaṃḍanāyamānānikhiladeśāvataṃ sakarnāṭakajanapadādhiṣṭhānabhūta śrīmanmahīśūramahāsaṃsthānamadhyadedīpyamānāvikalakalānidhikulakramāgata-rājakṣitipālapramukhanikhilanijarājādhirājamahārājacakravartimaṃḍalānubhūta-divyaratnasiṃhāsanārūḍha śrīmadrājādhirājarājaparameśvaraprauḍhapratāpāpratimavīranarapatibirudeṃteṃbaragaṃḍalokaikavīrayadukulapayaḥpārāvārakalānidhiśaṃkhacakrāṃkuśakuṭhāra-makaramatsyaśarabhasālvagaṃḍabheruṃḍadharaṇīvarāhahanumadgaruḍakaṃṭhīra-vādyanekabirudāṃkitaśrīmanmahīśūrapuravarādhīśa śrīkṛṣṇarājamahārājaviracite śrītattvanidhyākhyagraṃthepatrikākṣakrīḍādimahākautukanirūpaṇaṃnāmanavamo-nidhissaṃpūrṇaḥiti śrītattvanidhyākhyagranthe - navamaḥ kautukanidhissaṃpūrṇaḥ

sanskrit: tāsāṃ madhye samāsīnobhagavānacyutohariḥkeyūrāṃgadahārādyairbhūṣaṇairupaśobhitaḥpūrvoktaistridaśairnityaṃ sevitaḥpuruṣottamaḥśrīmadaṣṭākṣarairmaṃtraiḥ siddhānāṃ vai manīṣiṇāmgamanaṃ vaiṣṇave lokenetareṣāṃ kathaṃcana || raktavarṇaḥdevadevastu kartavyaḥ śeṣasuptodvibāhukaḥ || ekapādosyakartavyolakṣmyutsaṃgagataḥprabhoḥekaḥ karosyakartavyaḥ savyajānauprasāritaḥnābhīsaṃbhūtakamale sukhāsīnaḥ pitāmahaḥśaṃkhacakragadādīnimūrtāniparito nyaset || 4 || meghavarṇaḥmaṇimukuṭavicitrālaṃkṛtā kalpajātairbhavatu bhuvanamātāsaṃtataṃśrīśśriyainaḥ || 1 || kanakavarṇaḥdāḍimīphalasaṃyuktā vāmekalpataroradhaḥsarvālaṃkārabhūṣāḍhyā dhyeyāsarvaphalapradā || 2 || svarṇavarṇaḥcaturbhujāsukhāsīnāvarābhayakarānvitāsarvābharaṇasaṃyuktā nīlādevīsamīritā || 2 || śyāmavarṇaḥpaścādbāhudvayena pratibhaṭaśamane dhārayañchaṃkha cakredevī bhūṣādijuṣṭo janayati jagatāṃśarmavaikuṃṭhanāthaḥ || 1 || meghavarṇaḥagre vācayati prabhaṃjanasute tattvaṃ munibhyaḥ paraṃvyākhyāṃ taṃ bharatādibhiḥ parivṛtaṃ rāmaṃbhajeśyāmalam || 1 || śyāmavarṇaḥśaṃkhacakravarābhītilasat pāṇistrayīmayaḥkālarūpī sadādhyeyobhaktābhīṣṭapradohariḥ || 2 || śvetavarṇaḥkirīṭahārakeyūrakuṃḍalaiśca virājatemadhuvratasragvanamālayāvṛtorarājarājanbhagavānurukramaḥpadaṃdvitīyātkramatastriviṣṭapaṃnavai tṛtīyasyatadīyamaṇvapiurukramasyāṃghriruparyadhodivomaharjanābhyāṃtapasaḥ paraṃgataḥ || raktavarṇaḥaṃḍāṃtaraṃbahirapi pratibhāsayaṃtaṃ śaṃkhākṣapustakasubodhayutābjabāhumamlānaśrīramṛtaviśadairaṃśubhiḥ plāvayanmāmāvirbhūyādanaghamahi māmānasevāgadhīśaḥ || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥdhyeyonijaiśca tanubhissakalairupetaḥ koloharissakalavāṃchitasiddhayenaḥ || 1 || śyāmavarṇaḥ

sanskrit: śeṣaścaturbhujaḥ kāryaścāruratnaphaṇānvitaḥsarparūpaśca kartavyastathaiva racitāṃjaliḥvāmāratnigatā tasya yoṣidrūpāvasuṃdharāyasminbhujedharādevī tatra śaṃkhaḥkarebhavetpadmāsanasthāṃ kurvītaśriyantrailokyamātaramraukmapadmakaravyagrāṃvaradāṃ dakṣiṇena tuvarāhaḥ śyāmavarṇaḥ || bhūmiśśuklavarṇā || śrīssuvarṇavarṇā || śeṣaśśubhravarṇaḥciṃtyaḥkarābhyāṃ vasutarpayansasvāṃkastha lakṣmīrgaruḍāṃsasaṃsthaḥ || 1 || kāṃcanavarṇaḥśaṃkhāridordvayamudarkamaheṃdubiṃbātsaṃsicyamānamamṛtenaramādhinātham || 1 || śuklavarṇaḥdorbhyāṃdadhānamakhilaiśca suraissametaṃ śītāṃśumaṃḍalagataṃ ramayāsametam || 1 || śuklavarṇaḥśaṃkhacakradharaṃdevaṃ pītavāsasamacyutamdhanurbāṇasamāyuktaṃ ciṃtayet puruṣottamam || 2 || śvetavarṇaḥbibhrāṇaṃpuṃḍarīkākṣaṃlakṣmyāliṃgitavigrahamsiṃhavaktraṃmahākāyaṃ nṛsiṃhaṃhṛdibhāvayet || śvetavarṇaḥśuklāṃbaradharassaumyomuktābharaṇabhūṣitaḥdakṣiṇordhvakareśaṃkhaḥ vāmoccakarecakraṃ vāmādhaḥ karegadā dakṣādhaḥkarepadmaṃ śuklāṃbaraḥ muktābharaṇaḥ kāryaḥ || svarṇavarṇaḥpītavāsāmaṇimayairbhūṣaṇairuttamairvṛtaḥdakṣiṇādhaḥkareśaṃkhaḥ dakṣordhvakarepadmaṃ vāmoccakare gadā vāmādhaḥkarecakram || meghaśyāmavarṇaḥcitramālyāṃbaradharaḥ puṃḍarīkanibhekṣaṇaḥvāmordhvakareśaṃkhaḥ vāmādhaḥkarepadmaṃ dakṣordhvakarecakraṃ dakṣādhaḥkaregadā || kṛṣṇavarṇaḥraktāraviṃdanayanastaptakāṃcanabhūṣaṇaḥvāmādhaḥkareśaṃkhaḥ dakṣādhaḥkarecakraṃ dakṣordhvakare gadā vāmoccakarepadmam || śvetavarṇaḥhemāṃbaradharassragvīkeyūrāṃgadabhūṣitaḥvāmordhvakareśaṃkhaḥ vāmādhaḥkarecakraṃ dakṣādhaḥkaregadā dakṣordhvakarepadmam || śvetavarṇaḥśaṃkhaṃcakraṃgadāṃpadmaṃdorbhirnityaṃbibhartyasau

sanskrit: dakṣordhvakareśaṃkhaḥ vāmoccakarepadmaṃ vāmādhaḥ karegadā dakṣādhaḥkarecakram || raktavarṇaḥkirīṭahārakeyūrakuṃḍalaiśca virājatevāmādhaḥkareśaṃkhaḥ dakṣādhaḥkare padmaṃ dakṣodhrvakare gadā vāmordhvakare cakram || raktavarṇaḥdorbhiśśaṃkhaṃgadāṃ cakraṃ padmaṃ caiva bibhartyasaudakṣādhaḥkare śaṃkhaḥ dakṣoccakare cakraṃ vamoccakare gadā vāmādhaḥkare padmam || śvetavarṇaḥśrīdharaḥ puṃḍarīkābhaḥcakraśaṃkhagadābjabhṛt | raktāraviṃdanayanomuktādāmavibhūṣitaḥvidyudvarṇohṛṣīkeśaścakraśaṃkhagadābjabṛt || raktamālyāṃbaradharaḥpuṃḍarīkāvataṃsakaḥvāmādhaḥkareśaṃkhaḥ dakṣādhaḥkaregadā dakṣodhrvakarecakraṃ vāmordhvakarepadmam || kanakavarṇaḥiṃdranīlanibhaścakraśaṃkhapadmagadādharaḥ || pdmanābhaḥpītavāsāścitramālyānulepanaḥdakṣādhaḥkareśaṃkhaḥ dakṣodhrvakarepadmaṃ vāmordhvakarecakraṃ vāmādhaḥkaregadā || nīlavarṇaḥdāmodaraśśādvalābhogadāpadmāriśaṃkhabhṛt || pītavāsāviśālākṣonānāratnavibhūṣitaḥdakṣodhrvakareśaṃkhaḥ vāmordhvakaregadā vāmādhaḥ karecakraṃ dakṣādhaḥkarepadmam || dūrvāśyāmavarṇaḥsaṃkarṣaṇassitodhatte śaṃkhapadmārisadgadāḥ || dakṣodhrvakareśaṃkhaḥ vāmoccakarepadmaṃ vāmādhaḥkarecakraṃ dakṣādhaḥkaregadhā || śvetavarṇaḥdakṣodhrvakareśaṃkhaḥ vāmordhvakarecakraṃ vāmādhaḥkarepadmaṃ dakṣādhaḥkaregadā || śvetavarṇaḥdakṣodhrvakareśaṃkhaḥ vāmordhvakaregadā vāmādhaḥkarepadmaṃ dakṣādhaḥkarecakram || kanakavarṇaḥaniruddhonīlavarṇaḥ śaṃkhapadmagadāribhṛt || vāmordhvakareśaṃkhaḥ vāmādhaḥkarepadmaṃ dakṣādhaḥkarecakraṃ dakṣocca karegadā || nīlavarṇaḥvāmordhvakareśaṃkhaḥ vāmādhaḥkaregadā dakṣādhaḥcakraṃ dakṣoccakarepadmam || śvetavarṇaḥvāmordhvakare śaṃkhaḥ vāmādhaḥkarecakraṃ dakṣādhaḥkarepadmaṃ dakṣodhrvakaregadā || nīlavarṇaḥvāmādhaḥkare śaṃkhaḥ dakṣādhaḥkarecakraṃ dakṣordhvakarepadmaṃ vāmordhvakaregadā || śvetavarṇaḥvāmādhaḥkare śaṃkhaḥ sanskrit: śrīdharaḥpītavarṇābho hṛṣīkeśastaṭitprabhaḥdāmodarodvādaśaite kathitāḥ keśavādayaḥsa eva vāsudevādicaturṇāṃ tadbhuvāmapiśuddhasphaṭikaśaṃkāśovijñeyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || adhokṣajaśśyāmavarṇonṛsiṃhohemasannibhaḥupeṃdraśśyāmalaḥ proktohariḥ pītanibhaḥ smṛtaḥsatuśuklavapuḥ kāryonīlavāsāyadūttamaḥgadāsthāne ca musalaṃcakrasthāne calāṃgalam || śvetavarṇaḥyogamūrdhordhrva śaṃkhaśca dakṣeśārṅgadharassmṛtaḥdhārayeduttare cakra dakṣiṇe ca gadāmiti || śvetavarṇaḥcakramūrdhve tathā vāme gadāṃdadyādadhaḥkare || 1 || pītavarṇaḥdhanuḥ kheṭadharaṃ vīramaniruddhaṃ pracakṣate || 1 || kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ || 1narāṃghrirmatsyarūpo vā matsyarūpījanārdanaḥ || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥkūrmastu kacchapākāromatsyarūpoktarūpavān || svarṇavarṇaḥnarāṃgaṃsūkarāsyaṃ ca manākpīnaṃsubhīṣaṇametadrūpadharaṃ vaṃdevarāhaṃ bhuktimuktidam || 2 || śyāmavarṇaḥdaṃṣṭrākarālavadanaṃ lolajihvāsubhīṣaṇamabhedyatīkṣṇanakharamātmoru kṛtadānavamgadācakradharaṃ dvābhyāṃnṛsiṃhaṃ praṇametprabhum || 3 || śvetavarṇaḥkuṃḍīcchatradharodvābhyāṃ vāmanaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 1 || śyāmavarṇaḥjāmadagnyaśva kartavyorāmaśśatruniṣūdanaḥ || 1 || svarṇavarṇaḥājānubāhuḥkartavyorāmo bāṇadhanurdharaḥ || 1 || śyāmavarṇaḥgadāmusalavajraṃ ca halīrāmaḥ dadhatsitaḥmusalarūpaṃvajramityarthaḥ || kṣīravarṇaḥpadmāsanasthodvibhujodhyeyo buddhaḥ prakīrtitaḥpāṭalavarṇaḥ prasiddhaḥ

sanskrit: mlecchacchedakaraḥ kalkīdvibhujaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥśaṃkhacakradharaḥ śyāmodvibhujaḥ kṛṣṇasaṃjñakaḥ || śyāmavarṇaḥ || 11varāhaśśyāmalanibhodhvalākṛtireva vāvāmanaśśyāmalanibhokālavarṇo mahābalaḥbharataśśyāmalaḥ proktaḥ lakṣmaṇaḥ kanakaprabhaḥp. 56) māṃḍavīraktavarṇābhācormilāśyāmalākṛtiḥśrutakīrtissitāṃgī syāddhanūmānkanakaprabhaḥ || aṃgadoraktavarṇābhassugrīvohemapiṃgalaḥguhastuti lavarṇābhaḥ kālavarṇovibhīṣaṇaḥmeghaśyāmobhavet kṛṣṇorukmiṇī kanakaprabhādakṣiṇe tu gadāpadmī nīlajīmūtasannibhaḥvāme śrīrvallakī hastāpuṣṭāpadmakarāpare || śyāmavarṇaḥdhyeyassadā savitṛmaṃḍalamadhyavartī nārāyaṇassarasijāsanasanniviṣṭaḥ || keyūravānmakarakuṃḍalavānkirīṭīhārī hiraṇmayavapuḥ dhṛtaśaṃkhacakraḥ || 1 || svarṇavarṇaḥvaṃdehaṃ krūraghoraprabalataramahāgaṃḍabheruṃḍa siṃhavyāghrāścakroḍaśākhāmṛgavarakhagarāṅbhallukādyaṣṭavaktram | dvātriṃśatkotibāhuṃhalamusalagadā śaṃkhacakrādihetīrvibhrāṇaṃ bhīmadaṣṭraṃśarabhakhagagajānbhakṣayaṃtaṃ nṛsiṃhamśarīre raktavarṇaḥ mukheṣu tattadvarṇāḥvajrasamānatuṃḍanakharaṃdaṃṣṭridvijihvānanamhṛdayajaṭharagāhyaṣṭakālyaṣṭadurgā || ūrūdvaurudrakālaukhagamṛganṛharirgaṃḍabherūpaḥpāyādasmān sa cakroharirihaśarabhādyugraśatrūnpravidhyanbāhudvaṃdvoparuddhāsuraka ca caraṇaṃdoryugodyannakhāgrapracchannārāti dehaṃraviśaśidahanatrīkṣaṇaṃvajrapakṣamhairaṇyāṃtraṃtriśūlaṃ phalakamapi mahāpāśaśīrṣaṃpinākaṃ vajraṃkaumodakīṃ cāpyatibalamasalaṃsaṃdadhānaṃ karāgraiḥśarīreraktavarṇaḥ mukheṣu tattadvarṇāḥmuṃḍamālādharaṃraudraṃkaṃṭhahāreṇaśobhitamcaṃdramauliṃnilakṃṭhaṃ prativaktraṃtrilocanamakṣasūtraṃgadāṃpadmaṃśaṃkhaṃgokṣīrasannibhamkhaḍgaṃ ca śūlapāśau ca nṛsiṃhaṃrudrarūpiṇamiṃdragopakanīlābhaṃ caṃdrābhaṃ svarṇasannibham || pūrvādimottarāṃtāsyamūdhrvāsyaṃ sarvavarṇakambibhrāṇaṃ sarvajagatāmādhāraṃ girikanyake || śarīreraktavarṇaḥ || mukheṣuvarṇānāṃ paṃcakam

sanskrit: dorbhiḥkhaḍgaṃ triśūlaṃḍamarumasidhanurdaṃḍabāṇaṃ kuṭhāraṃśaṃkhaṃcakraṃ kṛpāṇaṃhalamusalagadābhiṃḍivālaṃ ca pāśam || udyadbāhuṃ ca muṣṭiṃhyabhayavarakaraṃbibhrataṃ śuklavarṇaṃ vaṃderāmaṃtriṇetraṃtvamararipu kulaṃmardayaṃtaṃpratāpaiḥ || 1 || śuklavarṇaḥsugrīvaśca vibhīṣaṇaśca yuvaraṭtārāsutojāṃbavānmadye nīlasarojakomalarucaṃrāmaṃbhajeśyāmalam || 1 || nīlavarṇaḥnavāmrapallavābhāsaṃpiṃgabhrūśmaśrulocanam || dakṣiṇodhrvakarepadmaṃśaṃkhaṃ tasyāpyadhaḥkarebhibhrataṃ puṃḍarikākṣaṃ phaṇāsaptānvitaṃbhaje || 2 || gomūtravarṇaḥvanya srajekabalavetraviṣāṇaveṇu lakṣmaśriye mṛdupadepaśupāṃgajāya || 1 || nīlvarṇaḥaṃgulyagraistanaṃcānyaṃ spṛśaṃ taṃ ca muhurmuhuḥyaśodāṃkasthitaṃ gopaṃdhyāyet putrapradaṃsadāśaṃkhacakragadā padmapāśāṃkuśasumāśugānṣoḍaśacchadapadmastha ṣaṭkoṇoparisaṃsithataḥsvarapatrastha gopībhirādarādīkṣitovatāt || 3 || raktavarṇaḥjvālākeśaṃ triṇetraṃ jvaladanalanibhaṃhārakeyūrabhūṣaṃ dhyāyet ṣaṭkoṇasaṃsthaṃ sakalaripujanaḥprāṇasaṃhāracakram || 1 || raktavarṇaḥtiryagjvālāgnirūpaṃ jvalitaśikhiśikhottuṃgakeyūra bāhuṃpiṃgākṣaṃdīpta jihvāṃdaśaśatavilasattīkṣṇadhārātiraudram || śārṅgacakrābjaśaṃkhānśaramusaladharaṃ sarvaśatrūndahaṃtaṃ ṣaṭkoṇābhyaṃtarasthaṃ raviniyutanibhaṃ cakrarājaṃprasannam || 1 || raktavarṇaḥśyāmavarṇaḥ caturbhirbhujaistarjanī śaṃkhacakragadādadhānaḥ pīṭhādhastātprasāritadakṣiṇapādaḥ ākuṃcitavāmapādaḥ kirīṭādi sarvālaṃkārabhūṣito viṣvaksenaḥ || śyāmavarṇaḥsphaṭikābhaṃsvarṇakāṃtiṃ dvibhūjaṃ ca kṛtāṃjalim || kuṃḍaladvayasaṃśobhimukhāṃbujamahaṃbhaje || 1 || svarṇavarṇaḥkoṭisūryapratīkāśaṃ kapivaktraṃsu tejasamasyaikaṃdakṣiṇaṃ vaktraṃ nārasiṃhaṃ mahādbhutampaścime gāruḍaṃvaktraṃ vakratuṃḍaṃmahādyutiuttaraṃsaukaraṃ vaktraṃ kṛṣṇaṃdīptaṃ śikhojjvalamūrddhvaṃhayānanaṃ ghoraṃdānavāṃtakaraṃ paramdrumagomudrikāmuṃḍaṃdadhānaṃsuravaṃditam || 6 || svarṇavarṇaḥsavyajānugatobhūmaumūrdhnā ca phaṇimaṃḍitaḥdvibāhuḥ pakṣayuktaśca kartavyovinatāsutaḥ || 2 || suvarṇavarṇaḥnānākalpavibhūṣaṇaḥkara sahasrārdhāttabāṇāsanobāṇāttārdhasahastrabāhuraniśaṃbhūvallabhonaḥ prabhuḥ || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ ||sahasrabāhuṃsaśaraṃsacāpaṃ raktāṃbaraṃ ratnakirīṭakuṃḍalam || corādiduṣṭāmayanāśamiśṭaṃ dhyāyen mahāṃtaṃbhuvikārtavīryam || 1 || raktavarṇaḥaṣṭabāhuḥ prakartavyośaṃkhapadmavibhūṣitaḥ
