sanskrit: ratiḥprītistathā śaktirbhedaśaktistathojjvalācatvāraścakarāstasya kāryābhāryāstanopagāḥkāmaṃkāṃcana saṃnibhamiti saivāgame || svarṇavarṇaḥmaṃdāramūle maṇimaṃṭapasthitaṃ suvarṇadānaikanibaddhadīkṣam || dhyāyetparītaṃnavanāthasiddhairdāridryadā vānalakālameghaiḥvyākhyāmudrāṃkarasarasijedakṣiṇe saṃdadhānojānunyastāvarakarasarojātavāmonnatāṃsaḥ || dhyānādhārātsukhaparavaśādardhamāmīlitākṣodattātreyobhasita dhavalaḥ pātunaḥ kṛttivāsāḥ || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥnāgaṃ pāśaṃ ca ghaṃṭāṃ pralayahutavahaṃ sāṃkuśaṃ vāmabhāge nānālaṃkārayuktaṃsphaṭikamaṇinibhaṃ pārvatīśaṃ namāmi || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥpṛthak caturbhujākāryā devī siṃhāsane śubhāaṣṭapatraṃ mahābhāgākarṇikāyāṃsu saṃsthitābṛhannālaṃkare kāryaṃ tasyāśca kamalaṃśubhamvāmemṛtaghaṭaḥ kāryastathā rājanmanoharaḥtasyā anyaukaraukāryaubilvaśaṃkhadharāviti || marakatavarṇaḥastimerorudagbhāge mahānkailāsaparvataḥsaṃvāsoyojanānāṃ ca viṃśatkoṭibhirāyataḥnavaratnamayaṃ tasyamadhye śikharamuttamamprākāragopurāṭṭālavalabhībhirvirājitampraphullakamalollāsa paṃcaviṃśanmukhojjvalaḥphullaraktāṃbujātta śrīnābhyaṃghriyugalojjvalaḥanekakoṭisūryābhaḥ paramānaṃdavigrahaḥyatovāconivartaṃte aprāpyamanasāsahabhasmoddhūlita sarvāṃgovyālajñopavītavānprativaktraṃ trinayanobhakta sarvarthasiddhidaḥabhayaṃ cakraśūle caṭaṃkabāṇaugadāṃbhujehalāṃkuśākṣamālāśca cchurikāṃdhvajadaṃḍakauvajrakuṃtāsthi daṃṣṭrāścakrakacaṃbhiṃḍīvālakaṃ || paṃcaviṃśatibhirhastairdadhānodakṣiṇaiśśubhaiḥmudgaraṃḍamaruṃ ghaṃkṭāṃ rudravīṇāṃ ca pustakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: phalakaṃpaṭta saṃvetraṃkamaṃḍaluhutāśanaumahān sadāśivassoyaṃrājate tatra parvate || 16 || śvetavarṇaḥjaṭāmakuṭasaṃyuktaṃ triṇetraṃ caṃdraśekharamdadhānamasthibāṇau ca gadāṃpadmaṃ kapālakamkhaṭvāṃgaṃparaśuṃ caiva dadhānaṃ dakṣiṇaiḥ karaiḥnāgamagniṃ mṛgaṃ ghaṃṭāṃdhanuśca kaṭihastakametadāyudhasaṃyuktaṃ ruṃḍamālāvibhūṣitamnīlavarṇaḥśūlaṃkapālamabhayavaraudadhatamiṣṭadamahibhūṣita sarvāṃgaṃtamaghoramupāsmahe || 2 || nīlavarṇaḥśyāmakaṃcukadhārī ca madāruṇavilocanaḥmahākālīṃ ghanaśyāmāmanaṃgārdrāmapāṃgayankālamṛtyumukhairyuktassarvalokaika bhakṣakaḥvitanvaṁllalitābhakteṣvāyuṣo dīrghadīrghatām || 4 || nīlavarṇaḥcaṃdravarṇaṃsravaddivyāmṛta caṃdrakalādharamamṛtāpūrṇakanakakalaśāptakaradvayaṃnānābharaṇasaṃbhūṣaṃ nāgayajñopavītinambhasmānulepinaṃ rudraṃ mṛtyuṃjayamimaṃ smaret || 4 || śubhravarṇaḥakṣamalāṃ ca śūlaṃ ca kapālaṃ dadhataṃkaraiḥtriṇetramabjanilyaṃbālārka sadṛśaprabham || sādhakābhīṣṭadātāraṃ nīlakaṃṭhamahaṃbhaje || 2 || aruṇavarṇaḥnīlakaṃṭhaṃsarpabhūṣaṃ vyāghracarmāṃbarāvṛtamcaṃdragaṃgājaṭājūṭaṃrūdraṃtaṃ praṇamāmyaham || 2 || śvetavarṇaḥbhṛṃgīnāradabāṇabhairava gajāsyaskaṃda vīreśvarāmadhyeśubhra sarojakomalarucaṃ śaṃbhuṃbhajepāṃḍuram || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥnṛtyaṃtamādipuruṣaṃ śaśiśekharaṃtaṃ devāḥ pradoṣasamayenubhajaṃti sarvegākautuṃburunāradausamurajaunaṃdī kumārastathā rudronṛttakarassvabhāvajanitaṃnāṭyaṃ sadāpātunaḥ || 1 || gauravarṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tryakṣaścaturvaktra-uruprabhāvassadyodhijātovatumāṃ pratīcyām || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥtrīlocanaścārucaturmukhomāṃ pāyādudīcyāṃdiśivāmadevaḥ || 1 || kanakavarṇaḥcaturmukhonīlarucistriṇetraḥ pāyādaghorodiśidakṣiṇasyām || 1 || nīlavarṇaḥcaturmukhastatpuruṣastriṇetraḥ prācyāṃ sthitorakṣatu māmajasram || 1 || kanakavarṇaḥsitadyutiḥ paṃcamukhovatānmāmīśāna-urdhvaṃparamaprakāśaḥ || 1 || śvetavrṇaḥ || 1gauravarṇasamāyuktaṃ barhipiṃchasamanvitamdakṣiṇe svajaṭāgre tu jāhnavyāparimaṃḍitamsarvābharaṇasaṃyuktamupavīta samanvitamprasāritabhujaṃ vāmedakṣiṇe'bhayahastakamvakraṃ tu dakṣiṇaṃpādamapasmāroparisthitamānaṃdatāṃḍavaṃ proktam || gauravarṇaḥabhayaṃ ḍamaruṃsavye vāme piṃchaṃsavismayamūdhrve tu dakṣiṇaṃpādamapasavyānugaṃdadhamsaṃdhyātāṃḍavamevaṃ syād || varṇādikaṃ pūrvavatgaurāṃgaṃṣaḍbhujopetamabhayaṃ damaruṃ tathāgajahastopamaṃ hastaṃsavyapārśvānugaṃdadhamuddhṛtaṃ dakṣiṇaṃpādaṃ vāmapādānugaṃ tathāsarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ vyāghracarmottarīyakamumātāṃḍavamatrom || śiṣṭaṃpūrvavatkaroṭiṃbakapuṣpaṃ ca dhuttūraṃ cārkapuṣpakamsarpakaṃkaṇasaṃyuktamapasmāroparisthitamsavyedadhānamabhayamanyasmin ḍamaruṃkarevāmegaurī samāyuktamavāme naṃdikeśinamvāme maulisamāyuktaṃśeṣaṃ prathamanṛttavatgaurītāṃḍavamityuktam || raktavarṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhujāṣṭakasamāyuktaṃ savyapādaṃ samuddhṛtamabhayaṃ śūlapāśaṃ ca ḍamaruṃdakaṣiṇekaregajahastopamaṃhastaṃ prasṛtaṃdakṣiṇānugamkālikātaṃḍavaṃ proktam || gauravarṇaḥskaṃdaṃdakṣiṇapārśve tu savyahaste dhṛtāṃjalimpāśaṃṭaṃkaṃ tathā daṃḍaṃnāgaṃ vai dakṣiṇekareanalaṃ pustakaṃ caiva varadaṃ ketukheṭakamsarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ śeṣaṃprathamanṛttavattraipuraṃtāṃḍavaṃ proktam || gauravarṇaḥkuṃcitaṃ vāmapādaṃtamapasmāroparisthitamabhayaṃśūlapāśau ca ḍamaruṃdakṣiṇekaregajahastopamaṃ vāme caturdorbhissamanvitamnaṃdīśaṃ savyabhāge tu vāmegaurīsamanvitamśiṣṭaṃ prathamanṛttavat || gauravarṇaḥ || 1umātāṃḍavamevaṃ syādgaurītāṃḍavamapyathosaṃhāratāṃḍavaṃ saptamamitthaṃ saptatāṃḍavāḥ || 2rudrobhīmo mahādevaḥ kīrtitāstvaṣṭamūrtayaḥ || 1 || ||varābhayakarāścaivaṭaṃka kṛṣṇadharāstathākesarovidrumonīlobhavādināṃ ca varṇakaḥ || 1śivoharastathā śarvaḥ kapālībhava eva caekādaśaite kathitāḥ rudrālokahiteratāḥyasmāt prajajñiredevāstaṃ śaṃbhuṃpraṇamāmyaham || 1|| śoṇavarṇaḥcaturvedaiśca sahitaṃ pinākinamahaṃbhajeharidvarṇaḥgiriśogirijāprāṇavallabhostu sadāmude || 1 || nīlavarṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sthāṇuṃnamāmi śirasā sarvadeva namaskṛtamśvetavarṇaḥhṛdayasthaḥ sadābhūyādbhargobhayavināśanaḥśyāmavarṇaḥrudrobhūtvāharannaṃte gatirmestu sadāśivaḥśyāmalavarṇaḥkalyāṇaguṇadhāmnestu śivāyavihitānatiḥpītavarṇaḥpinākāṃkitahastāyaharāyāstu namaskṛtiḥkṛṣṇavarṇaḥkhaḍgapāṇistīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraśśarvākhyostumude mamababhruvarṇaḥśūlapāṇissukhāyāstu kapālīmehyaharniśampāṭalavarṇaḥvedāṃtakṛtasaṃcāraṃ bhavaṃtaṃ śaraṇaṃbhajeśvetavarṇaḥrudraṃtriṇetramaruṇaṃ jaṭāmaṃḍaladhāriṇamvaiyyāghracarmavasanaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamaparābhyāṃ ca hastābhyāṃ bibhrāṇaṃparaśuṃmṛgampītaḥkālastathā babhruvarṇakaḥpāṭalassitaḥekādaśānāṃ rudrāṇāṃ varṇoyaṃsamudāhṛtaḥṛjutanusamapādasthānakaṃ vidrumābhaṃhariṇaparaśupāṇiṃpadmapīṭhopariṣṭhampravālavarṇaḥsavye tu nīlotpalacāruhastāṃ devasya vāmasthitapadmapīṭhāmśyāmavarṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sumukhaṃ paramutpaladṛgvaradaṃ hyumayāsahanaumisarūpamidamśvetavarṇaḥphālasthākṣaṃ prasannaṃtrinayanalasitaṃ baddhaveṇīkirīṭaṃ vāme gauryāsametaṃ namataśubhakaraṃ taṃ vṛṣārūḍhamīśam || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥśivakāmavallī caṃdraśekharasamīpasthāṃbāvatkāryāśaṃbhuṃdakṣiṇapārvatīkaratalaṃ savyena saṃgṛhṇataṃṭaṃkaṃ kṛṣṇamṛgaṃdharaṃ varakaraṃcūḍeṃdubaddhādaramtryakṣaṃ caturbhujaṃnaṃsye navayauvanagarvitamkuṃcitaṃ savyapādena sthitasavyetarāṃghrikam || 1 || siṃdūravarṇaḥdvibāhukāṃdvinetrāṃ ca sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāmdukūlavasanāṃ devīṃ kuryāddevasyavāmake || śyāmavarṇaḥyajñasūtrottarīyaṃ ca jaṭāmakuṭasaṃyutamsruvaṃdakṣiṇahaste tu pustakaṃ vāmakedadhamkuṃḍaṃ tu caturaśraṃ vai mekhalātrayasaṃyutamkuryānmadhye havyavāhaṃ jvālāpaṃcakasaṃvṛtambrahmaṇaḥ puratobhāgenyastāgniṃ samyagarcayet || pāṭalavarṇaḥdevyāstu dakṣiṇepārśve menakāsusmitānanāmsarvābharaṇasaṃyuktāṃ sarvālaṃkāraśobhitām || kāñcanavarṇaḥhastadvaye hemakuṃbhajalaṃdharakṛtiṃ bhajetdevasyavāmapārśve tu sanakaśca sanaṃdanaḥviṣṇvādyamaramukhyāśca vivāhe sevayāyutāḥsanakasanandanau pāṭalavarṇau || viṣṇvādīnāṃ tattadvarṇāḥbhasmadigdhaṃ vidrumābhaṃ kaṭyāṃpannagasaṃvṛtamdakṣiṇaṃ tatkarāgraṃ tu hariṇāsyānugaṃ bhavetvāme tvaparahaste tu triśūlaṃpiṃchadhāriṇamsamabhaṃgasthānakaṃ ca gamanonmukharūpakamevaṃ bhikṣāṭanaṃ proktam || guṃḍodaramathośṛṇu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hastadvayasamāyuktaṃ kapālaṃśirasi nyasetdaṃṣṭrākarālavaktraṃ ca pūrvoktaṃ lakṣaṇānvitamdevovidrumavarṇaḥ || guṃḍodaraḥśyāmavarṇaḥkṛṣṇaṭaṃkasamāyuktamabhayaṃvaradānvitamdakṣiṇelaṃbitaṃpādaṃ vāmapādaṃ tu śāyitamkāryaḥkāmaripustvevaṃ vakṣyehaṃkālanāśanam || raktavarṇaḥvāme kuṃcitapādamuddhṛtatalaṃkālasya vakṣasthalechinnābhinna jaṭādharaṃgirijayāyuktaṃ jagaddaivatamsavyapādaṃliṃgamūrdhni sthitaṃ raudramukhaṃ bhajet || 2 || raktavarṇaḥdvibhujaśca dvinetraśca bhasmarudrākṣasaṃyutaḥśivārcanaparaśśāṃtaḥ śivadhyānaparo bhavet || śvetavarṇaḥdevasya vāmapāśve tu kālaṃ mṛtyusvarūpakamhastadvaye daṃḍapāśakarṣaṇākṛtirūpakamtanmadhye mahiṣasthityākālarupamihocyate || śyāmavarṇaḥdhanurbāṇasamāyuktamumayāsahitaṃ tathāpatraṃdadhaṃvāmakarṇe dakṣiṇe kuṃḍalānvitamjaṭāmakuṭasaṃyuktaṃvilasadvidrumāṃgakam || 3 || evaṃ tripurasaṃhāram || vidrumavarṇaḥupavītasamāyuktaṃ sarvālaṃkāraśobhitamdakṣahaste sthitaṃchatraṃ vāmepūrṇakamaṃḍalumkarṇakuṃḍalasaṃyuktaṃ hāranūpurasaṃyutamsarvālaṃkārasaṃyuktaṃ kakṣekhaḍgasamanvitamjalaṃdharamathaproktam || devoraktavarṇaḥ || jalaṃdharaḥ pītavarṇaḥtāṭaṃkaṃkuṃḍalaṃ savyavāmaśrutyośca bibhratamvajraṃparaśupūrvāṃsaṃ vāme brahmakaroṭikamapare śūlahastaṃ ca śeṣaṃ purvoktavatkuru || gauravarṇaḥṭaṃkaṃ kṛṣṇamṛgaṃdharaṃparakare bhīṣmānaneṃdu prabhaṃvāmo mātibhayonmukhīsutayutaṃ sūcyāḍhyahastaṃharam || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dakṣiṇe khaḍgabāṇau ca vāme cāpaṃ gadāṃdharamruṃḍamālāsamāyuktaṃ pādukoparisusthitambhadrakālīsamāyukaṃ karālaṃ hṛdivinyaset || nīlavarṇaḥajavaktraṃ dvinayanaṃśṛṃgadvayavibhūṣitamnamaskārāṃ jaliṃvipraṃ śivadhyānaparāyaṇam || śyāmavarṇaḥ || 1savyeṭaṃkābhayaṃ syāditarakarayuge śaṃkhakaumodaki syāt kiṃcillālāṭanetraṃ vilasatupurataḥ śrīharerardhadehamphālārdhe locanārdhākalitasamapadaṃ śubhayajñopavītaṃ haryardhaṃnaumi śaṃbhuṃsakalaśubhakaraṃ sarvasaṃpatkarāḍhyamraktavarṇa īśkarabhāgaḥ || viṣṇubhāgaḥśyāmavarṇaḥvāmārdhaṃ vāmabhāge tu sīmaṃtatilakālakamdakṣiṇe kuṃḍalaṃkarṇedadhaṃ vāme tu patrakamvaradotpalake vāmekeyūrakaṭakānvitamśroṇyardhaṃ dakṣiṇe śaṃbhorvyāghracarmakṛtāṃbaramnūpurālaṃkṛtaṃ vāme savyapādaṃ tu kuṃcitamdevībhāgaśśyāmavarṇaḥsarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ divyāṃbarasamāvṛtamupavītasamāyuktaṃ samabhaṃgatanuṃkurusarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ kṛtāṃjalipuṭaṃ sthitamevaṃ kirātamākhyātam || devoraktavarṇaḥ || arjunaḥśyāmavarṇaḥśūlaṃkṛṣṇamṛgāsya laṃbitakaraṃ baddheṃdu cūḍaṃharaṃ vaṃdedeva-ṛṣīśvaraiḥ parivṛtaṃvaiyyāghracarmāṃbarampādayoḥ pādukāyuktaṃ kiṃcidvaigamanonmukhamśaṃkhaṃ tu vāmakarṇe tu pakṣiṇenakrakuṃḍalamchurikāṃ dakṣakaṭyāṃ tu dadhānaṃ bhūtasaṃyutamdevasya vāmapārśve tu mahābhūtaṃprakalpayetkapālaṃśirasi nyasya devavāme tu saṃsthitamevaṃ kaṃkālamākhyātam || devoraktavarṇaḥ || bhūtaḥkṛṣṇavarṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caṃḍeśasyottamāṃge pratinihitakaraṃ dakṣabhāgetriṇetraṃ sarvālaṃkārayuktaṃ śaśiśakaladharaṃgaṃgayāyuktamīḍedevasya bāhumātreṇacaṃḍeśāyāma-ucyatecaṃḍeśvaraṃ svarṇavarṇaṃbālabhūṣaṇabhūṣitamcaṃḍeśānugrahaṃproktamdevaḥ caṃḍeśaśca pītavarṇaḥcaturbāhuṃsuraktaṃ samṛgaṃparaśudhāriṇamvaradaṃ vāmahaste tu sarvālaṃkārasaṃyutamkaṃṭhenipīḍya sthita savyalaṃbāṃciṃtākulāmīśvaratuṣṭidātrīmdevoraktavarṇaḥ || devīśyāmavarṇāyastasmaidayayā paraṃ paśupatiṃpadmākṣa ityākhyayāṭaṃkaṃ kṛṣṇamṛgaṃvaraṃ ca dadhataṃcakrapradaṃtaṃbhajedadhameṇaṃ ca paraśuṃvaraṃ ca caiva vāmakedevasya vāmabhāge tu śyāmarūpaṃ susaṃsthitamśaṃkhacakrasamāyuktamuttare cāṃjaliṃ nyasetdevaḥśvetavarṇaḥ || viṣṇuḥśyāmavarṇaḥabhayaṃ śirasinyasyavaradaṃ vāmahastakeśayānaṃ dakṣiṇaṃpādaṃdadhaṃvāmaṃ tu laṃbitamdevasya vāmapārśve tu devīṃprahasitānanāmvāme varadasaṃyuktāṃ dvibhujāṃ ca triṇetrakāmekapīṭhasthitāṃ devīmumāṃskaṃdoktivatkurunamaskārāṃjalikaraṃ paśāṃkuśasamanvitamvighnaprasādamityuktam || devodevī ca śyāmavarṇau || vighneśoraktavarṇaḥvāmegauriyutaṃ sukhāsamubhayormadhye kumārasthitiṃsomāskaṃdavibhuṃmṛgābhayavarān ṭaṃkaṃdadhānaṃbhajecaturbhujaṃ triṇetraṃ ca jaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitamkṛṣṇaṭaṃkaṃ dadhānaṃ ca dakṣiṇe vāmakepi caupavītadharaṃ caiva śayānaṃ vāmapādakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tayormadhyagataṃ skaṃdaṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutamsomāskaṃdasya pārśve tu bhogaśaktiśca vāmakepaṃcaviṃśatimūrtīnāṃ somāskaṃdomahānmataḥdharāṃ tu kumudaṃ devīṃ vāmevaradasaṃyutāmsaralābjadharaṃhaste sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamsomāskaṃdamiti proktam || devoraktavarṇaḥ || devīśyāmavarṇā || skaṃdonīlavarṇaḥśaṃbhordakṣiṇavāmakakṣabhujayorbrahmācyutābhayāṃ sthitaṃ tattallakṣaṇamāyudhaiḥ parivṛtaṃ hastadvayāḍhyāṃjalimekapādamitikhyātaṃ sukhāsinam || raktavarṇaḥ || pakṣāṃtare śvetavarnopi prasiddhaḥaruṇāṃbaraśobhilasachubhadaṃguṇanetrasukhāsanarūpamidamabhayaṃ dakṣiṇehastevaradaṃ vāmahastakeśayānaṃdakṣiṇaṃpādaṃ dadhaṃvāmaṃ tu kuṃcitamsukhāsīnamiti proktam || raktavarṇaḥvyākhyāpīṭheniṣaṇṇassakalamunivaraissevitaḥ suprasannassavyālaḥ kṛttivāsāssatatamavatunodakṣiṇāmūrtirīśaḥbharadvājaśśaunakaścāpyagastyobhārgavastathākailāsaparvate tasmin vaṭavṛkṣasyamūlakeśubhravarṇaḥnālakādhasthitaṃ pādaṃliṃgodbhavasamanvitamdakṣevarāharūpasya rūpeṇādhogatohariḥsvarūpeṇadvipādasthāvajaviṣṇūvibhoḥpareśobhānvitaṃ śubhakaraṃsakalaprajānāmaiśvarya saṃghaparivṛddhikaraṃvidadhyātpakṣāṃtare śubhravarṇopi prasiddhaḥdvātriṃśadbāhusaṃyuktaṃ sūryasomāgnilocanamūdhrvakeśaṃ mahābāhuṃ nānālaṃkārabhūṣitamkhaḍgakhaṭvāṃgaparaśūnakṣamālāsthi śūlakamvaradaṃpāśahastaṃ ca gadāṃbāṇadhvajau tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kapālaṃ pustakaṃkuṃtaṃ durgāśliṣṭakarāṃbujamdaṃṣṭrollāsaṃ mahāsiṃhacchaṭācchaṭanipīḍitamraktavarṇaḥsiddha-ucchiṣṭavighneśaukṣiproheraṃbanāmakaḥvijayaḥkalpanṛttaścāpyūrdhva vighneśa-ucyateharidrākhyaścaikadaṃtassṛṣṭiruddaṃḍanāmakaḥsiṃhoyogaśca durgā ca devassaṃkaṭahārakaḥbālasūryamimaṃvaṃde devaṃbālagaṇādhipam || 1 || raktavarṇaḥdhatte sadāyastaruṇāruṇābhaḥ pāyātsayuṣmāṃstaruṇogaṇeśaḥ || 1 || raktavarṇaḥśaraccandrābhavapuṣaṃbhaje bhaktagaṇādhipam || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥśūlaṃ ca kuṃtaparaśudhvajamudvahaṃtaṃ vīraṃgaṇeśamaruṇaṃ satataṃsmarāmi || 1 || raktavarṇaḥsaṃdhyāruṇaṃ pāśasṛṇīvahaṃtaṃ bhayāpahaṃ śaktigaṇeśamīḍe || 1 || siṃdūravarṇaḥstaṃberamānanacatuṣṭayaśomamānaṃtvāṃyaḥ smareddijagaṇādhipatesadhanyaḥ || 1 || śubhravarṇaḥudvahanparaśumastu tenamaśrīsamṛddhiyuta hemapiṃgala || 1 || piṃgalavarṇaḥdadhaducchiṣṭanāmāyaṃ gaṇeśaḥ pātumecakaḥprakārāṃtareṇa nārīyonirasāsvādalolupaṃ kāmamohitam || nīlavarṇaḥpāṇiśritaiḥ parisamīhitabhūṣaṇaśrīrvighneśvarovijayateta panīyagauraḥ || 1 || svarṇavarṇaḥbaṃdhūkakamanīyābhaṃ dhyāyet kṣipragaṇādhipam || 1 || raktavarṇaḥphalamadhigatasiṃhaḥ paṃcamātaṃgavaktrogaṇapatiratigauraḥ pātuheraṃbanāmā || 1 || gauravarṇaḥśyāmenāttasaroruheṇasahitaṃ devīdvayaṃcāṃtike gorāṃgauvaradānahastasahitolakṣmī gaṇeśovatāt || gauravarṇaḥbījāpūragadekṣukārmukalasaccakrābjapāśotpalavrīhyagrasvaviṣāṇaratnakalaśān-hastairvahaṃtaṃbhaje || 1 || raktavarṇaḥvighnaṃnihaṃtunassarvaṃ raktavarṇo vināyakaḥ || 1 || raktavarṇaḥpītaprabhaṃkalpataroradhasthaṃbhajāmi nṛttopapadaṃgaṇeśam || 1 || raktavarṇaḥāliṃganodyatakaroharitāṃga yaṣṭyādevyākarotu śubhamūrdhvagaṇādhipome || 1 || kanakavarṇaḥhastāgrākḷpta pāśāṃkuśaradavaradonāgavaktro hi bhūṣodevaḥ padmāsanasthobhavatu sukhakarobhūtaye vighnarājaḥ || 1 || raktavarṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: puṣṭyāśliṣṭatanuṃ dhvajāgrakarayāpadmollasaddhastayā tadyonyā hitapāṇimāttavasumatpātrollasatpuṣkaram || 1 || raktavarṇaḥhemavarṇaṃ caturbāhuṃpāśāṃkuśadharaṃvarampuṣkarairmodakaṃ caiva dhārayaṃtamanusmaret || 2 || svarṇavarṇaḥśaśiśakalakalitamaulistrilocanoruṇaśca gajavadanaḥvighnapayodhrapavanaḥkaradhṛtakamalassadāstume bhūtyai || 2 || raktavarṇaḥpāśāṃkuśaudharaṃ devaṃ modakaṃdaṃtameva cabhaktābhayapradātāraṃvaṃde vighnavināśanam || haridrāvarṇaḥsalaḍḍukaṃdaṃtamadhaḥ karābhyāṃ vāmetarābhyāṃ ca dadhānamīḍe || 1 || śyāmavarṇaḥvighnaṃnihaṃtu naśśoṇaḥ sṛṣṭidakṣovināyakaḥ || 1 || raktavarṇaḥgaurāṃgyārucirāraviṃdakarayā devyā samāliṃgitaśśoṇāṃgaśśubhamātano tu bhajatāmuddaṃḍavighneśvaraḥ || 1 || raktavarṇaḥraktāṃśukogaṇapatirmude syādṛṇamocakaḥ || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥdhattekarairvighnarājoḍhuṃḍināmāmudestunaḥ || 1 || raktavarṇaḥraktāṃśukoratnakirīṭamālībhūtyai sadāmedvimukhogaṇeśaḥ || 1 || haridvarṇaḥpīṭhe svarṇamayāraviṃdavilasatsatkarṇikābhāsure svāsīnastrimukhaḥ palāśarucironāgānanaḥ pātunaḥ || 1 || raktavarṇaḥśuṃḍādaḍalasanmṛgeṃdravadanaḥ śaṃkheṃdugauraḥśubhodīvyadratnanibhāṃśukogaṇapatiḥ pāyādapāyātsanaḥ || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥpāśekṣvakṣānyogadaṃḍaṃdadhānopāyānnityaṃ yogavighneśvaronaḥ || 1 || raktavarṇaḥtaptakāṃcanasaṃkāśaścāṣṭahastomahattanuḥ || dīptāṃkuśaṃśaraṃcākṣaṃdaṃtaṃ dakṣevahankaraiḥraktāṃśukassadābhūyāddurgāgaṇapatirmude || 2 || kanakavarṇaḥlasadiṃdīvarahastāṃgaurāṃgīṃ ratnaśobhāḍhyāmnīlāṃśukalasamānaḥ pīṭhepadmāruṇe tiṣṭhansaṃkaṭaharaṇaḥpāyātsaṃkaṭapūgādgajānanonityam || raktavarṇaḥśvetārkapuṣpamālaṃ ca hemaratnakirīṭinamdivyagaṃdhānuliptāṃgaṃ śuklayajñopavītinamśivaśaktijñānayogaṃ jñānaśaktisvarūpakam || śvetavarṇaḥkukkuṭābhayavajrāṇi dadhataṃ varadaṃ kare
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mekhalāṃbarasaṃvītaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitamdhūmravarṇaprabhaṃ skaṃdaṃprabhāmaṇḍalamaṃḍitam || skaṃdarūpamidaṃproktam || dhūmravarṇaḥsruvākṣamālāṃkhaḍgaṃ ca svastikaṃdakṣiṇekareagnihotravidhiṃ devamagnijātasvarūpakamnīlavarṇaḥkuṃcitaṃ vāmapādaṃ ca susthitaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ padamvajraṃ cekṣudhanuśśūlaṃ varadaṃ vāmake dadhampadmapuṣpanibhaṃ caiva saurabheyasvarūpakam || pāṭalavarṇaḥkaraṃḍamukuṭopetaṃ kukkuṭadhvajadhāriṇamparaśuṃpūrṇakuṃbhaṃ ca savyahaste tu dhāriṇamaraṇiṃkukkuṭaṃ vāmegāṃgeyasamarūpakam || pāṭalavarṇaḥsarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ siṃhasthaṃ dadhataṃbhajekhaḍgaṃkhetaṃ ca vajraṃ ca kukkuṭadhvajadhāriṇamśarajanmasamākhyātam || raktavarṇaḥśaktiṃśūlaṃ tathā ca kramaṃkuśābhayamanyakemayuravāhanārūḍhaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitambālasūryapratīkāśaṃ kārtikeyaṃ śivātmajam || raktavarṇaḥśaktiṃcābhayadadaṃkṣe savyevaradavajrakepadmapuṣpaṃdharaṃ kaṃṭhedevaṃbālasvarupakam || raktavarṇaḥkukkuṭaṃ ca dhanuḥkheṭaṃśaṃkhaṃdhattehalaṃvaramjayā ca vijayā caiva vāmadakṣiṇapārśvayoḥṣaṇmukhaṃcābhayaṃ khaḍgaṃ śaktiṃ vāmetaredadhamtārakāriṃbhajekhyātam || raktavarṇaḥsarvāvaraṇasaṃyuktaṃ divyagaṃdhānulepanamsusmitaṃcāruvadanaṃ devasenāpatiṃbhaje || 2 || śyāmavarṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śūlaṃ vajraṃdharaṃ savyevarābhayakamanyakejāyayā vāmapārśve tu kalyāṇotsavavigrahampādāṃbujaṃ hṛdidhyāttvāguharūpaṃsamāśraye || śyāmavarṇaḥdakṣabhāge daṃḍahastaṃ vajravāmoruhastakamśikhāyajñopavītāḍhyaṃmauṃjīkaupīnasaṃyutamdivyarūpadharaṃ devaṃ brahmacāriṇamāśraye || 3 || raktavarṇaḥśaktihastadvayaṃ caiva japamālādharaṃśubhamityevaṃ vidhivaddhyāyecchiva devasyadeśikam || 2 || raktavarṇaḥvaradābhayasaṃyuṃktapuṣpabāṇekṣukārmukamkrauṃcabhedakara dvaṃdvaṃkrauṃca bhedisvarūpakam || 2 || raktavarṇaḥpāśāṃkuśaṃdadhaṃ caiva jvalākeśaśikhaṃḍakamcaturdaśādibhavanaṃ śikhivāhanamācaret || 2 || raktavarṇaḥkātyāyanīsutamahaṃ kaṭibaddhavāmahastaṃ ca daṃḍadharadakṣiṇahastamīḍe || 1 || raktavarṇaḥdadhataṃ ruṃḍamālāṃ ca pādukādvayasaṃyutamdakṣiṇaṃpītavasanaṃ vīrabhadramupāsmahe || nīlavarṇaḥakṣayasvarṇamāṇikyagaṇapūritapātrakamsatataṃ ciṃtayed bhaktyābhairavaṃ sarvasiddhidammadonmattaṃ sadānaṃdaṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtamevaṃ dhyāyecca maṃtrajñaḥ svarṇākarṣaṇabhairavam || pītavarṇaḥśūlaṃ kapālaṃpāśaṃ ca ḍamuruṃdadhataṃkaraiḥśvānārūḍhaṃ ca nirvāṇaṃ vadukaṃ bhairavaṃbhaje || 2 || raktavarṇaḥanukṛtaśaśitejaḥ kuṃḍalaṃ cāruhāsaṃ prakaṭadaśanaśobhānirjitāneka hīramsaphaṇapavanabhugdordaṃḍabhūṣābhirāmaṃkara ḍamaruninādaiḥ pūritadyokhagarbhambhujagaphaṇasuguptairbhūṣaṇairnyastabhūṣaṃpraṇata surakirīṭavyāptapā dāraviṃdamkanakagirisamābhaṃnaiśacūrṇābhirāmaṃ sakalanigamaguhyaṃ naumimallāridevam || 4 || raktavarṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṭaṃkaṃca śūlamabhayaṃjapamālikāṃ ca bibrāṇamekamanasāsatataṃ smarāmi || 1 || raktavarṇaḥsaṃhārābhaṃsumūrdhānaṃ prativatkraṃ trilocanamśaktimudgaraśaṃkhāsīn dadhānaṃ somasūtriṇamsāṃgaṃpāśupataṃ śastraṃbhaje padmāsane sthitam || raktavarṇaḥghaṃṭāṃkapālaṃ ca sṛṇiṃmuḍaṃ cāpikṛpāṇakamdadhānaṃ raktavasanaṃbhajehaṃ khaḍgarāvaṇam || 2 || raktavarṇaḥaṣṭāṣṭakamidaṃ puṇyaṃ bhairavāṇāmabhīṣṭadampūrvavadvarṇatodhyāne dhyeyaṃ sarvaiḥ pṛthak pṛthakpāśaṃ cāsiṃdadhānaṃ ca dhyāyetsarvāṅgasuṃdaram || 1 || kanakavarṇamdadhānaṃpustakaṃ vīṇāṃsuśvetamaṇibhūṣaṇam || 1 || śvetavarṇamdhyāyettṛtīyaṃ śubhadamaṣṭakaṃśubhalakṣaṇam || 1 || nīlavarṇamdhūmravarṇamabhipretaṃ dhyāyedaṣṭakamādarātkuṃtaṃ kheṭaṃ ca parighaṃbhiṃḍivālaṃ tathaiva ca || dhūmravarṇampaṃcamāṣṭakametadviśvetaṃ syātsumanoharam || śvetavarṇam || 1paṃcamāṣṭakametaddhiśvetaṃ syātsumanoharamkrameṇapītaraktataṭidvarṇāḥsvacchaṃdovighnasaṃtuṣṭaḥ khecaraḥ sacarācaraḥviśvarūpovirūpākṣo nānārūpadharaḥparaḥbhūmikaṃponīlakaṃṭho viṣṇuśca kulapālakaḥabhrarūpodharāpālaḥ kuṭilomaṃtranāyakaḥśaṃkarobhūtavetālotriṇetrastripurāṃtakaḥhasticarmāṃbaradharoyogīśo brahmarākṣasaḥbhīṣaṇākhyobhayaharassarvajñākhyastathaiva casaṃhāraścātiriktāṃgokālāgniśca priyaṃkaraḥghoranādoviśālākṣoyogīśodakṣasaṃsthitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: iti śrīmatsamastabhūmaṃḍalamaṃḍanāyamānanikhiladeśāvataṃ sakarnāṭakajanapadasaṃpadadhiṣṭhānabhūta śrīmanmahīśūramahāsaṃsthāna madhyadedīpyamānāvikalakalānidhikulakramāgata rājakṣitipālapramukhanikhilarājādhirājamahārājacakravartimaṃḍalānubhūtadivya-ratnasiṃhāsanārūḍha śrīmadrājādhirājarājaparameśvara prauḍhapratāpā pratimavīranarapatibirudeteṃbaragaṃḍalokaika vīrayadukulapayaḥ pārāvārakalānidhiśaṃkhacakrāṃkuśakuṭhāramakaramatsya śarabhasālvagaṃḍabheruṃḍadharaṇīvarāhahanumadgaruḍakaṃṭhīravādyaneka virudāṃkitamahīśūrapuravarādhīśa śrīkṛṣṇarājamahārājaviracite śrītattvanidhyākhyagraṃthe mahākailāsamūrtyādiśivamūrtisvarūpanirūpaṇaṃnāmatṛtīyaśśivanidhissaṃ-pūrṇaḥyajñasūtrottarīyaṃ ca jaṭāmakuṭasaṃyutamsruvaṃ dakṣiṇahaste ca pustakaṃ vāmahastakepadmapatradalāgrābhaṃ dhyāyedevaṃ caturmukham || 3 || pāṭalavarṇaḥcaturbhujā sā kartavyā tathaiva ca samasthitāvāmayośca tathā kārye vaiṇavī ca kamaṃḍaluḥsamapādāpratiṣṭhāpyākāryā saumyamukhīsitā || śvetavarṇābaddhapadmāsanaṃ tuṣṭaṃ tathā kṛṣṇājināṃbaramvāmanyaste tarakaraṃ tasyaikaṃdoryugaṃ bhavetkamaṃḍaluṃ dvitīye ca sarvābharaṇadhāriṇampadmapatradalāgrābhaṃ dhyānasaṃmīlite kṣaṇamācāryaḥ kārayedevaṃ citre vā vāstukarmaṇi || pāṭalavarṇaḥādityavarṇodharmajñassākṣasūtradharastathārūpaṃ pūrvoditaṃkāryaṃ sarvamanyajjagatpateḥ || pāṭalavarṇaḥsāvitrī tasya kartavyāvāmotsaṃgagatā śubhābrahmoktaṃ paramaṃrūpaṃ sarvaṃ kāryaṃ prajāpateḥ || pāṭalavarṇaḥdvibhujodaśapāṇiśca tejomūrtidharomahān || 1 || pāṭalavarṇaḥsarvābharaṇavāñchāṃtodharmakārya vidavyayaḥmūrtimān vyavasāyastu kāryodakṣiṇabhāgataḥkāryau padmakaraumūrdhni vinyastau ca tathātayoḥ || 3 || pāṭalavarṇaḥ || 2kardamaḥ kaśyapodakṣonavaite brahmasūnavaḥ || 1akṣasrakkuṃḍikāpāṇiṃ jaṭāvalkalabhūṣitamakṣasrakkuṃḍikāhastaṃ prajeśaṃkanakaprabham || 1 || kanakavarṇaḥjaṭilaṃśmaśrulaṃ śāṃtaṃśyāmalāṃgaṃbhaje'niśam || 1 || śyāmavarṇaḥśāṃtaṃjitāriṣaḍvargamakṣasragdaṃḍahastakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛṣṇājinottarīyaṃ ca jaṭilaṃpiṃgalaprabham || piṃgalavarṇaḥakṣamālāṃkuṃḍikāṃ ca dadhataṃghanamecakam || 1 || nīlavarṇaḥjaṭilaṃśmaśrulaṃdaṃḍakamaṃlukarojjvalamsaptārcirivabhāsvaṃtaṃ dhyāyehaṃtapasāṃnidhim || raktavarṇaḥjaṭāmakuṭaśobhāḍhyaṃ saṃdhyābhrāruṇavigrahamakṣasrakkuṃḍikāhastaṃcīrakṛṣṇājināṃbaram || siṃdūravarṇaḥpraṇavabrahmasaṃsaktacittaṃ satkāṃcanaprabhamprajāsaṃsarjanodyuktamakṣasrakkuṃḍikādharam || 2 || kāṃcanavarṇaḥnamaskārāṃjaliṃvaṃde śivadhyānaparāyaṇam || 1 || svāyaṃbhuvaṃ ghanaśyāmaṃ dakṣamadhvaradīkṣitam || śyāmavarṇaḥ || 1jaṭilāśśmaśrulāśśāṃtā-āsīnā dhyānatatparāḥjamadagnirvasiṣṭho trisapta vaivasvateṃtare || 1akṣasrakkuṃḍikādaṃḍāndadhānaṃ gautamaṃbhaje || 1 || kanakavarṇaḥakṣasragdaṃḍahastaṃ ca munimāṃgirasaṃbhaje || 1 || śyāmavarṇaḥkumudvatīpatiṃśāṃtaṃ viśvāmitraṃbhajāmyaham || 1 || pītavarṇaḥjapākṣasragdharaṃ patnīsahitaṃ munipuṃgavam || 1 || kṛṣṇavarṇaḥdaṃḍākṣasūtrapāṇiṃ ca jamadagniṃ namāmyaham || 1 || raktavarṇaḥsragdaṃḍapāṇiṃvaradaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ praṇamāmyaham || 1 || sitavarṇaḥanasūyāpatiṃśāṃtamatriṃniṣkalmaṣaṃbhaje || 1 || asitavarṇaḥ || 1sitāruṇaṃ pītakṛṣṇaṃsiṃharūpāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 1yamavāyuśiveṃdrāśca jñeyādharmādidevatāḥ || (eteṣāṃ lakṣaṇānidikpāleṣu draṣṭavyā 4 nidhau)caturbhujāssiṃhavaktrāssita pūrvāruṇāḥpareaparābhyāṃ ca vibhrāṇāḥ karābhyāṃ yogapīṭhakaumukheśvetavarṇāḥ || śarīreruṇavarṇāḥnir-ṛtiścaiva durgā ca kāmorudrastathaiva ca || 1 || (eteṣāṃ svarūpāṇiṃ tattanmūrtilakṣaṇe pūrvamuktānivakṣyaṃte ca krameṇa 4 - 5 - 2 - 5 nidhau) || (rudraḥ-ārdrānakṣatradevatāvat) durgāraudrivatsaradevatāvat)gīrvāṇamutapādābjaṃpuṇyaṃ hṛdivibhāvaye || 1 || svarṇavarṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: surāpānahṛdāyuktaṃ gurutalpakaṭidvayamupapātakaromāṇaṃpiṃgabhrūśmaśrulocanamkhaḍgacarmadharaṃkṛṣṇaṃkukṣaupāpaṃ viciṃtayet || kṛṣṇavarṇaḥdīrghajihvaṃ pītavastraṃ smarāmibagalāmukham || 1 || pītavarṇaḥ prasiddhaḥakṣamālādharaḥ saumyaḥ prītovyākhyāpanodyataḥ || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥvāme kuliśapāṇistu bhūtidomaṃgalapradaḥ || 1 || pītavarṇaḥakṣamālānvitodakṣe vāmekuṃbhadharassmṛtaḥ || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥakṣamālānvito vāmedakṣekuṃbhadharassmṛtaḥ || 1 || śvetavarṇaḥhastābhyāṃdadhatīpadmaṃ pītavastramanūpamamsāmidhenīsamākhyātā || śubhravarṇāsṛgāyālakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu || raktavarṇāviśālākṣī padmahastākṛśodarī || 1 || raktavarṇāsavyeśukaṃ tathā dakṣedhānyamaṃjarikāṃ tathādadhānāsākahūrdevī || śvetavarṇāsūkarāsyā cakorākṣī caṃpakā bhāsitāṃśukākanakavarṇāḥkāśyapaṃcayajurvedaṃ rudradaivaṃ tu taṃ viduḥadhidaivaṃ vijāniyādvaitānaṃ syādatharvaṇe(atharvaṇavedābhimānībrahmā bṛhaspatipratyadhidevatāvat 4 ni0)akṣasūtraṃ sudhākuṃbhaṃ bibhadārogyado bhṛśampītavarṇaḥudatiṣṭhanmahārājapuruṣaḥ paramādbhutaḥśyāmalastaruṇaḥ sragvī sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥnīlakuṃcitakeśāṃta subhagassiṃhavikramaḥsavaibhagavatassākṣādviṣṇoraṃśāṃśa saṃbhavaḥsitavasanavirājanmaulirārogyadāyīśatamakhamaṇivarṇaḥ pātudhanvaṃtarirnaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nīlavarṇaḥkālāṃbhodojjvalāṃgaṃ kaṭitaṭavilasaccārupītāṃbarāḍhyaṃ vaṃde dhanvaṃtariṃ taṃ nikhilagadavanavrātadāvāgnilīlambibhrāṇaḥ karuṇākaraśśubhakarassarvāmayadhvaṃsakassarvaṃ te duritaṃ chinattu bhagavāndhanvaṃtarissaṃtatamnīlavarṇaḥdhanurbāṇadharoraudro mastake kapilā jaṭāḥpītavarṇaḥsahasranetraṃ pītābhamiṃdraṃ hṛdi vibhāvayepītavarṇaḥ || (śukrapratyadhi devatāvat 5 ni0)tryakṣasūtrā sa kuṇḍā ca ṣaḍbhujādaṃḍapaṃkajāśubhravarṇāsāvitrī tasya kartavyā vāmotsaṃgagatāśubhāpāṭalavarṇaḥ(paṃcabrahmasuprajāpatibrahmavat 4 ni0)kuṭhāradaṃḍābjahasto mekhalākuṇḍalānvitaḥkumudavarṇaḥyajñasūtrottarīyaṃ ca jaṭāmakuṭasaṃyutamsruvaṃ dakṣiṇahaste ca pustakaṃ vāmahastakepāṭalavarṇaḥ || (trimūrtyaṃtargatabrahmavat 4 ni0)vīṇākarānvitaṃ divyaṃ divyavastravibhūṣitamśubhravarṇambhāsākuṃdeṃdu śaṃkhasphaṭikamaṇinibhābhāsamānā samānāsāmevāgdevateyaṃ nivasatu vadane sarvadāsu prasannā || 1 || śvetavarṇāpāśapaṃkajasaṃyuktaṃ sākṣasūtraṃ sa pustakamniruktamitinirṇītam || śubhravarṇamvaruṇoṃbupatissvarṇa varṇo makaravāhanaḥkanakavarṇaḥ || (dikpālāntargatavaruṇavat 4 ni0)
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: cakorāsyaṃ japāpuṣpaṃ śaktiṃ bibhracchikhānvitamdadhānāśubhadāmesyād devamātā yaśasvinīpītavarṇā || (punarvasvadhidevatāvat 5 ni0)akṣasūtraṃ japāṃbibhraddhastayordakṣavāmayoḥkanakavarṇaḥ || (caturviṃśatimūrtirathaharivat 2 ni0)akṣasūtraṃ dadhaddakṣe sūdhāpūrṇaṃ ghaṭaṃpareśvetavarṇamgadāpāṇirdvibāhuśca kartavyo varadaḥ śaśīśvetavarṇaḥ || (navagrahasthacaṃdravat 5 ni0)siṃhāsyo dakṣiṇe sūtraṃ dhvajaṃvāmakare dadhatnīlavarṇamvaradānakaraṃdhūmravarṇaṃ vāyu mahaṃbhajedhūmravarṇaḥ || (paṃcabhūtasthavāyuvat 4 ni0)muktājapākṣa dhṛk dakṣe tulā hastaṃ tu vāmataḥśvetavarṇamsarvābharaṇavānśveto dharmaḥ kāryo vijānatāśvetavarṇaḥakṣasūtrā bhayaṃjñeyaṃ nānābharaṇabhūṣitamcaṃpakavarṇamśvetavarṇaḥ || (anyat sarvaṃ 14 manuṣudraṣṭavyam 4 ni0)akṣasūtraṃ ghaṭaṃvibhrat paṃkajā varaṇānvitaḥdūrvāśyāmavarṇaḥsāvitrī tasya kartavyā vāmotsaṃgagatā śubhāpāṭalavarṇaḥ || (paṃcabrahmasthaprajāpatibrahmavat 4 ni0)akṣasūtraṃ triśūlaṃ ca bibhrāṇaṃ ca trilocanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śvetavarṇamsumukhīkṛtamutpala dṛgvaradamumayā sahadeva sa rūpamidamśvetavarṇaḥakṣasūtraṃ halaṃbibhradvanamālāvibhūṣitamśvetavarṇamsa tu śuklavapuḥ kāryo nīlavāsāyadūttamaḥdakṣordhvakareśaṃkhaḥ dakṣādhaḥ kare musalaṃ vāmādhaḥ kareśārṅgaṃ vāmordhva kare lāṃgalamśvetavarṇaḥ || vyūhamūrtivat 2 ni0)sūtrapātradharaṃbhīmaṃ vyāghracarmāṃbarā vṛtamśvetavarṇamvaradābhayaśūlākṣa sūtradhṛk parameśvaraḥśvetavarṇaḥ || (sūryapratyadhidevatāvat 5 ni0)akṣasūtraṃ pātākāṃ ca dadhataṃ kuṃḍalānvitamdakṣiṇordhvakare padmaṃ śaṃkhaṃ tasyāpyadhaḥ karebibhrataṃ puṃḍarīkākṣaṃ phaṇāsaptānvitaṃ bhajegomūtravarṇaḥjāpyadaṃḍadharaṃdīrghaṃ na khalomajaṭādharamjñānābhayāṃkita karaṃkapilaṃ ca dattaṃ dhyāyedajādi samitiṃ pratibodhayaṃ tamraktavarṇaḥnyāyaśāstraṃ tathākāvya malaṃkāraśca nāṭakamdeśabhāṣāparijñānaṃ lipijñānaṃ lipikriyāsāmudrikaṃ ca śakunaṃ parīkṣāratnasaṃtateḥgajaśāstraṃ mallavidyā pākakarma tataḥ paramdhātuvādaḥ khanīvādo rasavādastataḥ paraḥvāyustaṃbhastathā vaśyaṃ mohanākarṣaṇe tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāṇijyaṃ pāśupālyaṃ ca kṛṣirā savakarma caratikauśalamākheṭo pyadṛśyakaraṇī tathātathaiva dyūtakaraṇī corakarmājanaṃ tathājalaplavanavāksiddhi ghuṭikā siddhayastathāvidyāmaheṃdrajālena catuṣṣaṣṭirmatā imāḥcaturbhūjāṃ saumyatanuṃ caṃḍāṃśu sadṛśāṃbarāmdakṣiṇābhyāṃ tathāvāma karābhyāṃ sarasīruhamdiṅnāgānāṃ caturṇāṃ ca pṛṣṭhārūḍhāṃ caturbhujāmśubhravarṇāmādhuryaguṇasaṃyuktāḥ sarvālaṃkāraśobhitāḥdadhānāḥ pāśakalaśau sadāmakaravāhanāḥśubhravarṇāḥmeṣārūḍaṃ saptahastaṃ svāhādevī samanvitamkanakavarṇaḥvaradānakaraṃdhūmravarṇaṃvāyumahaṃbhajedhūmravarṇaḥcaṃdrārkahastaṃ dvibhujaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamnīlavarṇamraktavarṇāpadmavarṇāpītavarṇāharidvarṇākṛṣṇavarṇānīlavarṇāraktavarṇā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śvetavarṇāūrdhvāgaganasannimā || nīlavarṇāadhasthāpṛthivītulyā || śvetavarṇāmahāpadmaśca śaṃkhaśca kulikoṣṭau kulānihipratyekaṃ tu sahasrāṣṭa phaṇaistau samalaṃkṛtaupratyekaṃ tu phaṇā śaptaśatasaṃkhyā virājitaupītavarṇau phaṇaiḥ paṃcaśatatuṃgottamāṃgakauphaṇātriśatakau jñeyau vikhyātā vititattvataḥ || 5puṣpadaṃto bṛhacchyāmo ṣaḍdaṃtaḥ puṣpadaṃtavānpuṣpadaṃtassārvabhaumassupratīkoṣṭadiggajāḥ || 1tāmraparṇīsudaṃtī syādaṃ janācāṃjanāvatī || 1abhayaṃ dakṣiṇe haste varadaṃvāmahastakeratnakaustubhamaṇikya divyābharaṇabhūṣitamairāvatagajārūḍhaṃ śacīkāṃtaṃ namāmyahamhemavarṇaḥtripātprasannavadanassukhāsīnaśśuci smitaḥvibhraddakṣiṇahaste tu śaktimannaṃ srucaṃ sruvammeṣārūḍhaṃ jaṭābaddhaṃ ghoravarṇaṃ mahodaramātmābhimukhamāsīnamevaṃ dhyāyeddhutāśanamraktavarṇaḥśyāmavarṇaṃ pāśahastaṃ kṛtāṃtaṃ praṇamāmyahamraktavarṇo hi lokānāṃ svasvakarmaphalapradaḥśyāmavarṇaḥūrdhvakeśo virūpākṣaḥ karālaḥ kālikā priyaḥnīlavarṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: varuṇoṃbu patiḥsvarṇa varṇomakaravāhanaḥsvarṇavarṇaḥhemadaṃḍadhvajaḥ śyāmo varṇato mohinī priyaḥśyāmavarṇaḥnidhīśvaraḥ svarṇavarṇo dhanadorūpavānprabhuḥsvarṇavarṇaḥvaradābhayaśūlākṣa sūtradhṛtparameśvaraḥśvetavarṇaḥdhruvaṃdhruvāya yaśase ciṃtayāmi sadāmudāpītavarṇaḥagniśuśrūṣaṇaratamadhvaraṃ praṇamenvahamśyāmavarṇaḥratnasiṃhāsanagataṃ somaṃ hṛdivibhāvayesitavarṇaḥāpaḥśubhapradāssaṃtu matsyavāhanasaṃgatāḥśvetavarṇāḥsamastadevanivahavaṃdyamānapadāṃbujaḥharidvarṇaḥkirīṭojjvalamūrdhānamanalaṃ bhāvayāmyahamlohitavarṇaḥpratyūṣaṃ ciṃtaye bhūyaḥ pratyūhonmūlakāraṇamśvetavarṇaḥakṣasūtrojjvalakaraṃ vyāghrājinanivāsinamśvetavarṇaḥāpaḥsitā itiproktā hyanalolohitaḥ smṛtaḥ

sanskrit: pāṭalavarṇaḥghaṭaṃ daṃḍaṃ ca bibhrāṇaṃ devaṃ hṛdivibhāvayegomūtravarṇaḥmudgaraṃ kuṃḍikāṃ caiva bibhrāṇaṃ hṛdibhāvayegomedavarṇaḥkaśerupūritaṃ pātraṃ ghaṭaṃ bibhradvidūrathaḥkapilavarṇaḥdaṃḍaṃ śaktiṃ ca bibhrāṇo dvibujosau jaṭāyutaḥśubhravarṇaḥmakarasthoṃbujaṃdakṣe vāme kalaśamādadhatśvetavarṇaḥmakarasthoṃbujaṃdakṣe vāme kalaśamādadhatmauktikavarṇaḥ || 1dadhānā dvibhujāḥ pūjyā nadyo makaravāhanāḥ || 1bhāgīrathīṃ namasyāmi gaṃgāṃtripathagāṃ nadīmśubhravarṇā || 1 || - ||vidhiharihararūpāṃ seṃdukoṭīrajuṣṭāṃ kalitasitadukūlāṃ jāhnavīṃ tāṃ namāmi || 1 || śvetavarṇā || 1|| - ||lāvaṇyāmṛtaniṣyaṃda saṃśliṣadnātrayaṣṭikāmevaṃ dhyāyet susaumyāṃ ca caṃdrāyuta samaprabhāmsudhāplāvitabhūpṛṣṭhāṃ divyagaṃdhānulepanāmśvetavarṇākṛṣṇapādarajaḥpūtāṃ yamunāṃ hṛdi bhāvayetkṛṣṇavarṇāpāvanīṃ sarvalokasya svargadvārasya kuṃcikāmpāṭalavarṇā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛṣṇāṃgarajasādhūta kalmaṣe te namonamaḥkṛṣṇavarṇākalyāṇajananīṃ loke namāmi kanakaprabhāmkanakavarṇāaṃtastāpapraśamanīṃ praṇamāmi mahānadīmraktavarṇāveṇīṃ pravālasaṃkāśāmupāse sukhasiddhayeraktavarṇānamāmi maṃgalānaṃda saṃdhātrīṃ bahudhāmudāmauktikavarṇāyo dhatte sarvajīvānāṃ varaṃ jīvaṃ ca śoṣakampāśaṃ cakraṃ kisalayaṃ kuṃḍikāṃ daśabhiḥ karaiḥśvetavarṇāphullaraktotpalākṣau ca pītasragvastravarṇakauśvetavarṇau || 2 || - ||pādādi kaṃṭhaparyaṃtamaśvarūpaṃ prakalpayetśrotradvayau sthūlakaṃṭhau caturbāhusamanvitaukaraṃḍaṃ cāmṛtaghaṭaṃvāma haste ca bibhrataḥdevānāṃdasranāsatyau nāmnoktau śvetarūpiṇauśvetavarṇaughāsamuṣṭiṃ tathākuṃḍīṃ bibhrāṇābhūtapuṣṭidāgauravarṇā || 1|| - ||maṇḍūkanetrāṃ sannāsāṃ kāmadhenupraninditāmatyāyata śirogrīvāṃ vismitā syābhivīkṣitāmgauravarṇā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gadātriśūlacakre ca padmaṃ ceti daśāyudhamkṛtāṃjali puṭopetāḥ karaṃḍamukuṭānvitāḥnānāvarṇamahāvidyun nīlajīmūtavarṇakamśāraṃ dābhraṃ ca raktaṃ ca vajrādīnāṃ ca varṇakamśesāḥ puṃstvena vikhyātāḥ kīrtitāstvastramūrtayaḥ || 5 || - ||dhanuḥ strīraktapadmābhā mūrdhnibhūṣita cāpabhṛtuktānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ mūrdhnisvāyudhalāṃchanambhujau dvau tu prakartavyau skaṃdhalagna tadā yudhaustrīrūpiṇī pāṭalābhā svetāśva varavāhanādakṣe vāme śamkhaghaṃṭā kheṭābhaya gadāstathākausuṃbhavastrasaṃvītā pujitā ceṣṭadā nṛṇāmpāṭalavarṇākhaḍgacāpau bhṛśuṃḍīṃ ca śūlaṃ śaktiṃ varaṃ halamcaturdaśabhujairddhatte dakṣevāme pṛthakpṛhakraktavarṇājāṃbūnadarucirnṛtyan mayūravaravāhanādadhānākramaśaścitra vasanāmakuṭojjvalāraktavarṇāṣaḍbhirbhujaiścakraśaṃkha varābhayadhanuśśarānkanakavarṇāsaṃdhyāruṇoṣṭabhirhastaiścakraṃ padmaṃnidhiṃvaramdadhānaḥ pītavasanaḥ kirīṭāṃgadaśobhitaḥraktavarṇaḥmeghavarṇaḥ karālāsyaḥ krūradaṃṣṭraśca digbhujaiḥśaṃkhaṃdaḍaṃśaraṃkhaṭvā bhayaubibhradarīnvaśe
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: meghavarṇaḥcakraśūlagadādaṃḍa khaḍgaghaṃṭāvaraṃdhanuḥdadhāno dvyaṣṭabhirhastairnīlaśuklacitāṃśukaḥraktavarṇaḥśatarūpā tasya bhāryā kṣatradharmamanuvrataḥākūtiḥrdevahūtiśca prasūtiḥ śvetavarṇavānyatradharmāśca vividhāḥ caturvarṇya śritāśśubhāḥśvetavarṇaḥdyumatsuṣeṇarociṣmat pramukhāstasya cātmajāḥtaptakārtasvarābhāsassarveṣāṃ jagatāṃ patiḥhemavarṇaḥbhāryoṣāsṛṃjayajayahotrādyāstasya cātmajāḥcaturṇāmekasaptatyā yugānāṃ patirīśvaraḥraktavarṇaḥkhyātiḥ patnīketumaṃta ityādyāstatsutāmatāḥharidvarṇostradhārī tu sarveṣāṃ jagatāṃ prabhuḥharidvarṇaḥpatnīviṃdhyāvaliḥ putrādattakārjunapūrvakāḥsadākhaḍgādyastradhārī sarveṣāṃ jagatāṃ prabhuḥśyāmavarṇaḥādityapautrastatpatnī kāṃtistasyātmajāñchṛṇubrāhmavratadharodevaḥ sarveṣāṃ jagatāṃ prabhuḥraktavarṇaḥikṣvāku pramukhāḥ putrāḥ patnīriṣṭiritīritāsauvarṇavarṇaḥ padmākṣo jagatāṃ prabhurīritaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: svarṇavarṇaḥnirmohavirājaskādyāḥ pūtrāḥ patnī tu devikācaturṇāmekasaptatyā yugānāṃ prabhurīritaḥśyāmavarṇaḥpatnīparādhṛṣṭaketurityādyāstatsutāssmṛtāḥcaturnāmekasaptatyā yugānāṃ prabhurīritaḥraktavarṇaḥtatsutābhūriṣeṇādyāstatpatnī bṛhatī matāsarveṣāṃ jagatāṃ bhartā pūrvoktā manavo yathāśvetavarṇaḥdharmaputrastatsutāstu satyadharmādayomatāḥcaturṇāmekasaptatyā yugānāṃ prabhurīritaḥraktavarṇaḥdevānudevāstatputrāḥ patnītvāryā nṛbhiḥ smṛtāḥcaṃḍapraśāsanastvāsīt sarveṣāṃ jagatāṃ prabhuḥśyāmavarṇaḥāsīdvedaśirāḥ putrobrāhmaṃdharmamanuvrataḥcaturṇāmekasaptatyā yugānāṃ patirīśvaraḥśvetavarṇaḥiṃdraputrastatsutāścāpyurugaṃbhīrakādayaḥabhūtpatnīmatistasya sarveṣāṃ jagatāṃ prabhuḥnīlavarṇaḥ || 1aśvatthāmā ciraṃjīvī dīrghamāyurdadātumeśvetavarṇaḥviṣṇupādāṃkitaśirāściraṃ jīvīprasīdatu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛṣṇavarṇaḥciraṃjīvī dīrghamāyurdadātu jaṭilo mamakṛṣṇavarṇaḥsaṃjīvanāpahartā me dīrghamāyurdadātvihasphaṭikavarṇaḥdadātu cirajīvitvaṃ ciraṃjīvī jiteṃdriyaḥkṛṣṇavarṇaḥvitanotu prasannātmā yāvajjīvamarogatāmśvetavarṇaḥdadātu cirajīvitvaṃ prasannātmā bhṛgūdvahaḥsvarṇavarṇaḥdhyāyāmyahaṃ mahāsaumyaṃ prahlādaṃ cirajīvinamsvarṇavarṇaḥvedaśāstrārtha tattvajñaṃ mārkaṃḍeya mahaṃbhajeśubhravarṇaḥ || 1vyāsaḥ kṛṣṇo mārutistu sphaṭikābhaḥ prakīrtitaḥjāmadagnyassuvarṇābho mārkaṃḍeyassitassmṛtaḥprahlādaśca suvarṇābho varṇā eṣāṃ prakīrtitāḥsa vedāśca vasiṣṭhaśca bhṛgurnārada eva casukuṃbhākṣadharāḥkāryā munayo dvibhujā daśasakhyeva vīṇayāvāma bhujamūlopagūḍhayāśvetavarṇāḥbhṛvaṇo bhāvanaścaiva sujanyassujanastathāpravāsaścāvyayaścaiva dakṣodvādaśakastathāśvetavarṇāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ātmā āyurmanodakṣaḥ pādaprāpastathaiva capītavarṇāḥsārasvataṃ vyākaraṇaṃ niruktaṃ varuṇaḥ prabhuḥmīmāṃsā bhagavānsomo nyāyamārgassamīraṇaḥitihāsaḥ prajādhyakṣo dhanurvedaśśatakratuḥphalavedo mahādevo nṛttaśāstraṃ maheśvaraḥpātaṃjalamanaṃtaśca sāṃkhyaṃ ca kapilo muniḥkalāśāstrāṇi sarvāṇi kāmadevo jagadguruḥsa eva devatā tasya śāstraṃ kāvyaṃ ca vedavatkhecarā ye devacarāstānnamasye sukhāptaye || 1saṃdaṃśapāṇirdvibhujastejo mūrtidharo mahānkanakavarṇaḥ || 1saptāśvarathasaṃyukto dvibhujassyāt sadāraviḥpāṭalavarṇaḥhastāṃbhojairdadhānaṃ trinayanavilasadvedavaktrābhirāmaṃ mārtāṃḍaṃvallabhāḍhyaṃ maṇimayamakuṭaṃ hīradīptaṃ bhajāmaḥvidrumavarṇā || 1 || - ||padmadvayābhayavarāndadhataṃ karābjairmāṇikyamaulimaruṇāṃgaruciṃ triṇetramraktavarṇaḥchāgasthaḥ sākṣasūtraśca varadaḥ śaktidhārakaḥaruṇavarṇaḥkapālaśūlakhaṭvāṃgapinākīṃduśirāḥ śivaḥśvetavarṇaḥgadāpāṇirdvibāhuśca kartavyo varadaśśaśīśvetavarṇaḥ || 1 || - ||svasyāṃkasthamṛgoditā śrayaguṇaṃ somaṃ sudhābdhiṃ bhaje
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śvetavarṇaḥdadhānāḥ pāśakalaśau muktābharaṇabhūṣitāḥśvetavarṇāḥumābibharti hasteṣu pūjitā tridaśairapisvarṇavarṇācaturbhujomeṣagamovaradassyāddharāsutaḥraktavarṇaḥcaturbhujā saumyavapuścaṃḍāṃśu sadṛśāṃbarāpadmaṃkare ca kartavyaṃ bhuvoyādavanaṃdanaśvetavarṇāraktāṃbaradharodevo mayūravaravāhanaḥpatākāvaijayaṃtī syācchaktiḥ kāryā ca vāmayoḥpāṭalavarṇaḥkhaḍgacarmagadāpāṇissiṃhasthovarado budhaḥkanakavarṇaḥpradakṣiṇaṃ dakṣiṇādhaḥ karādārabhya nityaśaḥśvetavarṇaḥsvarṇavarṇaḥ || 1tiṣṭhantarati vai varṣaṃ rāśaurāśau bṛhaspatiḥdaṃḍinau varadau kāryau sākṣasūtrakamaṇḍalūkanakavarṇaḥprācīpatiḥ prakartavyo nānābharaṇabhūṣitaḥsvarṇavarṇaḥpāṭalavarṇaḥsopāsaṃgapatākastu śuklassyāttu rathomahān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: daṃḍinau varadau kāryau sākṣasūtrakamaṃḍalūśvetavarṇaḥabhayā''maṃḍitākāryādvibhujā ca tathā śacīkanakavarṇāsahasranetraṃ pītābhamiṃdraṃ hṛdivibhāvayekanakavarṇaḥbāṇacāpadharovīraḥ kartavyorkasutassadākṛṣaṇavarṇaḥsāvitrī tasya kartavyā vāmotsaṃgagatā śubhāyajñopavītī haṃsastha ekavaktraścaturbhujaḥpadmavarṇaḥkālaḥkarālavadanaḥ nīlāṃgaścāti bhīṣaṇaḥnīlavarṇaḥnīlasiṃhāsanasthaśca rāhurmesyācchubha pradaḥnīlameghavarṇaḥekabhogāstribhogā vā sarvekāryāśca bhīṣaṇāḥraktavarṇaḥpāśadaṃḍadharaḥ kāryassarpavṛścikaromavānkṛṣṇavarṇaḥkapotavāhanā nityaṃ ketavassyūrvarapradāḥ(ketūnāṃbahutvepi ekasyaiva prādhānyam ) dhūmravarṇāḥakṣasrakkuṃḍikābhīti dānahastaṃ viciṃtayepadmavarṇaḥdakṣiṇe lekhinīṃ caiva dadhaṃvāme ca patrakamkanakavarṇaḥ

sanskrit: dhyāyāmi daityahaṃtrīṃ tāṃraktā svādana tatparāmnīlavarṇāśūrpakarṇaṃ namasyāmi śirasākhuvarasthitamraktavarṇaḥtrilocanaṃ cordhvakeśamatikruddhaṃ sudaṃṣṭrakamkṣudraghaṃṭā baddhagulphaṃ kapālasragvibhūṣaṇamdakṣiṇeśūlavetāla khaḍgaduṃdubhidhāriṇamkṣetrapālamahaṃvande sarvāriṣṭopa śāṃtayeśyāmavarṇaḥabhayaṃkaramīḍehaṃ satataṃ saukhyadāyinamkanakavarṇaḥ || (anyatsarvamiṃdravat 4 ni0)vaṃdehaṃ vāstupuruṣaṃ śayānaṃ śayane śubhenīlavarṇaḥ || dvibhujaḥmaulibaddheṃdu vigaladamṛtādraṃsitadyutimbhaktārtiharamīśānaṃ mṛtyuṃjayamupāsmaheśvetavarṇaḥsupakvāmrātasīpuṣpanīlābjaśukasannibhāḥśaṃkhapadmadharāssarve varābhayakarāstu vai || 2daṃḍahastaṃ ca vṛṣalaṃ dadṛśe nṛpalāṃchanam || (1 skaṃ0 17 adhyā0) kṛṣṇavarṇaḥpītaḥkalaughanaśyāmo vāsudevaḥ puraḥpumānsukhāsīnāścāruhastā yugānāmadhi devatāḥ || 2raktākṣasthūladehaśca prabhavobrāhmaṇaḥ pumānkṛṣṇavarṇaḥdivyāṃgadaṃrathārūḍhaṃ dhyāyedvibhavamīdṛśammeghavarṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: lipikalpadrumasyādho dhyāyechruklākhya vatsaramśvetavarṇaḥpramodūtassavijñeyaḥ kāṃtāliṃgitavigrahaḥśyāmavarṇaḥmahodaro lohitākṣo vatsarastu prajāvatiḥraktavarṇaḥpadmahastadvayaṃ devaṃ dhyāyedāṃgira sābhidhamśvetavarṇaḥpuṣkarākṣaṃ haridrābhaṃ dhyāyecchrīmukhavatsaramkanakavarṇaḥūrdhvabāhuyutaścaiva dvibhujaḥ kṣatriyassmṛtaḥraktavarṇaḥdvibhujaṃ śvetavarṇaṃ ca padmākṣaṃyuvavatsaramśvetavarṇaḥtriṇetraṃ padmavarṇaṃ ca nirbhayaṃ dhātusaṃjñakampadmavarṇaḥcitrāṃbaradharaṃdevaṃ dhyāyedīśvarasaṃjñakamaruṇavarṇaḥvitatalalitatejādīrghavakṣādvipādaḥ kamalanayanayuktaściṃtitodvādaśobdaḥnīlavarṇaḥgraiveyakṛtamāṇikyaḥ pramāthī vatsaraḥpumānkanakavarṇaḥmadhyamoccaṃ dīrghabāhuṃ dvipādaṃ vikramaṃ viduḥgodhūmavarṇaḥākhubhuksadṛśokṣibhyāṃ mukhevraṇayutaścalaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nīlavarṇaḥdevālaye japansthāne nānālaṃkārabhūḍitaḥkapilavarṇaḥtṛṣārtomeṣavadanassvabhānurdvibhujo vibhuḥkapilavarṇaḥnīrajākṣo vyāghrapātsyād gajāsyastāraṇābhidhaḥraktavarṇaḥtaskarodaṃḍayuktaśca sthūloṣaṭhaḥ pārthivaḥ smṛtaḥgauravarṇaḥnipuṇaḥ satyavākcaiva vyayovyayakaraḥpumānkapilavarṇaḥsaddhastaḥ kūpakhanakaḥ sarvajitsarvasādhakaḥgauravarṇaḥsūkṣmoṣṭho dīrghadehaśca sarvadhārī ca sarvadāraktavarṇaḥsūkṣmagrīvasthūladehasthūlamadhyo virodhikaḥraktavarṇaḥśuṣkodarodīrghakaṃtho raktākṣo vikṛtiḥ pumāngauravarṇaḥvaradhābhayapāṇiśca gadāpadmadharaḥ paraḥraktavarṇaḥbhasmarudrākṣasaṃyukto varado naṃdanaḥ pumānraktavarṇaḥvāmatassarvato dṛṣṭirvijayorjunamūlagaḥpadmavarṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: varadābhayapāṇiśca sitaḥ śyāmayutojayaḥdhūmravarṇaḥbaḍabāpaṃcakārūḍho manmatho manmathā kṛtiḥkāṃcanavarṇaḥdvibāhuḥśārṅgapāṇiśca durmukhī durmukholasaḥraktavarṇau tu tau vṛddhau sadāmātṛsamīpagauśiṃśupākhyatarormūle cāsīnau girisannibhauturaṃgaguptiyuktaśca capalaḥ plavavatsaraḥraktavarṇaḥdhāriṇau puṃḍrarudrākṣaṃ malayadrumasannibhauśivanārāyaṇau dhyāyankrodhyabdo hrasvakaḥsitaḥśvetavarṇaḥvāpīsopānamāśritya dhyāyanvai viśvato mukhamraktavarṇaḥtiṣṭhatyekaḥ plavatyekaḥ yuvānāvati darpitauśvetavarṇaukīlakaścaiva saumyaśca tapasyaṃtau girestaṭenīlaraktavarṇaupurastāddevamīśānamarcayanvasati dvijaḥkanakavarṇaḥraktākṣaḥ sthūladehaśca mṛgānhiṃsaṃścaratyayamnīlavarṇaḥśvetavarṇaḥdhyāyanraviṃkṛśonīlaḥ pramādīcodvijaḥ smṛtaḥānaṃdo lohito dhyāyannakṣamālāvabhūṣitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: raktavarṇaḥpathikānbādhamānastu rākṣasaḥ śvānagositaḥjaṭābhṛcchmamu?laśśāṃtaḥ kṛṣṇobhūti vibhuṣaṇaḥkṛṣṇavarṇaḥjapataḥ śvetanīlāṃgāṃ varaṇye niṃbasannidhau || 1śvetavarṇaḥ || 2 || nīlavarṇaḥtiṣṭhandhyāyanjapanvarṇī śvetassidhārthivatsaraḥśvetavarṇaḥraktākṣaḥ sthūladehaśca śyāmo?kṣakriḍane rataḥkṛṣṇavarṇaḥkhaḍgacarmadharoraktaḥ śatrucchedanalālasaḥraktavarṇaḥdhyāyanvasati niśśaṃkaṃ viṣṇuṃ vai viśvarūpiṇamnīlavarṇaḥarcayandroṇapuṣpaistu rudramekādaśātmakamkanakavarṇaḥstrībhiḥkrīḍanbhūṣitāṃgo raktākṣī tu yuvāvibhuḥśvetavarṇaḥśvabhiḥ kriḍanvilolākṣo krodhano vikṛtānanaḥraktavarṇaḥkrūraḥ kṛṣṇo dīrgharomā'kṣayo dīrghākṛtiḥ pumānkṛṣṇavarṇaḥidvatsaraḥ iḍāvatsaraḥ saṃvatsaraḥ parivatsaraḥ anuvatsaraḥ iti saṃjñāstu prabhavādiṣu ṣaṣṭisaṃvatsareṣu āditaḥ paṃcānāṃ paṃcānāmekaikaśaḥ krameṇa jñeyāḥsarvabhogayutadīrghajīvito jāyate prabhavasaṃbhavaḥ pumānrājābhavedātmakule suśīlovidvānmanuṣyo vibhavābdajanmā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sadbhāgyavidyāvinayopapannonūnaṃ pumāñchuklasamudbhavaḥ syātdakṣaśca dhūrtaḥ parakāryakartā pramodajanmāmanujobhimānīdevadvirjārcābhirato vinītomartyaḥ prajādhīśasamadbhavassyātsaguptabuddhiḥ khaludīrghajīvī naroṃgirogirovatsarasaṃbhavassyātsatkīrtiyuktotitarāmudāro bhavennaraḥ śrīmukhasaṃbhavaścasadāsaharṣo vimato bahūnāṃ bhāvābhidhānodbhavamānavassyātsudhīścirāyurdṛḍhadehaśālī jātoyuvābde puruṣassatoṣaḥśilpaśāstrakuśalaśca suśīlodhātuvatsara bhavohinarassyātdakṣaḥkalākauśalaśīlaśālī martyobhavedīśvara jātajanmābahuprakārairbahudhānyavittaḥ syānmānavo vai bahudhānyajanmāmaṃtrī nareṃdrasyanaraḥ kṛtajñaḥ pramāthisaṃvatsarasaṃbhavassyātśūraśca vīrotitarāmudāraḥ parākramīvikramavarṣajātaḥbartā bahūnāṃgalinolasaśca jāto vṛṣābdemanujoti lubdhaḥcāruśīlavilasatkalācitaścitrabhānujanito hi pūruṣaḥprasannamūrtissamasiddhihūtissvabhānusaṃvatsarajo narassyātutpannabhoktādraviṇena muktassyāt tāraṇābdodbhavamānavo yaḥkalākalāpekuśalo vilāsīyaḥ pārthivābde kulapārthivassyātjātaḥ pumānasthiracittavṛttirvyayābhidhāne vyayakarmaśīlaḥ || 1vairivargavijayodyatassadāsarvajiccharadisaṃbhavaḥ pumāndhīratadguṇayutoti dāruṇassarvadhāriṇi ca yasya saṃbhavaḥjanenasākaṃ gatacittavṛttirvirodhivarṣaprabhavo narassyātcārubuddhirahitopyamitrakomānavo vikṛtivarṣasaṃbhavaḥkleśī ca lajjāvidhivarjitassyānnaraḥ kharābdaprabhavoti dīrghaḥvilāsinīnaṃdanajātaharṣo narobhayennaṃdanavarṣajanmādātādayāluḥ kilavairihaṃtā yasya prasūtirvijayābhidhāne
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jayābhilāpī viṣayānurakto jātojayābde manujo mahaujāḥsadgītanṛtyābhirataśca bhoktā yo manmathābde jananaṃ prapannaḥkrūroddhato niṃdyamatiśca lubdho vakrāsya bāhvaṃghriraruśaṃ? priyaḥ syāt || viruddhabāṣī bahuduṣṭaceṣṭo yo hāyane durmukhināmnijātaḥsamastavastugrahaṇaikabuddhiryo hemalaṃbi prabhavaḥ pumāntsyātprārabdhakāryetitarāṃ pralāpī vimalaṃbisaṃvatsarassaṃbhavassyātanalpajalpassvasuhṛdvikalpo vikārisaṃvatsarajonarassyātanekavidyābhyasanānuraktaḥ saṃvatsare śārvarināmnijātaḥsuguptabuddhiścapalasvabhāvaḥ plavābhidhānābdabhavonarassyātsyānmānavassūnudhanorusaṃpadyasya prasūtiḥ śubhakṛtsamāsukāṃtovinītaḥ śubhakṛtpravīṇoyaḥ śobhakṛdvatsarasaṃbhavaḥ syātācāratolpatvaśaṭhatvayuktaḥ parābhave yasya bhavet prasūtiḥdhūrtassadācāravicārahīnaḥ plavaṃgajovaimanujaḥ kṛśāṃgaḥsthūlāṃghrisanmauliralaṃbalīyāñjātorikīlaḥ kilakīlakābdesāttvikaḥ kṛśakalebarayaṣṭiḥ saumyavatsarabhavomanujastukrodhīśucirbhoganivṛttacetāḥ prāṇī hi sādhāraṇajaḥ pragītaḥparāṅmukhastātavacasyatīvavirodhikṛnnāmni hi janma yasyavyāpārasaṃprāptamahatpratiṣṭhaḥ pumānbhavedvai paridhāvināmnisyādalpadhīrgarhitakarmakarttā pramādi janmā manujaḥ pramādīprājñaḥ kṛtajñaḥ sutarāṃvinītopyānaṃdajāto manujovadānyaḥdayāvihīnaśca sasāhasopi bhavennaro rākṣasavarṣajanmāsyādalpavitto bahupālakaśca jātonalābde capalomanuṣyaḥtyāgīśaṭhotyaṃtakaṭhoravākyo jātonaraḥ piṃgalanāmadheyenareṃdramaṃtrī bahupūjitārthaḥ siddhārthijāto manujaḥ samarthaḥjātāpakīrtiḥ khalacittavṛttirnarotiraudraḥ khaluraudrijanmākāmīprakāmaṃ duritepravṛtto yo durmatirdurmati varṣajātaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tauryatrikaprītiratīvajātaścenmānavo duṃdubhināmavarṣepādadvaṃdve bhavati kunakhīhastayuṇmethavāsyācchastrāddukhaṃ vrajatirudhirodgārijanmāmanuṣyaḥanyādhikattvaṃ sahatenakiṃcidraktākṣijātokṣirujānvitaścaparasyabuddhiṃ praharetprakāmaṃ yohāyane krodhananāmnijātaḥsatkāryaketyalpamanaḥ pravṛtiḥ kṣayābhidhāne jananaṃ hi yasya || 1āṃgīrasaḥ śrīmukhaśca bhāvothayuvavatsaraḥcitrabhānuḥ svabhānuśca tāraṇaḥ pārthivo vyayaḥnaṃdanovijayaścaiva jayomanmathadurmukhauśubhakṛcchobhakṛtkrodhī viśvāvasuparābhavauparidhāvīpramādīsyādānaṃdo rākṣasonalaḥduṃdubhīrudhirodgāriraktākṣī krodhanākṣayauṣaḍānanaśca vallī ca gaurībrahmīmaheśvarīcāmuṃḍikāpyarogaśca bhrājaḥpaṭara eva caraviḥsūryaśca bhānuśca khagaḥ pūṣā tathaiva caarkastatobhāskarāgni jātavedassahaujasaḥpaṅtirāthavisarpiśca matsyakūrmavarāhakāḥkṛṣṇaḥ kalkībuddhadurgeyā tu dhānaśca bhairavaḥabhimāninya eteṣāmabdānāṃ devatāḥ kramāt || 7vakṣobhāgavirājamānaviśadaśrībrahmasūtrojjvalaṃ vaṃdehaṃ prabhavābhidhaṃ kamalajaṃ śreyobhivṛddhipradampadmavarṇaḥkarairanaṃtāsanasanniviṣṭaṃ dhyāyedrameśaṃvibhavādhināthammeghaśyāmavarṇaḥvṛṣavarakṛtavāhaṃ śuklasaṃjñaṃ girīśaṃnamadamaramunīṃdraṃ śūlapāṇiṃ namāmiśvetavarṇaḥpratyūhaśāṃtipradamākhusaṃsthaṃ dhyāyeddhṛdabje satataṃ gaṇeśam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: raktavarṇaḥbhakteṣṭapātho nidhipūrṇacaṃdrāṃ vaṃdeprajotpatti kṛtābhidhānāmraktavarṇāāṃgirasanāmadheyaṃ ṣaṇmukhamīḍemareṃdrasenānyamraktavarṇaḥśrīmukhasaṃjñāṃ vallīṃ śreyovṛddhipradāmahaṃkalayepāṭalavarṇābhāvākhyā mahamīḍe bhavakutukāṃbhodhi pūrṇacaṃdrāṃtāmmarakatavarṇāhaṃsapravarārūḍhāṃ śaṃbhumanohārirūpasaubhāgyāmkanakavarṇācaṃdrāvataṃsasahitā śreyovṛddhipradāsadāśaṃbhoḥśubhravarṇātāmīśvarābhidhānāṃśaṃ karatoṣapradāṃ svarūpeṇapāṭalavarṇāśaṃkaravāmāṃkasthāṃ namatāmiṣṭārthadāyikāmaniśammeghaśyāmavarṇāśreyobhivṛddhidātrīṃ kṛtanijanāmnīṃ pramāthītiśyāmavarṇābhāsuracaṃdrakirīṭāṃ bhaktābhīṣṭapradāṃbhiyāṃśāṃtyaikanakavarṇāvi(vṛ)ṣunāmnīṃ suravaṃdyāṃ daityakuladhvaṃsakāriṇīmaniśamkṛṣṇavarṇāturaṃgamavarārūḍhaṃ makuṭojjvalamastakamraktavarṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gajārūḍhaṃlasatkhaḍgakheṭahastaṃ namāmyahamraktavarṇaḥtāraṇaṃ sūryagamanaṃ śūlodbhāsikarāṃbujamraktavarṇaḥśaṃkhacakradharaṃdivya pītāṃbaramahaṃbhajeraktavarṇaḥcaṃdrāvataṃsaṃ jaṭilaṃ triṇetraṃśūlabhāsuramraktavarṇaḥbhṛśuṃḍīpāśahastābjaṃ vyāghrārūḍhaṃ trilocanamraktavarṇaḥiṣṭaprāptyaisadāvaṃde saptāśvarathamāsthitamraktavarṇaḥ || (śiṣṭaṃsūryavat ni0 5)kaśyapaṃ paṃcavadanaṃ daśahastaṃ namāmyahamraktavarṇaḥ || (śiṣṭaṃsūryavat ni0 5)pannageśvaramārūḍhaṃ cārupītāṃbarā vṛtamraktavarṇaḥ || (śiṣṭaṃsūryavat ni0 5)sūryābhidhaṃ kharaṃvaṃde caturvaktāṣṭa hastakamraktavarṇaḥ || (śiṣṭaṃsūryavat ni0 5)mṛgeṃdravāhanaṃpaṃcavaktraṃ daśabhujaṃ bhajeraktavarṇaḥ || (śiṣṭaṃsūryavat ni0 5)vyāghracarmāṃbaradharaṃvaṃde vijayasaṃjñakamraktavarṇaḥ || (śiṣṭaṃsūryavat ni0 5)śaṃkhacakrāṃkitakaradvaṃdvaṃ hṛdisamāśrayeraktavarṇaḥhiraṇyagarbhaṃvaṃdehaṃ manmathākhyaṃ mameṣṭadam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: raktavarṇaḥvivṛttāsyaṃ jagadbhīti dāyakaṃ saṃśraye mudāraktavarṇaḥ || (śaṣṭaṃsūryavat ni0 5)saptasaptisamārūḍhaṃ jagatāṃ netramāśrayeraktavarṇaḥ || (śiṣṭaṃsūryavat ni0 5)cāpabāṇadharaṃdorbhyāṃ turaṃgavaravāhanamraktavarṇaḥkraravyāghrasamārūḍhamekanetraṃ namāmyahamraktavarṇaḥcakrojjvalakaraṃvaṃde bhāsvadrathasamāśritamraktavarṇaḥajārūḍhaṃ caturhastaṃ dviśīrṣaṃ plavasaṃjñakamraktavarṇaḥ || (śiṣṭamagnivat ni0 4)āṃdolikāsamārūḍhaṃ khaḍgakheṭadharaṃ śubhamraktavarṇaḥśibikāvāhanārūḍhaṃ cāmaradvayapāṇikamraktavarṇaḥgorathārūḍhamaniśaṃ kuṃtojjvalakarāṃbujamraktavarṇaḥnaravāhanamārūḍhaṃ khaḍgakheṭadharaṃśubhamraktavarṇaḥuttuṃgaturagārūḍhaṃ paraśūjjvalapāṇikamraktavarṇaḥśvetāśvavaramārūḍhaṃ śārṅgavāṇadharaṃ sadāraktavarṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: uttuṃgagajamārūḍhaṃ śūlojjvalakarāṃbujamraktavarṇaḥśaṃkhacakrojjvalakaraṃbhaktābhīṣṭapradāyakamśvetavarṇaḥkāṃcanavarṇaḥvaradābhayadaṃ vaṃde virodhikṛditi śrutamśyāmavarṇaḥprahlādaharṣadātāraṃ parīdhāvikṛtā hvayamśvetavarṇaḥbalipratāpanakaraṃpramādī ca kṛtāhvayamśyāmavarṇaḥ dūrvādalavatrāmamānaṃdanāmānaṃ dhṛtakodaṃḍamārgaṇamśyāmavarṇaḥbhārgavaṃrāmamāśāse rākṣasābhidhamaṃjasākāṃcanavarṇaḥbalarāmamahaṃvaṃde nalāhvayamaharniśamśubhravarṇaḥnavanītojjvalakaraṃnṛtyaṃ taṃ hṛdisaṃśrayeśyāmavarṇaḥāśrayekalkimārūḍhaṃ dhanurbāṇakaraṃ sadāśvetavarṇaḥnagnaṃvirūpavapuṣaṃ stripradharṣaṇakāraṇampāṭalavarṇaḥdhyāyāmidaityahaṃtrīṃtāṃ raktāsvādanatatparāmnīlavarṇā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dhyāyāmyaniṣṭaśāṃtyarthaṃ durmatītikṛtāhvayamnīlavarṇaḥbhairavaṃśca varārūḍhaṃ digaṃbaramupāśrayeśyāmavarṇaḥsamudralaṃghanodyuktaṃ dīrghalāṃgūlamāśrayekanakavarṇaḥraktāṃkṣasaṃjñikāṃ devīṃ prapadyevāgvibhūtidāmśvetavarṇāśukārūḍhāṃśūladharāṃbhajebhīṣṭārthasiddhayekanakavarṇāhaṃsārūḍhāmiṃdumukhīṃpāṇidvayakṛtāṃbujāmsvarṇavarṇā || 1pītavastrovahankuṃḍaṃ karṇikāradalākṛtiḥpūjitaḥ siddhaye nityaṃ dhanadhānyasamṛddhayeśyāmavarṇaḥmāṃjiṣṭhavasanopetaḥ svarṇamuktāvibhūṣaṇaḥdadhanmuktyaimude ca syāt pūjanīyastu kīrtayeśvetavarṇaḥ || 1bhavati dakṣiṇamanyadṛtutrayaṃ nigaditārajanī marutāṃ ca sā || 1dakṣiṇāśā mukhe kurvan na tatphalamavāpnuyāt || 1 || - ||mahiṣāsurahaṃtrī ca sthāpyā vai dakṣiṇāyane || 1 || - ||saumyāyane karmaśubhaṃ pradiṣṭaṃ yadgarhitaṃ tatkhalu dakṣiṇe syātsarvānkāmānavāpnoti viṃdate paramaṃ sukham || 1 || - ||tilapūrṇamanaḍvāhaṃ dattvārogaiḥ pramucyateghṛtābhiṣekaṃ vā kuryān mahāpuṇyaphalecchayā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gavyenājyena vā śaṃbhoḥ pradadyādghṛtakaṃbalamnarassadātrāṇaparopyudārobhīruśca saumyāyanajātajanmāśaṭhopyasahyonanumānavānāṃ yāmyāyane yojananaṃ prapannaḥbhāsvadrathagataṃsūryaṃ caṃdranakṣatrasaṃvṛtamraktavarṇaḥdivyasyaṃdanamārūḍhaṃ sūryādigrahasaṃyutamśvetavarṇaḥakṣamālodyatakaraṃ paṃcākṣaraparāyaṇambaddhapadmāsanāsīnaḥ prāṅkhohasitānanaḥbhasmoddhūlitasarvāṃgo vasaṃtostumudemamaśvetavarṇaḥakṣasūtrārka hastastu caṃdraśubhrātapatrayukgrīṣmaṃprāṅmukhamāsīnaṃ viṣṭare munipūjitekamaṃḍalūjjvalakaraṃ namāmi śirasānvahamdhūmravarṇaḥtāmravarṇaśukopetaḥ nīlavidrumakuṃḍalaḥmeghamālāvṛtaścaiva vidyutvānathadīptimānśirasāpraṇamāmyadyavarṣāharṣābhidhāyikāḥharidvarṇaḥkaṃṭhemauktikamālastu karṇeceṃdrāśmakuṃḍalaḥdadhānaḥ pūjanīyoyamāyurvṛddhyaisukhāya caṛtuḥ pratyaṅmukhāsīnaḥ sphā.ikaṃ valayaṃ vahancaṃdragauravarṇaḥpītavastrasamāvītastrijaṭaḥ kṛṣṇagodhikaḥpūjanīyo vibhūtyarthaṃ dhānyasaṃpadvivṛddhaye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śuciryajñopavītī ca prasīdatu śubhapradaḥkapilavarṇaḥpītakuṃḍalakarṇastu kaṃṭhevidrumamālakaḥvāmedhānyaśarāvaṃ ca dhārayanniṣṭavṛddhayesūryabiṃbādṛtakaraṃ paṃcākṣarajapodyatamharidvarṇaḥ || 1yānakānāṃ tathāgrīṣme chatrāṇāṃ tadanaṃtaram || 1 || - ||vipreṣuviprakanyāsu tilādīntsaṃprayacchativahnerdānaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā sūryamuddiśya codayekulmāṣaṃ sughṛtaṃdattvā yathāśaktyā dvijātiṣuśastrāstra śīlāmala cittavṛttiḥ vasaṃtajāto manujaḥ prasannaḥbhogībhavennāti vicāraśīlo yo grīṣmakāle jananaṃ prapannaḥkaphānilātmālalanāvilāsī varṣovyo?vaipuruṣaḥ saharṣaḥraṇapriyo vāhanasaṃyutaśca ṛatau śarannāmni ca janma yasyasatkarmadharmānurato manasvī hemaṃtajātaḥ satataṃ vinītaḥsatkarmaveṣaḥ puruṣaḥ saroṣobalādiśālīśiśirartujanmā || 1etāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ṣaṇṇāmṛtūnāmadhi devatāḥpuṣpabāṇavinirbhinna jagattrayamahaṃbhajekāṃcanavarṇaḥśaktisruksruvahastāḍhyaṃ devaṃ bhaktajana priyamlohitavarṇaḥnakrārūḍhaṃ pāśapāṇiṃ lokānāṃ jīvanapradamkanakavarṇaḥvaṃdelokaikajananīṃ sarvābhīṣṭapradāyinīmharidvarṇā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kādraveyaṃ mahāsattvaṃ bhajemāṃpātu sarvadāśvetavarṇaḥvaṃdetripurahaṃtāraṃ samebhīṣṭaṃ prayacchatuśvetavarṇaḥ || 1jagadānaṃdajanakaṃ madhumāsamupāsmaheraktavarṇaḥgarutmadvāhanārūḍhaṃ vaṃdebhīṣṭasya siddhayeśvetavarṇaḥvaiyyāghravāhanārūḍhaṃ śuklamāsamupāsmaheśvetavarṇaḥupāsmaheśuciṃmāsaṃ bhaktābhīṣṭapradāyakamaruṇavarṇaḥpaṃcavaktraṃ daśabhujaṃ sāraṃgapravarasthitamharidvarṇaḥcaturmukhaṃ cāṣṭabhujaṃ haṃsapravarasaṃsthitamśvetavarṇaḥbhaktābhīṣṭapradaṃnityamiṣamāsamupāsmahearuṇavarṇaḥkailāsasikharārūḍhamūrjamāsamupāsmaheśvetavarṇaḥnamāmi śirasādevaṃ sahākhyaṃmāsamanvahamśvetavarṇaḥdhyāyehaṃmanasānityaṃ sahasyaṃ māsamanvahamharidvarṇaḥdhyāyāmiṣṭakṛtenityaṃ tapomāsamananyadhīḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: haridvarṇaḥbrahmasūtrojjvalāṃsaṃca kirīṭāṃkitamastakampāṭalavarṇaḥ || 1jyeṣṭhaḥ śuklaḥ śvetavarṇaḥ śucirāṣāḍhakoruṇaḥbhādronabhasyaḥ śvetaḥ syādāśvayugro hitoruṇaḥpuṣyaḥ sahasyo haritaḥ māghopi haritaḥ smṛtaḥuktāmāsādhi devāśca varṇaiste pṛthivīpateviṣṇoḥprītyarthametāni deyānibrāhmaṇoṣvitihaviṣyaṃbrahmacaryaṃ ca bhūśayyāni yama sthitiḥapijanmasahasrotthaṃ pāpaṃdahati dāruṇamtrivikramasya prītyarthaṃ dātavyaṃ jyeṣṭhamāsi caāṣāḍhe vāmanaprītyai dātavyānīhabhaktitaḥśrāvaṇeśrīdharaprītyai dātavyāni dinedinehṛṣīkeśaprīṇanārthaṃ darpaṇaṃ sa guḍodanamprītyarthaṃ padmanābhasya deyamāśvayuje naraiḥdāmodarasya prītyarthaṃ pradadyāt kārtike naraḥdātavyā viṣṇusaṃprītyai mārgaśīrṣe narottamaiḥsubhagodarśanīyaśca yaśobhāgī ca jāyatepauṃḍarīka phalaṃ tasya divase divase bhavetgoviṃdaprīṇanārthāya dātavyaṃ puruṣarṣabha || 1pauṣekanakadānena parāṃ puṣṭiṃ tathaiva casatpātradānānu rataśca maṃtrī caitrodbhavaścāpi vicitramaṃtraḥkāmīcirāyurjalayānaśīlassyānmādhave bāṃdhavasaukhyayuktaḥvicitrabuddhiḥ khaludīrghasūtro jyeṣṭhodbhavaśśreṣṭhataronarassyātsadāgnimāṃdyaśśubhakarmakṛtsyādāṣāḍhajogāḍhatarābhimānaḥ

sanskrit: lokaprasiddhaḥ kaphavānvadānyoyaśśrāvaṇe puṇyaguṇaiḥ sapūrṇaḥsukhaiśca duḥkhairvikṛto hi martyo dhūrto bhavedbhādrapadesujanmādātāguṇajño bahuputrasaṃtatissyādāśvine'śvādi samṛddhibhājīkāmaṃ sa kāmaḥ krayavikrayārtha satkāryakṛtkārtikajātajanmāparopakarttā dhṛtasādhumārgo mārgodbhavo vai vibhavaissametaḥsuguptamaṃtraḥ kṛtaśāstrayuktaḥ pauṣeviśeṣī puruṣaḥ kalāvānbuddherviśeṣādvijitārisaṃgho māghodbhavassyādanagho manuṣyaḥvilāsinīkelividhānaśīloyaḥ phālgunephalguvaco vilāsaḥ || 1pūjāḥkrameṇamāseṣusarvasaṃpatsamṛddhaye(eṣāṃlakṣaṇānikeśavādi caturviśatimūrtivat ni0 2)kapālābhayahastāsyādekavaktrākarālikāraktavarṇāśvetavarṇā mahāghorā kapālābhayasaṃyutāśvetavarṇāabhayaṃ ca kapālaṃ ca dadhānaikamukhīśubhāpāṭalāṃgī dvihastā ca kapālābhayadhāriṇīpāṭalavarṇājihmikāsiṃhasaṃkrāṃtirekavaktrā prasīdaturaktavarṇāsiṃhikānāmavijñeyā kapālābhayaśobhitāmukhekṛṣṇavarṇā || deheraktavarṇāmaṃdātriṇetrasahitā kapālābhayadhāriṇīnīlavarṇākapālaśaktihastā ca saṃkrāṃtirvṛścikābhidhānīlavarṇā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kapālābhayahastā ca dhanussakrāṃtirucyatecitravarṇākapālavajrahastā ca rākṣasī coṣṭravāhanāraktavarṇākapālābhayahastā ca kuṃbhasaṃkrāṃtirīritānīlavarṇāmīnākhyāruṇavarṇāsyāt kapālābhayasaṃyutāaruṇavarṇā || 1jiṃhikāsihmikāmaṃdāhlādinī cojjvalāmatārākṣasībhaṃjikāvakrā ceti saṃkrāṃtayaḥ kramātkukkuṭājau ca mahisaścoṣṭrośvo ṛkṣa eva caetānivāhanānisyuḥ saṃkrāṃtī nāmajāditaḥvṛṣasaṃkramaṇedānaṃ gavāṃproktaṃ tathaiva caghṛtadhenupradānaṃ tu karkaṭe pariśasyatekanyāpraveśe vastrāṇāṃ surabhīṇāṃ tathaiva cakīṭapraveśe vastrāṇāṃ veśmanāṃdānameva camṛgapraveśedārūṇāṃ dānamagnestathaiva camīnapraveśe hyamlānamālyānāmapi cottamamvivasvattvaṣṭṛviṣṇvaṃśubhagapūṣaṇa eva caparjanyaśca dvādaśaite saṃkrāṃtīnāṃ hi devatāḥpulastyastuṃbururītimadhumāsaṃnayaṃtyamīraśmijālasamāślaṣṭastamastomavināśanaḥapsarāḥkṛtasthalī || gaṃdharvastuṃbaruḥ || pulastya-ṛṣiḥ || pāśasthānīyo vāsukiḥ || rathakṛdākhyovardhakiḥ || hetirnāmārākṣasaḥ || raśmayoṣṭasahasrāṇi || raktavarṇaḥnāradaḥ kacchanīraśca nayaṃtyetesmamādhavamaryamāstu sadābhūtyai bhūyasyai praṇatasya me

sanskrit: vṛṣabhemāsi aryamāsūryaḥ || pulaha-ṛṣiḥ || apsarāḥ puṃjikasthalī || nāradākhyogaṃdharvaḥ | kacchanīrākhyonāgaḥ || ūrjākhyovardhakiḥ || prahetīrākṣasaḥ || raśmayodaśasahasrāṇi || pītavarṇaḥrathasvana itihyete śuklamāsaṃnayaṃtyamīmitrostu mama modāyatamastomavināśanaḥmithunamāsimitrassūryaḥ || atrir-ṛṣiḥ || menakāpsarāḥ || hāhāgaṃdharvaḥ || takṣakonāgaḥ || rathasvanākhyovardhakiḥ || pauruṣeyorākṣasaḥ || raśmayassaptasahasrāṇi || aruṇavarṇaḥśukaścitrasvanaścaiva śucimāsaṃnayaṃtyamīkālabhūtaḥ kāmarūpo hyaruṇassevyate mayākarkakemāsi aruṇassūryaḥ || vasiṣṭha-ṛṣiḥ || raṃbhā'psarāḥ || hūhūrgaṃdharvaḥ || śukākhyonāgaḥ || citrasvanovardhakiḥ || sahajanyorākṣasaḥ || raśmayaḥpaṃcasahasrāṇi || śyāmavarṇaḥpramlocārākṣasaśśaryo nabhomāsaṃnayaṃtyamīśirasāpraṇamāmyadyaśreyovṛddhipradāyakamsiṃhemāsi iṃdrassūryaḥ || aṃgirā ṛṣiḥ || viśvāvasūrgaṃdharvaḥ || pramlocā'psarāḥ || ilāputronāgaḥ || śrotrākhyovardhakiḥ || śaryākhyorākṣasaḥ || raśmayassaptasahasrāṇi || śvetavarṇaḥanumlocāśśaṃkhapālonabhasyākhyaṃnayaṃtyamīnabhograhamahādīpaṃ vivasvaṃtaṃ namāmyahamkanyāmāsivivasvānsūryaḥ || bhṛgur-ṛṣiḥ || anumlocāpsarāḥ || ugrasenogaṃdharvaḥ || śaṃkhapālonāgaḥ || āsāraṇovardhakiḥ || vyāghrorākṣasaḥ || raśmayodaśasahasrāṇi || babhruvarṇaḥbrahmarātothaśatajiddhṛtarāṣṭra iṣaṃbharānānāśilpakaronānā dhāturūpaḥ prabhākaraḥtulāmāsitvaṣṭāsūryaḥ || brahmarāta-ṛṣiḥ || tilottamā'psarāḥ || dhṛtarāṣṭrogaṃdharvaḥ || kaṃbalākhyonāgaḥ || śatajinnāmāvardhakiḥ || ṛcīkākhyorākṣasaḥ || raśmayoṣṭasahasrāṇi || citravarṇaḥviśvāmitro mahāpreta ūrjamāsaṃnayaṃtyamīgāyatripratipādyaṃtaṃ viṣṇuṃbhaktyā namāmyahamvṛścikemāsiviṣṇussūryaḥ || viśvāmitra ṛṣiḥ || raṃbhā'psarāḥ || sūryavarcāgaṃdharvaḥ || satyajinnāmāvardhakiḥ || aśvataronāgaḥ || mahāpretorākṣasaḥ || raśmayaḥ ṣaṭsahasrāṇi || aruṇavarṇaḥvidyuchatrurmahāśaṃkhassahomāsaṃnayaṃtyamīmunīṃdranivahastutyobhūtidoṃśurbhavenmamadhanurmāsi aṃśussūryaḥ || kāśyapa ṛṣiḥ || urvaśyapsarāḥ || ṛtasenogaṃdharvaḥ || mahāśaṃkhonāgaḥ || tārkṣyovardhakiḥ || vidyucchatrūrākṣasaḥ || raśmayonavasahasrāṇi || haridvarṇaḥkarkoṭakaḥ pūrvacittiḥ pauṣamāsaṃnayaṃtyamīghaṭikānāṃ ca yaḥ kartābhagobhāgyapradostumemakaremāsibhagassūryaḥ || ariṣṭanemir-ṛṣiḥ || pūrvacittirapsarāḥ || ūrṇogaṃdharvaḥ || karkoṭakonāgaḥ || āyurvardhakiḥ || sphūrjorākṣasaḥ sanskrit: ghṛtācīgautamaśceti tapomāsaṃnayaṃtyamīsahasrakarasaṃvītassamastā śāṃtarāṃtaraḥkuṃbhemāsipuṣāsūryaḥ || gautama ṛṣiḥ || ghṛtācyapsarāḥ || surucirgaṃdharvaḥ || dhanaṃjayonāgaḥ || suṣeṇovardhakiḥ || dhātārākṣasaḥ || raśmayaṣṣaṭsahasrāṇi || alaktakavarṇaḥviśvaścairāvataścaiva tapasyākhyaṃnayaṃtyamījagadānaṃdajanakaḥ parjanyaḥ pūjyate mayāmīnemāsiparjanyassūryaḥ || bharadvāja ṛṣiḥ || varcāgaṃdharvaḥ || airāvatonāgaḥ || senajidvardhakiḥ || viśvorākṣasaḥ || raśmayonavasahasrāṇi || aruṇavarṇaḥpṛṣṭhabhāgeśiraścakraṃ sthānevimalamaṃḍalamuraḥpradeśe vimalaṃsyamaṃtakamahāmaṇimsamāśvamekacakraṃ ca bhāvayerathamāsthitamaruṇoharitaścaiva śoṇaḥkāṃtanibhoruṇaḥkṣayaḥ kārtikāadi trayenānyathā syāt tadāvarṣamadhyedhimāsadvayaṃ casaguḍājyaphalaṃdadyāt kāṃsyapātrapratiṣṭhitamsaptahastaṃ tripādaṃ ca dviśīrṣaṃ cordhvadṛṣṭikamgadāṃvāme ca bibhrāṇaṃ kheṭaṃpātraṃ śarāsanamkṛṣṇavarṇaḥvīṇāsijīrṇaśūrpāaṇi sitapadmaṃ śarāsanamtulādaṃḍamahīṃdraṃ ca dadhānā saptabhiḥ karaiḥasiṃśurpaṃsitāṃbhojaṃ tulādaṃḍaṃśarāsanamsarpaṃcakrakacaṃ caiva bibhrāṇā varadāstumemahodarīti vikhyātā jīrṇaśūrpaṃ sitāṃbujambibhrāṇā varadābhūyāt sarvadāriṣṭaśāṃtaye || 2sitapadmaśarāse ca tulādaṃḍaṃphaṇīṃdrakamkrakacakṣurikābāṇān bibhrāṇā śubhadā sadāśarāsanatulādaṃḍau nāgeṃdraṃ krakacaṃ śarānkṣurikāṃbhiṃḍivālaṃ ca dadhānābāhubhirmudā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tulādaṃḍamahīṃdraṃ ca krakacaṃ kṣurikāṃ tathāviśikhaṃbhiṃḍivālaṃ ca kuṃtaṃcāpi bibhartyasaujihmagakrakacau cāpi kṣurikāṃ bāṇameva cabhiṃḍivālaṃ ca kuṃtaṃ ca bhuśuṃḍīṃ bibhratī karaiḥṣaṣṭiyojanavistīrṇā śatayojanamunnatāūrdhvakeśī virūpākṣī saṃkrāṃtiḥ puruṣā kṛtiḥnīlavarṇākastūrikāṃ caiva suhemapātramannaṃ ca bhuṅkte hi bavevivasvānnīlavarṇaḥkāṃsyaṃ ca pātraṃ sahabhiṃḍivālaṃdhatte raviḥ pāyasabhuk ca bālavenīlavaraṇaḥbhakṣyaudanorājitabhūṣaṇaścasatāmrapātraḥkhalukaulaverkaḥ || 1 || nīlavaraṇaḥdhattedyayaḥpātrampūpabhojanomāṇisyabhuṣāmapitailerkaḥ || 1 || nīlavarṇaḥ ||nīlāni vastrāṇi ca sīsapātraṃ japāprasūnānigaredadhātinīlavarṇaḥnīlotpalaṃnīlamaṇīṃ ca dhattedadhyannabhoktātrapupātradhārīnīlavarṇaḥdhatteharidrāvapikāṃsyapātraṃ citrānnabhuksvarṇavibhūṣaṇorkaḥnīlavarṇaḥsa caṃpakaḥ pīśi?diśiprayātoguḍāśanaḥ śākunikoravissyātnīlavarṇaḥdhatte ca meṣenugataḥ sunidraścatuṣpade madhvaśanoravistunīlavarṇaḥkuṃḍānivibhraccasapūti gaṃdhaṃ bhuṃkte dhṛtaṃ nāgavasaṃjñakerkaḥnīlavarṇaḥ

sanskrit: śarkarābhugathatāmrabhūṣaṇo veṇupātrabhṛdathāṃtyasaṃjñakenīlavarṇaḥśoṇavastrojaṭālākṣo viśālatilakāṃcitaḥsūryaṃ dakṣedadhānoyaṃ vāmecaṃdrasya biṃbakampūjanīyo mahābhaktyā pratipakṣaṃsite'siteśvetavarṇaḥsūyabiṃbaṃ karebibhradvāme sārasamavyayamkṛṣṇavarṇaḥphalānāṃ ca tathādānaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe mahāphalamsadāsadānaṃdavinītakālaścejjanmakālastu valakṣapakṣemanobhavādhikyayutonitāṃtaṃ sitetareyasya narasya janmaāpūryamāṇapakṣāyanamaśśvetavapuṣmateśvetavarṇaḥasitāya namastestu pitṛprītikarāyavaikṛṣṇavarṇaḥcaturthīpaṃcamīṣaṣṭhīsaptamī cāṣṭamītathātrayodaśīcaturdaśyau pūrṇimāśśuklapakṣagāḥubhābhyāmapi pakṣābhyāṃ māsastriṃśaddinātmakaḥmeṣagāśaktipātrāsā śvetapakṣādimāmatāaruṇavarṇādvitīyāhaṃsagāśubhrāśubhrapustakadhāriṇī || śubhravarṇātṛtīyāvṛṣagāgaurāśūlapātrakarāmatā || gauravarṇāparaśuṃbibhratīpātraṃ pitavastrābhisaṃyutānīlotpalavarṇāśaṃkhaṃmudrāṃ tathāpātraṃ bibhrāṇā paṃcamī matā

sanskrit: pravālavarṇāaruṇavarṇāmeghavarṇākṣīravarṇāśvetavarṇākṛṣṇavarṇāsitānanāruṇākṣīsyadiṃdranīlasamadyutiḥcitravarṇāmeghavarṇāgauravarṇānīlakaṃṭhāceṃdragopanayanā ca caturdaśīpāṭalavarṇāsudhāpūr.ṇaṃ ghaṭaṃdhatte vāme dakṣepi dhānakamśvetavarṇā || 1astraṃpātraṃ sruvaṃcāpaṃ karairdhatte caturbhujādhūmravarṇāśvetavarṇānīlavarṇādhattekṣamālikāṃdaṃḍaṃ pāśaṃpātraṃ ca dakṣiṇekṛṣṇavarṇāśvetavarṇāekāsyā dvibhujāṣaṣṭhī raktavastropaśobhitāraktavarṇāgauravarṇāakṣaṃkhetaṃtathākhaḍgaṃ pātraṃdhatte caturbhujā

sanskrit: raktavarṇāśyāmavarṇājñānamudrābhayāceyaṃ pītavastrābjamālinīśubhravarṇānīlavarṇādvādaśīśubhravastreyaṃ nīlakuṃḍalabhūṣitādvibhujācoragārūḍhā kṛṣṇavarṇā trayodaśīkṛṣṇavarṇānīlavarṇādarbhāsanasthitā ceyaṃ darbhapiṃḍadharākṛśāmarakatavarṇāraṇopakaraṇaṃtatra tithaupratipadīritampauṣṭivāstvādikaṃkarma dvitīyāyāṃ vidhīyatekāryaṃ dvitīye divase yaduktaṃ sadā tṛtīye divasepi tat syātyanmaṃgalaṃ tāsukṛtaṃ ca māsairvināśamāyāti tathānumāsamciraṃsthiraṃsarvakarmapaṃcamyāṃsamudīritambhūṣākarma ca bhaiṣajyaṃ sarvaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vidhīyatetānisidhyaṃti kāryāṇi saptamyāmakhilānyapistrīratnapaṇyākhilabhūṣaṇāni kāryāṇyakāryāṇi maheśatithyāmnavamyāṃbhūtakarmāṇi bahūnyapi ca kārayetdarśanaṃ gṛhakāryāṇi daśamyāṃ kārayedbudhaḥvāstukaṃśilpanṛttādyamekādaśyāṃ vidhīyatecarasthirāṇi dvādaśyāmanyatraśravaṇaṃvināaśvaśikṣātathālekhyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu kārayetcaturdaśyāṃ na kartavyamanyacca śubhakarma vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: udvāhaśilpākhilabhūṣaṇāḍhyaṃ kāryaṃ pratiṣṭhākhalupaurṇamāsyāmkharaṃvaraṃ kaviṃviṣṇuṃ rālaṃsākaṃ viyatkramāt || 1 || - ||digvahnyarkamanukṣmābhṛdvasavo ghaṭikāḥ kramāttṛtīyāyāṃ priyamgūṇāṃ caturthyāṃ rajatasya casaptamyāṃ vāsasāṃ caiva tvaṣṭamyāṃ vai guḍasya caekādaśyāṃ suvarṇasya dvādaśyāṃ vasanasya cadānaṃ ca paramānnasya paṃcadaśyāṃ mahāphalamdvitīyāyāṃ tu saṃjāto godhānyādhipatirbhavetmedhāvī vākparovidvānjātaḥ śuddho jayātithauoṣadhīśatithaujātaḥ kāruṇya caritaḥ kaviḥmukhapṛṣṭhorutilakaḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ saṃjāyate naraḥsṛṣṭisthityaṃtadakṣassyājjātaśceṃdratithauprabhuḥkāmīkalatravāṃstyāgī tvaṣṭamyāṃ jāyate naraḥśūraḥkuputravānvaśyo navamyāṃ jāyate naraḥnītimānsatyavānvidvāndaśamyāṃ jāyate naraḥdhanavānprabhukāryaśca goviṃdatithijonaraḥdhīrastyāgī sukhīvīro dvādaśyāṃ jāyate naraḥdhanavānnṛttagobhoktā trayodaśyāṃ tu jātavānparadārarataścaiva caturdaśyāṃ tu saṃbhavaḥputramitrakalatrāḍhyo jātaḥpaṃcadaśī tithau || 1 || - ||atisulalitakāṃtirbhūmipālāttavittaḥpratipadiyadisūti jāyate yasya jaṃtoḥprasannamūrtirbahugītakīrtirjātodvitīyātithisaṃbhavassyātpravāsaśīlaścaturovilāsī martyastṛtīyāprabhavobhimānīdyūteratirlolamanāmanuṣyo vādīyadisyājjananeṃ caturthīnareṃdramānyastu narovadānyaḥ prasūtikāle kilapaṃcamī syāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prakṛṣṭakīrtiścaturovariṣṭhaṣṣaṣṭhyāṃ prajātovraṇakīrṇagātraḥkanyāpanetāparavittahartā syātsaptamījomanujorihaṃtākāṃtāprītiścaṃcalasvāṃtavṛttiryasyāṣṭamyāṃ jāyate janmasasyātnarassadācārakṛtādarassyādyasya prasūtaunavamītithissyātudāracitto nitarāṃvinīto ramyaśca kāmī daśamī bhavassyātpuṇyaikacitto gurukarmakṛtsyādekādaśījotikṛśotiroṣaḥsadānnadātā kṣitipāptavittassyāddvādaśījomanujaḥ prajāvānnarotiśuraścaturaḥ prakāmaṃ trayodaśīnāmatithiprasūtaḥsyāddussahotyaṃtaviruddhabhāṣī caturdaśījaḥ puruṣassaroṣaḥprabalabalavilāsotyaṃtakāruṇyapuṇyo guṇagaṇaparipūrṇaḥ pūrṇimājātajanmāmānyojanānāṃhatakāṃti harṣodarśodbhavassyātpuruṣaḥ kṛśāṃgaḥśāṃtikarmaṇipūjārthametāṃ mūrtiṃsamāviśaraktavarṇaḥpratimāyāmamuṣyāṃ tvaṃ sannidhatsvacaturmukharaktavarṇaḥnamasyāmipadābjaṃtepumarthapratipattayepītavarṇaḥgajānanārcāṃ gṛhṇīṣvapratimāmetyasādaramraktavarṇaḥpūjayāmi padābjaṃte sarvasaṃpadavāptayeśubhravarṇaḥpratimāyāṃhiraṇmayyāmehivallī manaḥ priyaraktavarṇaḥtrayītanonamasyāṃte bhūyobhūyaḥ karomyahamraktavarṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prasādaṃ kuru me śambho pratimāme hi sādaramśvetavarṇaḥihāgatyaprasādaṃ me racayāśu sureśvariśyāmavarṇānamonamostunāgāya pratimā me hi sādaramśubhravarṇaḥbhūriśreyassādhanāya dharmāyamahate namaḥnīlavarṇaḥpratimāmetyasahasā prasādaṃ kuru me vibhokanakavarṇaḥehīmāṃpratimāṃtūrṇaṃ prasīdamayimanmathakāṃcanavarṇaḥvaṃcanā caturaṃvaṃde bhūtaye kalibhūpatimkṛṣṇavarṇaḥkṣīrābdhipriyapūtrāya namaścaṃdramasestuteśvetavarṇaḥpratimāṃprāpyasauvarṇī prasīdaṃ tu sadāmayikṛṣṇavarṇāḥ || 1saptāśvarathasaṃyukto dvibhujassyātsadāraviḥpāṭalavarṇaḥgadāpāṇirdvibāhuśca kartavyo varadaḥ śaśīśvetavarṇaḥcaturbhujomeṣagamovaradaḥ syāddharāsutaḥraktavarṇaḥkhaḍgacarmagadāpāṇiḥ siṃhastho varado budhaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pītavarṇaḥdaṃḍinau varadau kāryau sākṣasūtrakamaṃḍalūiṃdranīlākṛtiḥśūlī varadogṛdhravāhanaḥbāṇabāṇāsanadharaḥ kartavyorkasutaḥsadānīlavarṇaḥ || 1auṣadhāhavadhānyādi nilayaṃ bhānuvāsarepuṣpagītakratukṣīrakṛṣikarmeduvāsaredhātvākarapravālāstrakarma bhūmijavāsarevivādadhātusaṃgrāmakarmasaumyasya vāsarevṛkṣagulmalatāyānakarmadevejyavāsarepaṇyotsavādigodhānyakarma bhārgavavāsaresthirakarmākhilaṃvāstu saṃgrahaḥ saurivāsare || 1daśajīve tu saptaiva bhṛguje paṃca sūryajepaṃcaviṃśāśukrabhānvormaṃdeṃdvoścāṣṭanāḍikāḥ || 1tadratnaṃ caiva taddhānyaṃ tadvarṇaṃ vastrameva cataddineṣu yathāśaktyā sarvātkāmānavāpnuyātsahiraṇyaṃ naro dattvā na rogairabhibhūyateabhyaṃgaṃsauridivase dattvājīvitamāpnuyātdātāmahotsāha yutomahaujā dinedine śasya bhavenmanuṣyaḥkukhe ca duḥkhepi samasvabhāvo vārenaraḥ śītakarasya jātaḥsattvānvitastīvratarasvabhāvo dinodbhavothāvaninaṃdanasyavaṇikkriyāyāṃ hi bhavedabhijñaḥ prājñoguṇajñojñadinodbhavoyaḥācāryavaryaśca janapriyassyādvāreguroryasya narasyajanmaśuklāṃbaraḥ prītidharo narassyātsumārgagobhārgavavārajātaḥtamoguṇaḥ kraurya ca yā bhibhūtaḥ śanerdine jātajanirmanuṣyaḥ || 1
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pittavātātmakomānī ravivārodbhavo naraḥśleṣmalaḥ paradārecchuścaṃdravārodbhavo naraḥkharvaḥkopī ca senāḍhyaḥ kujavārodbhavonaraḥsadā tu dharmanirato budhavārodbhavonaraḥtyāgībhogībhaviṣyajjño guruvārodbhavonaraḥgaṃdhamālyopabhogī ca śukravārodbhvonaraḥkunakhīmaṃdakṛtyaśca śanivārodbhavonaraḥ || 1divākarādivārāṇāmadhi devāḥ prakīrtitāḥśirasāpraṇamāmyadyaravivārādhipaṃ śivamśubhravarṇaḥdhyāyāmidaityahaṃtriṃtāṃ raktāsvādanatatparāmmeghavarṇāaṃgārakādhināthaṃ ṣaṇmukhamīḍemareṃdrasenānyamraktavarṇaḥkarairanaṃtāsanasanniviṣṭaṃ dhyāyedrameśaṃbudhavāranāthamnīlavarṇaḥvarābhayakaraḥśuddho guruvārādhipomataḥpadmavarṇaḥkaraiścaturbhirdadhataṃ śukrādhīśvaramāśrayepītavarṇaḥyamaṃnīlatanuṃbhīmaṃ śanivārābhidhaṃbhajenīlavarṇaḥcaṃdreśāditijīvāhipitaraścāryāmābhagaḥyātudhānoṃbuviśve ca viṣṇuśca vasutoyapauajaikapādahirbudhnyapūṣaṇaścetikīrtitāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sudhāsaṃpūrṇakalaśakarābjāvaśvavāhanauyātrābhiṣekamakhadīkṣaṇacaulamauṃjīḥkurvaṃtiśāṃtikavidhānamathāśvinīṣuyamaṃnīlaṃbhajebhīmaṃsuvarṇapratimāgatamdyutābhicāravidhimaṃtrabilapraveśakanyājanāni yamabhe kilayāṃtisiddhimekādaśāhātsukhībhavatī || - || asminnakṣatreprathamarajasvalāvidhavābhavati || - || asminnakṣatre ugrakāryāṇipraśastāni || - || asminnakṣatrejātaguṇāḥ - capalaḥ | bahusutaḥ | śāstrajñaḥ | sumukhaḥ | sukhī | dīrghāyuḥ | satyavādī | subhojanaḥ | strīpriyaḥ | tīvranidraḥ | raktākṣaḥ | raktakeśaḥ | bhogaśarīravān | nābhipradeśetilamatsyāṃkitaḥ | ṣaḍaśītivarṣāṇiparamāyurityādikaṃsarvametadgraṃthedraṣṭavyamsruksruvābhītivaradhṛkcaturhastaṃ namāmyahammaṃtrauṣadhīrasarasāyanasādhakāni sidhyaṃtivahni vihitāni hutāśanarkṣesitakeśaḥ | gaṃbhīraśarīraḥ | vāmabhāgematsyāṃkitaḥ | aśītivarṣāṇiparamāyurityādikaṃ sarvametadgraṃthe draṣṭavyamvarābhayakaraḥ śuddhorohiṇīdevatāstumeśālīkṣuvṛkṣavratabaṃdhanavāhanāninavyāṃbarābharāṇabhūṣaṇamabjajarkṣerohiṇīśakaṭākāraṃ paṃca | ū vā vī vū rohiṇī | kṛṣṇavarṇam | paṃcatārāḥ | śakaṭākṛtiḥ | pumān | manuṣyagaṇaḥ | bhujaṃgayoniḥ | brahmādevatā | śūdrajātiḥ | catuṣpāt | ūrdhvamukham | aṃdhalocanam | sthiram | madhyatārā | pattanasthānam | iṃdramaṃḍalam | jaṃbūvṛkṣaḥ | kukkuṭapakṣī | ukāra ṛkārāvakṣarau | asmin kṛṣṇabhīmau jātau | catvāriṃśadghaṭikābhyaḥ paraṃviṣanāḍyaścatasraḥ | ghṛtamiśraparamānnaṃbhuktvāpūrvottaraprayāṇe śubham | jvaresaptadinānyariṣṭāni || - || tacchāṃtyaibrahmadevatāpūjāvidhānam || kṛṣṇavastram | kastūrīgaṃdhaḥ || kahlārapuṣpam | gugguladhūpaḥ | kṣīrānnanaivedyam | namobrahmaṇe itimantreṇaṣoḍaśopacāraissaṃpūjyasarpirmiśrasaptadhānyairgāyatryā aṣṭottaraśataṃjuhuyāt | gaṃdhamālyaiḥ kṣīrodanaṃ prāgdiśibaliṃ haret || - || asminnakṣatreprathamarajasvalāpati priyāputravatī bhavati || - || asminnakṣatre ṛtusīmaṃtapuṃsavanacaulopanayanavedaśāstrābhyāsasamāvartanavivāha-tailābhyaṃgana vā bharaṇarājābhiṣekasiṃhāsanāṃ dolanārohaṇanavavāstu puragrāmasvīkaraṇapraveśagṛhapraveśadevatāpratisṭhākrayavikrayayajñādhyayana-homaśāṃtikapauṣṭikadhanadhānyataṭākādi śubhakāryāṇi praśastāti || - || asminnakṣatrejātaguṇāḥ - surūpaḥ || suratapriyaḥ | samarthaḥ | nipuṇaḥ | dhānyāḍhyaḥ | nānāvastrapriyaḥ | netrarogī kiṃciddīnaḥ | pīnasarogī | svalpapādapāṇiskaṃdhalalāṭaḥ | svamātulāriḥ | aṣṭāśītivarṣāṇiparamāyurityādikametadgraṃthe draṣṭavyamdaśāśvarathamārūḍho mṛgaśīrṣostumemudeśāṃtisnānanṛpābhiṣekaniyamāndevāgnipitrarcanaṃ kuryācchāṃtikapauṣṭikādi śubhadaṃ caṃdrarkṣabhe saṃyute || 1 || - || śiromṛgaśirāstrīṇi | ve vo kā kī mṛgaśirāḥ | śvetavarṇam | tritārā | mṛgaśīrṣākṛtiḥ || napuṃsakam | devagaṇaḥ | tiryaṅmukham | sarpiṇīyoniḥ | somodevatā | upajīvajātiḥ | dvipāt | maṃdalocanam | mṛduḥ | samatārā | sthānaṃpuram | vāyumaṃḍalam | khādiravṛkṣaḥ | kukkuṭapakṣī | ṛkārākṣarassvaraḥ | nirjīvajātiḥ || asminnakṣatre puruṣamṛgojātaḥ || caturdaśaghaṭikābhyaḥ paraṃ viṣanāḍyaścatasraḥ || mṛgamāṃsabhakṣaṇaṃkṛtvāpūrvottaraprayāṇe śubham | jvareprāṇabhayam | athavāmāsamariṣṭam || - || tacchāṃtyaisomadevatāpūjāvidhānam | śvetavastram | śvetacaṃdanam | kuṃdapuṣpam | gugguladhūpaḥ | paramānnanaivedyam | vavonava itimaṃtreṇaṣoḍaśopacāraissaṃpūjyakṣīramiśraghṛtenagāyatryā aṣṭottaraśataṃjuhuyāt | gaṃdhamālyaiḥ kṣīrodanaṃbaliṃharet | māsātsukhī bhavati || - || asminnakṣatrejātaguṇāḥ - saubhāgyayutaḥ | tejasvī | sthūlakāyaḥ | saṃpūrṇāṃgaḥ | kopavān | bhogī | arthavyayakaraḥ | paṃḍitaḥ | dīrghajīvī | vicitraripugaṇaḥ | pittavān | annadātā | matsarī | krūrakāryaḥ | dhīraḥ | paradeśagaḥ | raktakeśaḥ | kiṃcittilamatsyāṃkitaḥ | caturaśītivarṣāṇiparamāyurityādikaṃ sarvametadgraṃthe draṣṭavyam || 1saṃgrāmauṣadhavāditrakriyāḥ śastāśca vahnibhe || 1 || - ||saṃtarpyabrāhmaṇāṃtsādhūṁllokānāpnotyanuttamānpayonupānaṃ dātavyamānṛṇyārthaṃ dvijātaye || 1kṣauravāstu gajoṣṭrāśva yātrāḥ śastāśca caṃdrabhe || 1 || - ||dattvā divyavimānasthaḥ svargaṃprāpnotyanuttamamsaṃdhivigrahavaitāna rasādyāḥ śārvabhe śubhāḥ || 1 || - ||narastaratidūrgāṇi kṣuradhārāṃśca parvatān || 1kṣaurāstrakarmāditibhe vidheyaṃ dhānyabhuṣaṇam || 1 || - ||yaśasvīrūpasaṃpanno bahvanne jāyate kule || 1karagrahaṃvināsarva karmadevejyabhe śubham || 1 || - ||anālokeṣulokeṣu somavatsavirājate || 1vivādarasavāṇijyakarmabhaujaṃgabhe śubham || 1 || - ||sasarvabhayanirmuktaḥ śāstravānabhijāyate || 1vivāhanṛttagītādyāṃ nikhilaṃ karmapaitṛbhe || 1 || - ||pradāyapaśumāṃścaiva putravāṃśca prajāyate || 1pūrvatrayekhilaṃkarma kartavyaṃ māṃsavikrayaḥ || 1 || - ||bhakṣyāṃśca phāṇitairyuktāndattvā saubhāgyamaśnute || 1praveśasthāpanāśvebha vāstukarmottarā traye || 1 || - ||uttarāviṣaye dattvā svargeloke mahīyatesadāphalamanaṃtaṃ ca bhavatīhaviniścayaḥ || 2kṣauravāstvabhiṣekāśca bhūṣaṇaṃkarmabhānubhe || 1 || - ||narastarati durgāṇi kṣuradhārāśca parvatān || 1

sanskrit: tvāṣṭrabhevāstuvidyāssyuḥ kṣurabhūṣaṇakarmayat || 1 || - ||caratyapsarasāṃ loke ramate naṃdane vane || 1paśvaṃbvaśvebhakṛṣyādi kṣaurakarmasamīrabhe || 1 || - ||prāpnoti lokāṃśca śubhāniha caiva mahadyaśaḥ || 1sagrāsaṃgaṃ ca śakaṭaṃ sadhānyaṃ vastrasaṃyutamna ca durgāṇyavāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca gacchatinārakīyāṃśca saṃkleśānna prāpnotīti niścayaḥ || 3vastrabhūṣaṇavāstvādya maitrabhe saṃdhivigraham || 1 || - ||dattvāyugaśataṃvāpi naraḥ svarge mahīyate || 1iṃdrabhenṛttavāditraśilpalohāśma locanam || 1 || - ||jyeṣṭhāyāṃ mṛtyumutsādya gatimiṣṭāṃ ca gacchati || 1nir-ṛtaunṛttaśilpāstra saṃdhi vigraha lekhanamsvapitṝnprīṇaye deva gatimiṣṭāṃ ca gacchatipūrvāṣāḍhāsu kartavyaṃ māṃsavikraya karma vai || 1 || - ||kulavṛttopasaṃpanne brāhmaṇe vedapārageputrapautraiḥ parivṛtaḥ paśumāndhanavāṃstathā || 2praveśasthāpanāśvebha vāstukarmottarā traye || 1 || - ||dattvottarāsvaṣāḍhāsu sarvalokānavāpnuyāt || 1 || - ||dharmaniṣṭhomanīṣibhyaḥ svarge loke mahīyate || 1(uttarāṣāḍhānakṣatracaturthapādaśravaṇabhasyādyaghaṭikācatuṣṭayayuktaḥ-kālo'bhijidyoga ityucyate)purārāmagṛhāraṃbhaṃviṣṇubhe paṭṭabaṃdhanam || 1 || - ||śvetenayātvā yānena svargeloke mahīyate || 1vasubhevāstusīmaṃta praveśāśvebhabhūṣaṇam || 1 || - ||vastramasminnavaṃ dattvā pretyarājyaṃ prapadyate || 1aśvābharaṇasīmaṃta vāstukarmajale śubhe || 1 || - ||
