sanskrit: prāpnotyapsarasāṃlokaṃ dhattegaṃdhāṃśca śāśvatān || 1pūrvātrayekhilaṃkāryaṃ māṃsavikrayaṇādikam || 1 || - ||sarvabhakṣyaphalopetaṃ sarvaiḥ pretyasukhī bhavet || 1praveśasthāpanāśvebha vāstukarmottarā traye || 1 || - ||pitṛnprīṇāti sakalānpretyacānaṃtyamaśnute || 1praveśavastrasīmaṃta kṣaurabheṣajamaṃtyabhe || 1 || - ||sapretyakāmānādāyadātāramupatiṣṭhate || 1sthāpanāśvebhayānāstra kṛṣividyādayośvibhe || 1 || - ||hastyaśvarathasaṃpanne varcasvāñjāyate kule || 1bilapraveśagaṇitanikṣepāyāmyabhe śubhāḥ || 1 || - ||gā prabhṛtā athāpnoti naraḥpretyayaśastathā || 1kṛtidhṛtisamidhaḥ kṛtimanumanudiṅmanukṭijināḥkṛtiḥkakubhaḥparatoghṭīcatuṣkaṃ viṣasaṃjñaṃ kṛttikādiṣu jñeyam || 2vidyeṃdrābdhiyugābdhidigdhṛtijinairarkaiḥpurāṇairyutānāḍīstriṃśadatītyabheṣu-puratonāḍyaścatasro'mṛtam || 1yoṣidvibhūṣātmajabhūritoṣaḥ syādaśvinībhejananaṃ prapannaḥjalāttabhītiścapalaḥ khalassyātprāṇipraṇītobharaṇībhajātaḥkaṭhoravāggarhitakarmakṛtsyāccetkṛttikājanmani yasya jaṃtoḥvāgvilāsakalitākhilāśayorohiṇībhavati yasya janmabhambhoktānṛpasnehabhareṇapūrṇaḥ sanmārgavettā mṛgajātajanmāpasūtikāle ca bhavet kilārdrādayārdracetānabhavenmanuṣyaḥdātāpratāpīvasudhāvasuśca punarvasū yasya bhavet prasūtaubhavenmanuṣyaḥ khalupaṣyajanmā sanmānanānādhanavāhanāḍhyaḥsārpesadarpohivṛthārpitārthaḥ kaṃdarpasaṃtaptamanāmanuṣyaḥcejjavmabhaṃ yasya maghānaghassyānmatissadārāti vighātadakṣādhūrtaḥkrotyantasaṃjātagarvaḥ pūrvāphalgunyasti cejjanmakāle
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dhīronarotyaṃtamṛdūttaraḥ syācceduttarāphalgunikāprasūtauprasutikāle yadi yasya hasto hastodgatā tasya samastasaṃpatprasutikāle yadi yasya citrābuddhirvicitrākhalu tasya śāstresvātīprasūtaumanujasya yasya bhavennṛpaḥ prāptavibhūti yuktaḥyasya prasūtau ca bhavedviśākhāsakhānakasyāpi bhavenmanuṣyaḥsyātsaṃbhave yasya kilānurādhāsaṃpadvibādhāvividhā ca tasyaśreṣṭhapratiṣṭhovadatāṃ variṣṭho jyeṣṭhodbhavasssyātpuruṣo viśeṣātcedanyathā tatkurute viśeṣātsaubhāgyamātu(yu)ścakulābhivṛddhimtatrotpannaśiśormukham || aṣṭavarṣāṇinālokyaṃtā tena śubhamicchatāratnaiśśatauṣadhīmūlaiḥ saptamṛdbhiḥ prapūrayetbālakāṃ'vāpitṛsnāne vipraissaṃpādite sativiruddhāvayave mūle vidhirevaṃ smṛto budhaiḥcaturthapādaśśubhado nitāṃtaṃ sārpe vilomaṃ parikalpanīyamcejjanmakāle kilatatramūlamunmūlanaṃ tatkurute kulasyapaśūnāṃmitravargasya kramānmūlamaniṣṭadamgajāśca bhujayoryugme hastayorhṛdayeṣṭakamvinyasya puruṣākāre mūlasya phalamādiśetskaṃdhayordhūrvahatvaṃ ca bāhuyugmetva karmakṛtalpāyurnābhi deśe ca guhye ca sukhamadbhutamghaṭīphalaṃ kilaproktaṃ mūlasya munipuṃgavaiḥpitāmātāyamaḥ kālo viśvedevāmaheśvaraḥgaṃdharvo yamadevaśca brahmāviṣṇuryamastathāṣaṇmukhobhṛṃgirīṭiśca gaurīnāmnāsarasvatīviparītāḥ punarjñeyā āśleṣājātabālaketrayoviṃśe ca navame kulakṣayakaraḥ śiśuḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mūlavṛkṣavibhāgeṣu maṃgalaṃ hi phale bhavetpādemūhūrte velāyāṃ vṛkṣe ca puruṣā kṛtautātaṃvābhrātaraṃ jyeṣṭhaṃriṣṭa sātkurute dhruvambhūmiratnānnahemādi deyaṃ vipreṣu bhaktitaḥpratāpitārātijanomanuṣyo mūlekṛtīsyājjananaṃprapannaḥnūnaṃsaṃpajjāyate tasya gāḍhāpūrvāṣāḍhājanmabhaṃ yasya puṃsaḥkāṃtāsutāvāptasukhonitāṃtaṃ lokesuveṣaḥ puruṣomanīṣīdvijavarasurabhaktirvyaktavāṅmānavassyādabhijitiyadisūtirbhūpatiḥ sa svaṃvaṃśeprāṇīpurāṇaśravaṇapravīṇaścejjanmakāle śravaṇaṃ hi yasyayasya prasūtau ca bhaveddhaniṣṭhāmahānpratiṣṭhā sahito narassyātvairiṇāmativiśeṣadāruṇo vāruṇo yadi ca yasya saṃbhavebhavenmanīṣāsutarāmapūrvāpurvāyadābhādrapadāprasūtauyasyottarābhādrapadā ca janyāṃ dhanyāṃ labhen māṃ ca bhavedvādānyaḥmānavonanubhavenmahāmatīrevatī bhavati yasya janmabham || 1atigaṃḍassukarmā ca dhṛtiśśūlastathaiva cavajraṃsiddhirvyatīpātovarīyāt parivaśśivaḥete yogāḥ prakathitāssaptaviṃśatisaṃkhyayā || 3prāṅmukhaṃprāṃjalikaraṃtrikoṇoparisaṃsthitamkāṣṭhakarmaripūccāṭaṃviṣkaṃbhetu prakārayet || 1 || - ||viṣkaṃbhesarvadhānyānāṃ dānaṃ sarvāghanāśanamprāṅmukhaṃ puṃḍarīkākṣaṃ japamālādharaṃ śubhamrājavaśyaṃ mahotsāhaṃ prītiyoge ca kārayet || 1 || - ||prītautathānnasvarṇānāmprāṅmukhaṃpaṃcakoṇasthaṃ kauṃḍinyānvayasaṃbhavamvivādaṃpāṇipīḍāñca hyāyuṣmatyapi kārayet || 1 || - ||
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: (dānam) - āyuṣmatighṛtasya cakauṃḍinyagotrajanitaṃ prāṅmukhaṃjapatāṃvaramyajñakarmasurāpānaṃ saubhāgyekārayedbudhaḥ || 1 || - ||(dānam) - kuṃkumasya ca saubhāgyeśobhanaṃśobhanakaraṃ namatāmāśraye sadānṛpābhiṣekamārogyakarmakuryāccaśobhane || 1 || - ||(dānam) - yavadānaṃcaśobhaneatigaṃḍābhidhaṃvaṃde japaṃtaṃ prāṅmukhaṃ sadākṣudrakriyātigaṃḍekāryaṃ viṣaśastravahnikarmādyam || 2 || - ||(dānam) - atigaṃḍecavastrāṇāmkauṣikānvayasaṃbhūtaṃ japaṃtaṃ lokapūjitamrājābhiṣekakarmāṇisukarmaṇi ca kārayet || 1 || - ||(dānam) - pāyasasyasukarmaṇidakṣiṇāmukhamāsīno vedāmreḍanatatparaḥvratabaṃdhaṃgajārohaṃ dhṛtiyoge tu kārayet || 1 || - ||(dānam) - dhṛtaurajatadānaṃcadakṣiṇāmukha āsīnaḥkuṃḍinānvayasaṃbhavaḥnivāraṇaṃkrūrakarmaśūlayogevidhīyate || 1 || - ||(dānam) - śūlemūlādidānakamdakṣiṇāmukha āsīno brahmapāṭhaparāyaṇaḥbāhuyuddhaṃbhṛtyakarmakṣātraṃgaṃḍe praśasyate || 1 || - ||(dānam) - gaṃḍemaṃḍanadānaṃcayaściṃtayanparaṃbrahmabrasīmāśrityatiṣṭhatitaṭākasetubaṃdhaṃ ca vṛddhiyoge tu kārayet || 1 || - ||(dānam) - vṛddhaugodānamiṣyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: karebibhrannakṣamālāṃ gāyattrīmādarājjapansetubaṃdhanakarmāṇi kuryādyoge dhruvā hvaye || 1 || - ||(dānam) - dhruvecapaṃcaratnānāmpratyaṅmukhopavisṭaṃtaṃ pratyagraravisannibhamsarvāṇikrūrakarmāṇibhedanoccāṭanāni ca || 1 || - ||(phāṇitamityasyaguḍamiśrāpūpamityarthaḥ)paṭhaṃtaṃvedamaniśaṃ kāśyapānvayasaṃbhavamvaivāhikāstrasaṃgrahanṛpābhiṣekādyamakhilaśubhakarma || 1 || - ||(dānam) - harṣaṇegaṃdhadānaṃsyātpratyaṅmukha upāsīnaḥ paṭhanpraṇavamanvahamśastrasaṃgrahaṇādyaṃ ca vajrayoge praśasyate || 1 || - ||(dānam) - vajredadyānmaṇīnapiviṣṭaroparisaṃviṣṭovedāṃtapaṭhanonmukhaḥsuvarṇamuktāphalabhūṣaṇādi karmāṇisidhyaṃti ca siddhiyoge || 1 || - ||(dānam) - siddhausiddhārthakādeyāḥpratyaṅmukhaṃ pāṭhayaṃtaṃ vedāñchiṣyānaharniśamaṣṭanetraścaturvaktro vistīrṇaḥ śatayojanamripubhedoviṣātyugraṃ kāryaṃ ca vyatipātake || 1 || - ||(dānam) - vyatīpāte ca kāṃcanampratyaṅmukhaḥ prāṃjalikassāvetasakulodbhavaḥgajaturagādyadhirohaṇamakhilaṃ ca śubhaṃ varīyasi proktam || 1 || - ||(dānam) - varīyasitilāndadyātkailāsaśikharārūḍhosāmagāyanbhavenmayikrūraṃsamastaṃparighasyapūrvadalepikāryaṃ śubhamanyabhāge || 1 || - ||(dānam) - śastrāṇiparighe tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00238 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viṣṇuvaṃśasamudbhūtaḥ ṛgadhyāpanatatparaḥvivāhādyakhilaṃ yātrā śivayoge praśasyate || 1 || - ||(dānam) - jalakuṃbhāśśivedeyāḥudaṅmukhassvaśiṣyebhyo yajūṃṣisatataṃ paṭhandevapratiṣṭhādi śubhaṃ ca karmasiddhāhvaye sarvamuśaṃti yoge || 1 || - ||(dānam) - siddhesidhānnamiṣyateudaṅmukhomahāmaṃtramātharvaṇamanusmaransthiracarayātrādyakhilaṃ kāryaṃ sādhyāhvaye yoge || 1 || - ||sādhyelaṃkaraṇānāṃ caudaṅmukhojapanmaṃtraṃ śaivaṃpaṃcākṣaraṃ śubhamdhanadhānyagṛhodyogaṃ kāryaṃyoge śubhā hvaye || 1 || - ||(dānam) - chatradānaṃśubheśubhampratyagdṛṣṭissadābhūyātkauśikānvayasaṃbhavaḥkanyādānaṃ mahotsāhaṃ śuklayoge ca kārayet || 1 || - ||(dānam) - śuklecopānahordānambrahmaṇyāhitadṛṣṭissantapannastu sukhāyamekṛṣividyāsetubaṃdhaṃ yoge brahmā hvaye hitam || 1 || - ||(dānam) - śastaṃbrahmaṇisarpiṣaḥvādhūlānvaya jātāya varadāya sadānṛṇāmkāvyanāṭakasaṃgītamaiṃdrayoge tu sidhyati || 1 || - ||(dānam) - aiṃdre ca dīpakāndadyātkauṃḍinyagotrajobrahmasaṃsmaranmanasānvahamdadhataṃḍamaruṃ śūlaṃkhaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇamuccāṭanaṃvaṃcanaśṛṃkhalādikāryaṃ hitaṃvaidhṛtināmayoge || 1 || - ||(dānam) - vaidhṛtaukanakaṃhitam || 1
